name: IsRed_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRed_nil : IsRed []
proof: := by simp [IsRed]

name: IsRed_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRed_singleton x : IsRed [x]
proof: := by simp [IsRed]

name: IsRed_reverse
statement: theorem IsRed_reverse (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) → IsRed w
proof:
:= by
  intro h i hi
  symm
  specialize h (w.length - (i+2)) (by simp; omega)
  simp only [List.getElem_reverse, ne_eq] at h
  show ¬_
  convert h using 3 <;> omega

name: IsRed_reverse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem IsRed_reverse_iff (w : W) : IsRed (w ⁻¹) ↔ IsRed w
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ IsRed_reverse _ h, fun h ↦ IsRed_reverse _ (by simp [h])⟩

name: IsRed_uncons
statement: theorem IsRed_uncons {x} {ys} (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed ys
proof:
:=
  fun _ hh ↦ h _ (Nat.add_lt_of_lt_sub hh)

name: IsRed_cons
statement: theorem IsRed_cons {y} {x} {ys} (hne : y ≠ x) (h : IsRed (x :: ys)) : IsRed (y :: x :: ys)
proof:
:= by
  intro i hi
  match i with
  | 0 => exact hne
  | i+1 => exact h i (Nat.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hi)

name: IsRed_not_repeated
statement: lemma IsRed_not_repeated {ys} {x} {xs} : ¬ IsRed (ys ++ x :: x :: xs)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  specialize h ys.length (by simp)
  rw [List.getElem_append_right] at h
  rotate_left; · simp
  rw [List.getElem_append_right] at h
  rotate_left; · simp
  simp at h

name: red_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem red_nil : red [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: red_singleton
statement: @[simp] theorem red_singleton (x : Fin 3) : red [x] = [x]
proof: := rfl

name: red_duoton_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_duoton_succ (x : Fin 3) : red [x, x+1] = [x, x+1]
proof:
:= by
  simp! [red]; omega

name: red_duoton_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_duoton_succ_succ (x : Fin 3) : red [x + 1 + 1, x] = [x+1+1, x]
proof:
:= by
  simp! [red]; omega

name: red_IsRed
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_IsRed (w : W) : IsRed (red w)
proof:
:=
  go [] w IsRed_nil

name: red_length_le
statement: theorem red_length_le (w : W) : (red w).length ≤ w.length
proof:
:= by
  simpa using go [] w

name: red.go_length_le
statement:
theorem red.go_length_le (ys xs : W) :
    ys.length ≤ (red.go ys xs).length + xs.length
proof:
:= by
  induction ys, xs using red.go.induct <;> simp_all [red.go] <;> omega

name: red_eq_of_IsRed
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_eq_of_IsRed {w : W} (h : IsRed w) : red w = w
proof:
:=
  go [] w h

name: red_red
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_red (w : W) : red (red w) = red w
proof: := red_eq_of_IsRed (red_IsRed _)

name: red_reduce
statement: theorem red_reduce {ys} {x} {xs} : red (ys ++ x :: x :: xs) = red (ys ++ xs)
proof:
:=
  go [] ys IsRed_nil

name: rev_red
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rev_red (w : W) : (red w)⁻¹ = red (w⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [red] using go [] w (by simp)

name: red_append_red_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_append_red_right (w v : W) : red (w ++ red v) = red (w ++ v)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [red] using go [] v

name: red_append_red_left
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_append_red_left (w v : W) : red (red w ++ v) = red (w ++ v)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.reverse_injective; simp

name: red_append_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_append_inv (w v : W) : red (w⁻¹ ++ (w ++ v)) = red v
proof:
:= by
  induction w <;> simp [red_reduce, *]

name: red_rev_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_rev_self (w : W) : red (w⁻¹ ++ w) = []
proof:
:= by
  simpa using red_append_inv w []

name: red_append_inv_right
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_append_inv_right (w v : W) : red (w ++ (v⁻¹ ++ v)) = red w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← red_append_red_right]
  simp

name: red_append_nil_iff_eq_inv
statement:
theorem red_append_nil_iff_eq_inv (w v : W) (hw : IsRed w) (hv : IsRed v) :
    red (w ++ v) = [] ↔ w = v⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact go [] w hw
  · intro h
    simp [h]

name: red_append_nil_iff
statement:
theorem red_append_nil_iff (w v : W) :
    red (w ++ v) = [] ↔ red w = (red v)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← red_append_red_right, ← red_append_red_left]
  apply red_append_nil_iff_eq_inv
  · exact red_IsRed w
  · exact red_IsRed v

name: red_eq_red_iff_red_append_nil
statement:
theorem red_eq_red_iff_red_append_nil (w v : W) :
  red w = red v ↔ red (w⁻¹ ++ v) = []
proof: := by rw [red_append_nil_iff, ← rev_red, List.reverse_inj]

name: red_append_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_append_inj (w v : W) (h : IsRed w):
    w = red (w ++ v) ↔ red v = []
proof:
:= by
  rw [← red_eq_of_IsRed h, red_append_red_left, red_eq_red_iff_red_append_nil, ← List.append_assoc,
    red_append_nil_iff, red_rev_self, List.nil_eq, List.reverse_eq_nil_iff]

name: red_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_f (w : W) : red (f w) = f w
proof:
:= by
  unfold f; split <;> simp

name: rev_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rev_f (w : W) : (f w)⁻¹ = f w
proof:
:= by
  unfold f; split <;> simp

name: ff_fff
statement: theorem ff_fff (z : W) (h : IsRed z) : f (f z) = f (red (f (f z) ++ z))
proof:
:= by
  match z with
  | [] => simp
  | [x] => simp [f]
  | x::y::zs =>
    have : IsRed ((x + 1) :: x :: y :: zs) := IsRed_cons (by simp; omega) h
    simp [f.eq_3, this]

name: M.Satisfies206
statement: theorem M.Satisfies206 : Equation206 M
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨w, hw⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩
  simpa [Magma.op, hw, hv, red_append_nil_iff] using
    ff_fff (red (w⁻¹ ++ v)) (red_IsRed _)

name: M.Refutes1648
statement: theorem M.Refutes1648 : ¬ Equation1648 M
proof:
:= by
  unfold Equation1648
  push Not
  use ⟨[1], by simp⟩, ⟨[3], by simp⟩
  decide

name: Fact
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Fact : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Facts G [206] [1648]
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, _, M.Satisfies206, M.Refutes1648⟩

name: g_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem g_nil : g [] = [1]
proof: := rfl

name: gg_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem gg_nil : g (g []) = [1]
proof: := rfl

name: g_ne_nil
statement: theorem g_ne_nil (w : W) : g w ≠ []
proof:
:= by
  induction w <;> simp [g]

name: red_g
statement:
@[simp]
theorem red_g (w : W) : red (g w) = g w
proof:
:= by
  unfold g; split <;> simp

name: rev_g
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rev_g (w : W) : (g w)⁻¹ = g w
proof:
:= by
  unfold g; split <;> simp

name: f_nil_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem f_nil_iff (w : W) : f w = [] ↔ w = []

name: ff_gff
statement: theorem ff_gff (z : W) (h : IsRed z) (ineq : z ≠ []) : f (f z) = g (red (f (f z) ++ z))
proof:
:= by
  match z with
  | [] => tauto
  | [x] => simp [f, g]
  | x::y::zs =>
    have : IsRed ((x + 1) :: x :: y :: zs) := IsRed_cons (by simp; omega) h
    simp [f.eq_3, this, g]

name: fg_gfg
statement: theorem fg_gfg (z : W) (h : IsRed z) : f (g z) = g (red (f (g z) ++ z))
proof:
:= by
  match z with
  | [] => tauto
  | [x] =>
    have : IsRed [x+1,x] := IsRed_cons (by simp; omega) h
    simp [f, g, this]
  | x::y::zs =>
    have : IsRed ((x + 1) :: x :: y :: zs) := IsRed_cons (by simp; omega) h
    simp [f.eq_3, this, g]

name: M2.Satisfies1841
statement: theorem M2.Satisfies1841 : Equation1841 M2
proof:
:= by
  intro ⟨(w,fw), hw⟩ ⟨(v,fv), hv⟩
  cases fw with
  | false =>
    cases fv with
    | false =>
      by_cases h : w = v
      · simp only [h, Magma.op, ↓reduceIte, red_rev_self, rev_red, List.reverse_append, rev_g,
        red_append_red_left, List.append_assoc, red_append_inv_right, red_g, Prod.mk.injEq,
        Subtype.mk.injEq, red_append_inj _ _ hv, and_true]
        decide
      · simpa [Magma.op, hw, hv, red_append_nil_iff, h] using
        ff_gff (red (w⁻¹ ++ v)) (red_IsRed _)
    | true =>
      simp only [Magma.op, hw, red_append_inj, red_g, red_append_red_right, red_append_inv]
      rw [ite_cond_eq_false _ _]
      simpa [Magma.op, hw, hv, red_append_nil_iff] using
        fg_gfg (red (w⁻¹ ++ v)) (red_IsRed _)
      simp [g_ne_nil]
  | true => simp only [Magma.op]

name: M2.Refutes203
statement: theorem M2.Refutes203 : ¬ Equation203 M2
proof:
:= by
  unfold Equation203
  push Not
  use ⟨([], false), by simp⟩
  decide

name: Fact2
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Fact2 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Facts G [1841] [203]
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, _, M2.Satisfies1841, M2.Refutes203⟩

name: M.mul_def
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: M.mul_self
statement:
@[simp]
private theorem M.mul_self (a : M) : a * a = a
proof:
:= by
  simp [M.mul_def a a]

name: Msat3102
statement: private theorem Msat3102 (x y : M) : x = (((y * x) * x) * x) * x
proof:
:= by
  rw [M.mul_def y x]
  split
  · next h => simp
  next h =>
  split
  · next h => simp
  rw [M.mul_def (y ++ x) x]
  split
  · next h => simp
  next h =>
  split
  · next h => simp
  rw [M.mul_def (y ++ x ++ x) x]
  split
  · next h => simp
  next h =>
  split
  · next h => simp
  rw [M.mul_def _ x]
  split
  · next h => simp
  next h =>
  rw [if_pos]
  repeat rw [List.append_assoc]
  exact List.suffix_append y (x ++ (x ++ x))

name: Mnot3176
statement: private theorem Mnot3176 : ∃ (x y z : M), x ≠ (((y * z) * x) * x) * x

name: Mnot270
statement: private theorem Mnot270 : ∃ (x y : M), x ≠ ((y * x) * x) * x
proof:
:= by
  exists [0], [1]

name: Equation3102_not_implies_Equation3176
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Equation3102_not_implies_Equation3176 : ∃ (G: Type) (_: Magma G), Equation3102 G ∧ ¬ Equation3176 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M, ⟨M.mul⟩, Msat3102, ?_⟩
  · unfold Equation3176
    push Not
    exact Mnot3176

name: Equation3102_not_implies_Equation270
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Equation3102_not_implies_Equation270 : ∃ (G: Type) (_: Magma G), Equation3102 G ∧ ¬ Equation270 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨M, ⟨M.mul⟩, Msat3102, ?_⟩
  · unfold Equation270
    push Not
    exact Mnot270

name: RArray.get_eq_def
statement:
theorem RArray.get_eq_def (a : RArray α) (n : Nat) :
  a.get n = match a with
    | .leaf x => x
    | .branch p l r => (Nat.ble p n).rec (l.get n) (r.get (n.sub p))
proof:
:= by
  conv => lhs; unfold RArray.get
  split <;> rfl

name: RArray.get_eq_getImpl
statement:
@[csimp]
theorem RArray.get_eq_getImpl : @RArray.get = @RArray.getImpl
proof:
:= by
  ext α a n
  induction a generalizing n with
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | branch p l r ihl ihr =>
    rw [RArray.getImpl, RArray.get_eq_def]
    simp only [ihl, ihr]
    cases hnp : Nat.ble p n
    · replace hnp := ne_true_of_eq_false hnp
      simp at hnp
      rw [if_pos]
      omega
    · simp at hnp
      rw [if_neg]; rfl
      omega

name: RArray.checkSize_iff
statement:
theorem RArray.checkSize_iff {arr : RArray α} {n} :
    arr.checkSize = some n ↔ arr.WF ∧ arr.size = n
proof:
:= by
  induction arr generalizing n <;>
    simp only [checkSize, Option.some.injEq, WF, size, true_and, Option.bind_eq_some_iff, and_assoc,
      exists_and_left, exists_eq_left', and_left_comm, *]
  repeat apply and_congr_right'
  rename_i i l _ _ _
  cases e : i.beq l.size <;> simp [Bool.eq_false_iff] at e <;> simp [e]

name: RArray.ofFn_correct
statement:
theorem RArray.ofFn_correct {n : Nat} (f : Fin n → α) (h : 0 < n) (i : Fin n):
    RArray.get (RArray.ofFn f h) i = f i
proof:
:=
  go 0 n h (Nat.le_refl _) (Nat.zero_le _) i.2

name: LawN_implies_LawM
statement: theorem LawN_implies_LawM : @Law.MagmaLaw.implies.{0} Nat LawN LawM

name: Subgraph.LawN_implied
statement: theorem Subgraph.LawN_implied : ∀ (l : Law.MagmaLaw.{0} Nat), @Law.MagmaLaw.implies.{0} Nat l LawN

name: commut
statement: lemma commut (a b : α) : a | b = b | a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a | b = (a | b)′′ := by rw [sh₁]
    _     = (a | (b′′))′′ := by rw [sh₁ b]
    _     = (b′′ | a)′′ := by conv => left; arg 1; arg 1; simp [prime]
                              conv => left; arg 1; rw [sh₃]
                              rfl
    _     = b | a := by repeat rw [sh₁]

name: all_bot
statement: lemma all_bot (a b : α) : a | a′ = b | b′
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a | a′ = (a | a′)′′ := by rw [sh₁]
    _      = ((a | a′) | (b | b′))′ := by rw [sh₂]
    _      = ((b | b′) | (a | a′))′ := by rw [commut]
    _      = (b | b′)′′ := by rw [sh₂]
    _      = b | b′     := by rw [sh₁]

name: inf
statement: lemma inf (a b : α) : a ⊓ b = (a′ | b′)
proof: := rfl

name: sup
statement: lemma sup (a b : α) : a ⊔ b = (a | b)′
proof: := rfl

name: comple
statement: lemma comple (a : α) : aᶜ = a′
proof: := rfl

name: commut
statement: lemma commut₁ (a b : α) : a ⊔ b = b ⊔ a
proof: := by simp only [sup, commut]

name: commut
statement: lemma commut₂ (a b : α) : a ⊓ b = b ⊓ a
proof: := by simp only [inf, commut]

name: ident
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ident₁ (a : α) : a ⊔ z = a
proof: := by simp only [sup, z, sh₁, sh₂]

name: ident
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ident₂ (a : α) : a ⊓ u = a
proof: := by simp only [inf, u, z, sh₁, sh₂]

name: distrib
statement: lemma distrib₁ (a b c : α) : a ⊔ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊓ (a ⊔ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sup, inf, sh₁, sh₃, commut]

name: distrib
statement: lemma distrib₂ (a b c : α) : a ⊓ (b ⊔ c) = (a ⊓ b) ⊔ (a ⊓ c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sup, inf, sh₁]
  conv => left; exact (sh₁ _).symm
  rw [sh₃]
  exact congr rfl (congr (congr rfl (commut ..)) (commut ..))

name: compl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compl₁ (a : α) : a ⊔ aᶜ = u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sup, u, z, comple]
  exact congr rfl (all_bot a elt)

name: compl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma compl₂ (a  : α) : a ⊓ aᶜ = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [inf, z, comple, sh₁, commut]
  exact all_bot a elt

name: bound
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound₁ (a : α) : a ⊔ u = u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊔ u = (a ⊔ u) ⊓ u        := by rw [ident₂]
    _     = u ⊓ (a ⊔ u)        := by rw [commut₂]
    _     = (a ⊔ aᶜ) ⊓ (a ⊔ u) := by rw [compl₁]
    _     = a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ u)       := by rw [distrib₁]
    _     = a ⊔ aᶜ             := by rw [ident₂]
    _     = u                  := compl₁ a

name: bound
statement:
@[simp]
lemma bound₂ (a : α) : a ⊓ z = z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊓ z = (a ⊓ z) ⊔ z        := by rw [ident₁]
    _     = z ⊔ (a ⊓ z)        := by rw [commut₁]
    _     = (a ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (a ⊓ z) := by rw [compl₂]
    _     = a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊔ z)       := by rw [distrib₂]
    _     = a ⊓ aᶜ             := by rw [ident₁]
    _     = z                  := compl₂ a

name: absorb
statement:
@[simp] 
lemma absorb₁ (a b : α) : a ⊔ (a ⊓ b) = a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊔ (a ⊓ b) = (a ⊓ u) ⊔ (a ⊓ b) := by rw [ident₂]
    _           = a ⊓ (u ⊔ b)       := by rw [distrib₂]
    _           = a ⊓ (b ⊔ u)       := by conv => lhs; rw [commut₁]
    _           = a ⊓ u             := by rw [bound₁]
    _           = a                 := ident₂ a

name: absorb
statement:
@[simp] 
lemma absorb₂ (a b : α) : a ⊓ (a ⊔ b) = a
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊓ (a ⊔ b) = (a ⊔ z) ⊓ (a ⊔ b) := by rw [ident₁]
    _           = a ⊔ (z ⊓ b)       := by rw [distrib₁]
    _           = a ⊔ (b ⊓ z)       := by conv => lhs; rw [commut₂]
    _           = a ⊔ z             := by rw [bound₂]
    _           = a                 := ident₁ a

name: idemp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma idemp₂ (a : α) : a ⊓ a = a
proof:
:= by
  symm
  calc
    a = a ⊓ (a ⊔ z) := Eq.symm (absorb₂ a z)
    _ = a ⊓ a       := by rw [ident₁]

name: inv
statement: lemma inv (a a' : α) : a ⊔ a' = u → a ⊓ a' = z → a' = aᶜ
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  calc
    a' = a' ⊓ u               := Eq.symm (ident₂ a')
    _  = a' ⊓ (a ⊔ aᶜ)        := by rw [compl₁]
    _  = (a' ⊓ a) ⊔ (a' ⊓ aᶜ) := by rw [distrib₂]
    _  = (a' ⊓ a) ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ a') := by conv => left; right; exact commut₂ a' aᶜ
    _  = (a ⊓ a') ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ a') := by conv => left; left; exact commut₂ a' a
    _  = z ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ a')        := by rw [h₂]
    _  = (a ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ a') := by rw [compl₂]
    _  = (aᶜ ⊓ a) ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ a') := by conv => left; left; exact commut₂ a aᶜ
    _  = aᶜ ⊓ (a ⊔ a')        := by rw [distrib₂]
    _  = aᶜ ⊓ u               := by rw [h₁]
    _  = aᶜ                   := ident₂ aᶜ

name: dne
statement: lemma dne (a : α) : aᶜᶜ = a
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply inv
  . rw [commut₁]; exact compl₁ a
  . rw [commut₂]; exact compl₂ a

name: inv_elim
statement: lemma inv_elim (a b : α) : aᶜ = bᶜ → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : aᶜᶜ = bᶜᶜ := congrArg compl h
  simp only [dne] at h'
  trivial

name: cancel
statement: lemma cancel (a b : α) : a ⊔ bᶜ = u → a ⊓ bᶜ = z → a = b
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁ h₂
  have h : bᶜ = aᶜ := by apply inv <;> trivial
  apply inv_elim; symm; trivial

name: A
statement:
@[simp]
lemma A₁ (a b : α) : a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊔ b) = u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊔ b) = (a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊔ b)) ⊓ u := by rw [ident₂]
    _            = u ⊓ (a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊔ b)) := by rw [commut₂]
    _            = (a ⊔ aᶜ) ⊓ (a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊔ b)) := by rw [compl₁]
    _            = a ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ (aᶜ ⊔ b)) := by rw [distrib₁]
    _            = a ⊔ aᶜ := by rw [absorb₂, compl₁]
    _            = u := by rw [compl₁]

name: A
statement:
@[simp]
lemma A₂ (a b : α) : a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ b) = z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ b) = (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ b)) ⊔ z := by rw [ident₁]
    _            = z ⊔ (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ b)) := by rw [commut₁]
    _            = (a ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ b)) := by rw [compl₂]
    _            = a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ b)) := by rw [distrib₂]
    _            = a ⊓ aᶜ := by rw [absorb₁, compl₂]
    _            = z := by rw [compl₂]

name: dm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dm₁ (a b : α) : (a ⊔ b)ᶜ = aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply cancel <;> simp [dne]
  . rw [commut₁, distrib₁]
    conv => left; left; rw [commut₁]; right; left; exact Eq.symm (dne a)
    rw [A₁, commut₂, ident₂, commut₁]
    conv => left; right; rw [commut₁]; left; exact Eq.symm (dne b)
    simp
  . rw [distrib₂]
    conv => left; left; rw [commut₂]
    rw [A₂, commut₁, ident₁]
    rw [commut₂]; conv => left; right; rw [commut₂]
    simp

name: dm
statement:
@[simp]
lemma dm₂ (a b : α) : (a ⊓ b)ᶜ = aᶜ ⊔ bᶜ
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply cancel <;> simp [dne]
  . rw [commut₂, distrib₁]
    conv => left; left; rw [commut₁]; right; rw [commut₁]
    rw [A₁, commut₂, ident₂]
    rw [commut₁]
    rw [A₁]
  . rw [commut₂, distrib₂]
    conv => left; left; rw [commut₂]; right; left; exact Eq.symm (dne a)
    rw [A₂, commut₁, ident₁]
    rw [commut₂]; conv => left; right; rw [commut₂]; left; exact Eq.symm (dne b)
    rw [A₂]

name: D
statement: lemma D₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ aᶜ = u
proof:
:= by
  rw [commut₁]
  conv => left; right; left; exact Eq.symm (dne a)
  simp

name: E
statement: lemma E₁ (a b c : α) : b ⊓ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) = b
proof: := by rw [distrib₂, absorb₂, commut₁, absorb₁]

name: E
statement: lemma E₂ (a b c : α) : b ⊔ (a ⊓ (b ⊓ c)) = b
proof: := by rw [distrib₁, absorb₁, commut₂, absorb₂]

name: F
statement: lemma F₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ bᶜ = u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ bᶜ = bᶜ ⊔ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) := by rw [commut₁]
    _                  = u ⊓ (bᶜ ⊔ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c))) := by rw [commut₂]; simp
    _                  = (b ⊔ bᶜ) ⊓ (bᶜ ⊔ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c))) := by simp
    _                  = (bᶜ ⊔ b) ⊓ (bᶜ ⊔ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c))) := by rw [commut₁]
    _                  = bᶜ ⊔ (b ⊓ (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c))) := by rw [distrib₁]
    _                  = bᶜ ⊔ b := by rw [E₁]
    _                  = u := by rw [commut₁]; simp

name: G
statement: lemma G₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ cᶜ = u
proof:
:= by
  conv => left; left; right; rw [commut₁]
  apply F₁

name: H
statement: lemma H₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ a = z
proof:
:= by
  simp; rw [commut₂]
  calc
    a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ) = (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ)) ⊔ z := by rw [ident₁]
    _                  = z ⊔ (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ)) := by rw [commut₁]
    _                  = (a ⊓ aᶜ) ⊔ (a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ)) := by rw [compl₂]
    _                  = a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ)) := by rw [distrib₂]
    _                  = a ⊓ (aᶜ ⊔ (cᶜ ⊓ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ))) := by conv => left; right; right; rw [commut₂]
    _                  = a ⊓ aᶜ := by rw [E₂]
    _                  = z := by rw [compl₂]

name: I
statement: lemma I₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ b = z
proof:
:= by
  conv => left; left; arg 1; left; rw [commut₁]
  exact H₁ ..

name: J
statement: lemma J₁ (a b c : α) : (a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ c = z
proof:
:= by
  simp
  rw [commut₂]
  conv => left; right; rw [commut₂]
  simp

name: assoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc₁ (a b c : α) : a ⊔ (b ⊔ c) = (a ⊔ b) ⊔ c
proof:
:= by
  apply cancel; simp
  . calc
      (a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ ⊓ cᶜ) = ((a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ (aᶜ ⊓ bᶜ)) ⊓ ((a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ cᶜ) :=
        by rw [distrib₁]
      _ = ((a ⊔ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ aᶜ) ⊓ ((a ⊔ (b ⊔ c) ⊔ bᶜ))) ⊓ ((a ⊔ (b ⊔ c)) ⊔ cᶜ) := by rw [distrib₁]
      _ = (u ⊓ u) ⊓ u := by rw [D₁, F₁, G₁]
      _ = u := by simp
  . rw [commut₂]
    rw [distrib₂]; rw [distrib₂]
    calc
      (a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ a ⊔ ((a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ b ⊔ (a ⊔ b ⊔ c)ᶜ ⊓ c) = z ⊔ (z ⊔ z) :=
        by rw [H₁, I₁, J₁]
      _ = z := by repeat rw [ident₁]

name: assoc
statement:
@[simp]
lemma assoc₂ (a b c : α) : a ⊓ (b ⊓ c) = (a ⊓ b) ⊓ c
proof:
:= by
  apply inv_elim
  simp

name: shefferLE_iff
statement: theorem shefferLE_iff (a b : α) : a ≤ b ↔ a = b ⊓ a
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Sheffer.le_refl
statement: lemma Sheffer.le_refl (a : α) : a ≤ a
proof: := by simp [shefferLE_iff]

name: Sheffer.le_trans
statement: lemma Sheffer.le_trans (a b c : α) : a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShefferLE]
  intro h₁ h₂
  calc
    a = b ⊓ a       := h₁
    _ = (c ⊓ b) ⊓ a := by conv => lhs; rw [h₂]
    _ = c ⊓ (b ⊓ a) := Eq.symm (assoc₂ c b a)
    _ = c ⊓ a       := by rw [← h₁]

name: Sheffer.le_antisymm
statement: lemma Sheffer.le_antisymm (a b : α) : a ≤ b → b ≤ a → a = b
proof:
:= by
  simp [shefferLE_iff]
  intro h₁ h₂
  calc
    a = b ⊓ a := h₁
    _ = a ⊓ b := commut₂ ..
    _ = b     := id (Eq.symm h₂)

name: FreeMagma.orderLtSubst
statement:
theorem FreeMagma.orderLtSubst {α} (t : FreeMagma α) (σ : α → FreeMagma α) :
  FreeMagma.order t ≤ FreeMagma.order (t ⬝ σ)
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | Leaf _ => simp
  | Fork t u ht hu =>
      rw [order]
      exact add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add ht hu)  NeZero.one_le

name: derive.PreservesOrder
statement:
theorem derive.PreservesOrder {α} (Γ : Ctx α) (n : Nat) (sizeBound : Ctx.IsOfOrder Γ n)
    (E : MagmaLaw α) (h : Γ ⊢ E) :
    E.lhs = E.rhs ∨ n ≤ MagmaLaw.order E
proof:
:= by
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left, ← ne_eq]
  intro h2
  induction h with
  | Ax h => exact sizeBound _ h
  | Ref => simp at h2
  | Sym _ ih => simpa [MagmaLaw.order, min_comm] using ih h2.symm
  | @Trans t u v _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    simp at ih₁ ih₂ h2 ⊢
    by_cases h : t = u
    · subst h
      exact ih₂ h2
    by_cases h3 : u = v
    · subst h3
      exact ih₁ h2
    exact ⟨ih₁ h |>.1, ih₂ h3 |>.2⟩
  | @Subst t u σ _ ih =>
    simp at ih h2 ⊢
    specialize ih (by rintro rfl; contradiction)
    exact ⟨ih.1.trans <| t.orderLtSubst σ, ih.2.trans <| u.orderLtSubst σ⟩
  | @Cong t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    simp at ih₁ ih₂ h2 ⊢
    by_cases h : t₁ = t₂ <;> [specialize ih₂ (h2 h); specialize ih₁ h] <;> omega

name: models.PreservesOrder
statement:
theorem models.PreservesOrder {α} (Γ : Ctx α) (n : Nat)
    (sizeBound : Ctx.IsOfOrder Γ n) (E : MagmaLaw α) (h : Γ ⊧ E) :
    E.lhs = E.rhs ∨ n ≤ MagmaLaw.order E
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨h⟩ := Completeness h
  apply derive.PreservesOrder <;> trivial

name: comp1_2
statement:
theorem comp1_2 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ y) ⋆ (x ⋆ (x ⋆ z))) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply rules.eq3
  · apply rules.eq1
  · apply rules.eq1
  · apply rules.eq3
  · apply rules.eq1

name: comp1_3
statement:
theorem comp1_3 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ y) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ (x ⋆ z))) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ (x ⋆ z)) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply comp1_2

name: comp4_2
statement:
theorem comp4_2 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ z) ⋆ (x ⋆ y ⋆ x)) = x ⋆ y
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ z) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq4

name: comp4_3
statement:
theorem comp4_3 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ z) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ x)) = x ⋆ y
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ x) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  apply comp4_2

name: comp1_4
statement:
theorem comp1_4 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ y) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ rules (x ⋆ z))) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ z) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply comp4_3
  · apply comp1_3
  · apply comp1_3
  · apply comp4_3
  · apply comp1_3

name: comp1_2
statement:
theorem comp1_2 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y ⋆ z) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq1

name: comp3_2
statement:
theorem comp3_2 {x y : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ (x ⋆ x) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ y)) = x ⋆ x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply rules.eq3

name: comp1_3
statement:
theorem comp1_3 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ rules (rules (x ⋆ y) ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply comp3_2
  · apply comp3_2
  · apply comp3_2
  · apply comp3_2
  · apply comp1_2

name: comp1_4
statement:
theorem comp1_4 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (rules (x ⋆ x) ⋆ rules (rules (x ⋆ y) ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ x) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  apply comp1_3

name: comp1_2
statement:
theorem comp1_2 {x y z : FreeMagma α}:
    rules (y ⋆ y ⋆ x ⋆ rules (x ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ z) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply rules.eq3
  · apply rules.eq1
  · apply rules.eq3
  · apply rules.eq1
  · apply rules.eq1

name: comp2_2
statement:
theorem comp2_2 {x y z : FreeMagma α} (hxxy: NF rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ y)):
    rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ y ⋆ z)) = x ⋆ x ⋆ y
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ y ⋆ z) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply hxxy.top
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply hxxy.top
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq2

name: comp4_2
statement:
theorem comp4_2 {x y z w : FreeMagma α} (hxxyz: NF rules (x ⋆ x ⋆ y ⋆ z)):
    rules (((x ⋆ x) ⋆ y) ⋆ rules ((((x ⋆ x) ⋆ y) ⋆ z) ⋆ w)) = (((x ⋆ x) ⋆ y) ⋆ z)
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules ((((x ⋆ x) ⋆ y) ⋆ z) ⋆ w) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply hxxyz.top
  · apply rules.eq4
  · apply hxxyz.top
  · apply rules.eq2
  · apply rules.eq4

name: comp1_3
statement:
theorem comp1_3 {x y z : FreeMagma α} (hx: NF rules x):
    rules (rules (y ⋆ y ⋆ x) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (y ⋆ y ⋆ x) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  · apply comp2_2 hx
  · apply comp4_2 hx
  · apply comp1_2
  · apply comp4_2 hx
  · apply comp1_2

name: comp1_4
statement:
theorem comp1_4 {x y z : FreeMagma α} (hx: NF rules x):
    rules (rules (rules (y ⋆ y) ⋆ x) ⋆ rules (x ⋆ z)) = x
proof:
:= by
  generalize h: rules (y ⋆ y) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  all_goals apply comp1_3 hx

name: Everywhere.top
statement:
theorem Everywhere.top {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} : {x : FreeMagma α} → Everywhere P x → P x
  | .Leaf _ => fun h => h
  | _ ⋆ _ => fun h => h.2.2

name: Everywhere.left
statement: theorem Everywhere.left {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} {x y : FreeMagma α} (h: Everywhere P (x ⋆ y)): Everywhere P x

name: Everywhere.right
statement: theorem Everywhere.right {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} {x y : FreeMagma α} (h: Everywhere P (x ⋆ y)): Everywhere P y

name: Everywhere_idem
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Everywhere_idem {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} : Everywhere (Everywhere P) = Everywhere P
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor <;> intro h
  · induction x with
    | Leaf => exact h
    | Fork x y ihx ihy => exact ⟨ihx h.1, ihy h.2.1,  h.2.2.2.2⟩
  · induction x with
    | Leaf => exact h
    | Fork x y ihx ihy => exact ⟨ihx h.1, ihy h.2.1, h⟩

name: SubtermOf.refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem SubtermOf.refl (x : FreeMagma α) : SubtermOf x x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | Leaf => rfl
  | Fork x y => exact Or.inl rfl

name: SubtermOf.left
statement: lemma SubtermOf.left {x a b: FreeMagma α} (h : SubtermOf x a) : SubtermOf x (a ⋆ b)
proof:
:=
  Or.inr (Or.inl h)

name: SubtermOf.right
statement: lemma SubtermOf.right {x a b: FreeMagma α} (h : SubtermOf x b) : SubtermOf x (a ⋆ b)
proof:
:=
  Or.inr (Or.inr h)

name: everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere
statement:
theorem everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} {x} (h : x.Everywhere P) {y}
    (hsub : SubtermOf y x) : y.Everywhere P
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | Leaf =>
    cases hsub
    exact h.top
  | Fork x y ihx ihy =>
    obtain (rfl | hsub | hsub) := hsub
    · exact h
    · exact ihx h.1 hsub
    · exact ihy h.2.1 hsub

name: subterm_everywhere
statement: theorem subterm_everywhere {P : FreeMagma α → Prop} {x} (h : x.Everywhere P) {y} (hsub : SubtermOf y x) : P y
proof:
:=
  (everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere h hsub).top

name: length_le_of_subterm
statement: theorem length_le_of_subterm {x y: FreeMagma α} (h: SubtermOf x y) : x.length ≤ y.length
proof:
:= by
  induction y with
  | Leaf =>
    rw [h]
  | Fork x y ihx ihy =>
    obtain (heq | hsub | hsub) := h
    · rw [heq]
    · rw [FreeMagma.length.eq_2]
      exact Nat.le_add_right_of_le (ihx hsub)
    · rw [FreeMagma.length.eq_2, Nat.add_comm]
      exact Nat.le_add_right_of_le (ihy hsub)

name: projection_leaf
statement:
@[simp]
lemma projection_leaf (x): rw (.Leaf x) = x
proof:
:=
  hproj.proj (.Leaf x)

name: length_le_of_projection
statement: lemma length_le_of_projection (x): (rw x).length ≤ x.length
proof:
:=
  length_le_of_subterm (hproj.proj x)

name: everywhere_of_projection_of_everywhere
statement:
theorem everywhere_of_projection_of_everywhere P:
    ∀ x, Everywhere P x → (rw x).Everywhere P
proof:
:=
  fun x he ↦ everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere he (IsProj.proj x)

name: projection_everywhere
statement:
theorem projection_everywhere P :
    ∀ x, Everywhere P x → P (rw x)
proof:
:=
  fun x he ↦ subterm_everywhere he (IsProj.proj x)

name: bu_op_eq_rw_op
statement:
@[simp] theorem bu_op_eq_rw_op {x} {y}
    (hx: buFixed rw x) (hy: buFixed rw y): bu rw (x ⋆ y) = rw (x ⋆ y)
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← hx, ← hy]
  rw [← bu.eq_2 rw]

name: length_bu_le
statement: lemma length_bu_le [hproj : IsProj rw] (x): (bu rw x).length ≤ x.length
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | Leaf =>
    simp
  | Fork x y ihx ihy  =>
    rw [bu.eq_2]
    apply Nat.le_trans (length_le_of_projection rw _) ?_
    simp only [FreeMagma.length.eq_2]
    exact Nat.add_le_add ihx ihy

name: buNF_iff_NF
statement: lemma buNF_iff_NF {x}: buNF rw x ↔ NF rw x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | Leaf =>
    unfold NF buNF Everywhere
    simp
  | Fork x y ihx ihy =>
    have ih  := and_congr ihx ihy
    unfold NF buNF at ih ⊢
    unfold Everywhere
    simp only [← and_assoc, ← ih]
    apply and_congr_right
    intro ⟨hbx, hby⟩
    simp only [bu, hbx.top, hby.top]

name: buFixed_of_NF
statement: lemma buFixed_of_NF {x : FreeMagma α} (h : NF rw x) : buFixed rw x
proof:
:=
  ((buNF_iff_NF rw).mpr h).top

name: rw_eq_self_of_NF
statement: lemma rw_eq_self_of_NF {x} (h: NF rw x): rw x = x
proof:
:=
  h.top

name: bu_nf
statement: theorem bu_nf : ∀ x, NF rw (bu rw x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  induction x with
  | Leaf a =>
    simp only [NF, bu, Everywhere]
    obtain (hsub | hnf) := hproj.proj_or_nf (a)
    · unfold SubtermOf at hsub
      unfold Everywhere
      simp [hsub]
    · exact hnf
  | Fork x y ihx ihy =>
    simp only [NF, bu]
    obtain ((heq | hsub | hsub) | hnf) := hproj.proj_or_nf (bu rw x ⋆ bu rw y)
    · simp only [Everywhere, heq, and_true]
      exact ⟨ihx, ihy⟩
    · exact everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere ihx hsub
    · exact everywhere_of_subterm_of_everywhere ihy hsub
    · exact hnf

name: NF_iff_buFixed
statement: lemma NF_iff_buFixed {x}: NF rw x ↔ buFixed rw x
proof: := ⟨buFixed_of_NF rw, fun h ↦ h ▸ bu_nf _ _⟩

name: bu_idem
statement: @[simp] theorem bu_idem x : buFixed rw (bu rw x)
proof: := buFixed_of_NF rw (bu_nf rw x)

name: buFixed_rw_op
statement:
@[simp] theorem buFixed_rw_op {x} {y}
    (hx: bu rw x = x) (hy: bu rw y = y): buFixed rw (rw (x ⋆ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hx, ← hy, ← bu.eq_2 rw]
  exact bu_idem rw _

name: NF_rw_op_of_buFixed
statement:
theorem NF_rw_op_of_buFixed {x} {y}
    (hx: bu rw x = x) (hy: bu rw y = y): NF rw (rw (x ⋆ y))
proof:
:=
  (NF_iff_buFixed rw).mpr (buFixed_rw_op rw hx hy)

name: NF_rw_op
statement:
theorem NF_rw_op {x} {y}
    (hx: NF rw x) (hy: NF rw y): NF rw (rw (x ⋆ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [NF_iff_buFixed] at hx hy ⊢
  exact buFixed_rw_op rw hx hy

name: rw_op_idem
statement:
@[simp] theorem rw_op_idem {x} {y}
  (hx: bu rw x = x) (hy: bu rw y = y): rw (rw (x ⋆ y)) = rw (x ⋆ y)
proof:
:= by
  have := buFixed_rw_op rw hx hy
  rw [← NF_iff_buFixed] at this
  exact rw_eq_self_of_NF rw this

name: bu_rw_op_eq_rw_rw_op
statement:
theorem bu_rw_op_eq_rw_rw_op {x} {y}
    (hx: bu rw x = x) (hy: bu rw y = y): bu rw (rw (x ⋆ y)) = rw (rw (x ⋆ y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [buFixed_rw_op rw hx hy, rw_op_idem rw hx hy]

name: FreeMagma.dual_dual
statement:
@[simp]
theorem FreeMagma.dual_dual (w : FreeMagma α) : w.dual.dual = w
proof:
:= by
 induction w <;> simp [dual, *]

name: opMagma_eq_op
statement: theorem opMagma_eq_op (x y : Op G) : x ◇ y = (y ◇ x : G)
proof: := rfl

name: evalInMagmaOp
statement:
theorem evalInMagmaOp (φ : α → G) (w : FreeMagma α):
  evalInMagma (G := Op G) φ w.dual = evalInMagma (G := G) φ w
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | Leaf x => rfl
  | Fork w₁ w₂ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [dual, evalInMagma, opMagma_eq_op, ih₂, ih₁]

name: models.Op
statement:
theorem models.Op {w₁ w₂ : FreeMagma α} (h : G ⊧ w₁ ≃ w₂) :
    (Op G) ⊧ w₁.dual ≃ w₂.dual
proof:
:= by
  intro φ
  simp only [satisfiesPhi, _root_.Op]
  repeat rw [@evalInMagmaOp]
  apply h

name: law_dual_dual
statement: theorem law_dual_dual (l : MagmaLaw α) : l.dual.dual = l
proof: := by simp [dual]

name: dual_symm
statement: theorem dual_symm (l : MagmaLaw α) : l.dual.symm = l.symm.dual
proof: := rfl

name: satisfiesPhi_dual
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_dual {l : MagmaLaw α} {φ : α → G}
  (h : satisfiesPhi (Magma.opHom ∘ φ) l) : satisfiesPhi φ l.dual
proof:
:= by
  simp only [satisfiesPhi, Op, dual] at *
  rw [← evalInMagmaOp φ l.lhs.dual, ← evalInMagmaOp φ l.rhs.dual]
  simp only [Op, dual_dual]
  exact h

name: satisfies_dual_dual
statement: theorem satisfies_dual_dual {l : MagmaLaw α} (h : (Op G) ⊧ l) : G ⊧ l.dual
proof:
:=
  fun φ ↦ satisfiesPhi_dual (h (Magma.opHom ∘ φ))

name: implies_iff_dual
statement: theorem implies_iff_dual {l₁ l₂ : MagmaLaw α} : l₁.implies l₂ ↔ l₁.dual.implies l₂.dual
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h G _ hsat
    exact satisfies_dual_dual (h (law_dual_dual l₁ ▸ satisfies_dual_dual hsat))
  · intro h G _ hsat
    rw [← law_dual_dual l₂]
    rw [← law_dual_dual l₁] at hsat
    exact satisfies_dual_dual (h (law_dual_dual l₁ ▸ satisfies_dual_dual hsat))

name: iff_iff_dual
statement: theorem iff_iff_dual {l₁ l₂ : MagmaLaw α} : l₁.iff l₂ ↔ l₁.dual.iff l₂.dual
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H _ _ => ⟨(implies_iff_dual.1 H.mp ·), (implies_iff_dual.1 H.mpr ·)⟩,
   fun H _ _ => ⟨(implies_iff_dual.2 H.mp ·), (implies_iff_dual.2 H.mpr ·)⟩⟩

name: IsDual.symm
statement: theorem IsDual.symm {Law1 Law2 : MagmaLaw α} (H : IsDual Law1 Law2) : IsDual Law2 Law1
proof:
:=
  (MagmaLaw.law_dual_dual _ ▸ MagmaLaw.iff_iff_dual.1 H :).symm

name: Finite.fn_eventually_periodic
statement:
lemma Finite.fn_eventually_periodic {G : Type*} [Finite G] (f : G → G) :
    ∃ s p : ℕ, p > 0 ∧ f^[s] = f^[s+p]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, lt, heq⟩ : ∃ p₁ p₂ : ℕ, p₁ < p₂ ∧ f^[p₁] = f^[p₂] := by
    obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, ne, heq⟩ := Finite.exists_ne_map_eq_of_infinite (Nat.iterate f ·)
    rcases le_total p₁ p₂ with h_le | h_le
    . exact ⟨p₁, p₂, Ne.lt_of_le ne h_le, heq⟩
    . exact ⟨p₂, p₁, Ne.lt_of_le (Ne.symm ne) h_le, Eq.symm heq⟩
  let p := p₂ - p₁
  have : f^[p₁] = f^[p₁ + p] := by
    unfold p
    rw [← Nat.add_sub_assoc (by linarith), heq, add_tsub_cancel_left]
  exact ⟨p₁, p, by simp only [gt_iff_lt, tsub_pos_iff_lt, lt, p], this⟩

name: Finite.fn_eventually_periodic'
statement:
lemma Finite.fn_eventually_periodic' {G : Type*} [Finite G] (f : G → G) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p > 0 ∧ f^[p] = f^[2*p]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, p, hpgt, hp⟩ := Finite.fn_eventually_periodic f
  have hmod (n j : ℕ) : f^[s + j] = f^[s + j + n*p] := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp only [zero_mul, add_zero]
    | succ i ih =>
      have : s + j + (i + 1) * p = s + p + (j + i * p) := by simp +arith only [Nat.succ_mul]
      rw [this, Function.iterate_add f (s + p), ← hp, ← Function.iterate_add, ← Nat.add_assoc, ih]
  rcases eq_zero_or_pos s with h | h
  . simp only [h, zero_add] at hmod
    have : f^[p] = f^[2*p] := by simp +arith only [hmod 1 p]
    exact ⟨p, hpgt, this⟩
  . let n := s * p
    have : f^[n] = f^[2*n] := by
      show f^[s * p] = f^[2 * (s * p)]
      have hle : s ≤ s * p := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right s hpgt
      have key := hmod s (s * p - s)
      rw [show s + (s * p - s) = s * p from by omega] at key
      rw [show s * p + s * p = 2 * (s * p) from by omega] at key
      exact key
    have ngt : n > 0 := by apply Nat.mul_pos h hpgt
    exact ⟨n, ngt, this⟩

name: Finite.fn_mutually_eventually_periodic
statement:
lemma Finite.fn_mutually_eventually_periodic {G : Type*} [Finite G] (f g : G → G) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, p > 0 ∧ f^[p] = f^[2*p] ∧ g^[p] = g^[2*p]
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, hpgt₁, hp₁⟩ := Finite.fn_eventually_periodic' f
  obtain ⟨p₂, hpgt₂, hp₂⟩ := Finite.fn_eventually_periodic' g
  let p := p₁ * p₂
  have hpgt : p > 0 := by simp only [gt_iff_lt, mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left, p, hpgt₁, hpgt₂]
  have periodic_dvd' {f : G → G} (p n : ℕ) (hperiod : f^[p] = f^[2*p]) : f^[p + p*n] = f^[p] := by
    induction n with
    | zero => simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Nat.mul_add, ← Nat.add_assoc, Function.iterate_add, ih, ← Function.iterate_add]
      simp +arith only [mul_one, hperiod]
  have periodic_dvd {f : G → G} (p n : ℕ) (hperiod : f^[p] = f^[2*p]) (hngt : n > 0) :
      f^[n*p] = f^[p] := by
    obtain ⟨np, hnp⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero n (by linarith)
    rw [hnp, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm, periodic_dvd' _ _ hperiod]
  have fperiodic : f^[p] = f^[2*p] := by
    unfold p
    rw [Nat.mul_comm, periodic_dvd p₁ _ hp₁ hpgt₂]
    symm
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, periodic_dvd p₁ _ hp₁ (by linarith)]
  have gperiodic : g^[p] = g^[2*p] := by
    unfold p
    rw [periodic_dvd p₂ _ hp₂ hpgt₁]
    symm
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, periodic_dvd p₂ _ hp₂ (by linarith)]
  exact ⟨p, hpgt, fperiodic, gperiodic⟩

name: Finite.f_ffg_implies_f_fgf
statement:
lemma Finite.f_ffg_implies_f_fgf {G: Type*} [Finite G] (f g : G -> G) (h : f = f ∘ f ∘ g) :
    f = f ∘ g ∘ f
proof:
:= by
  have periodic : ∃ p : ℕ, p > 1 ∧ f^[p] = f := by
    obtain ⟨s, p, hpgt, hperiodic⟩ := Finite.fn_eventually_periodic f
    let S : Set ℕ := { n | f^[n] = f^[n+p] }
    have S_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      use s
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, S, hperiodic]
    classical
    set n : ℕ := Nat.find S_nonempty with hn
    have n_mem : f^[n] = f^[n + p] := Nat.find_spec S_nonempty
    have n_min : ∀ k ∈ S, ¬k < n := fun k hk hlt => Nat.find_min S_nonempty hlt hk
    have : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra nh
      simp at nh
      
      have : f^[n - 1] = f^[n + p - 1] := by
        obtain ⟨pred, hpred⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero n (by linarith)
        obtain ⟨pred2, hpred2⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero pred (by linarith)
        simp only [hpred, hpred2, add_tsub_cancel_right, Nat.succ_add_sub_one]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ, Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc, Function.iterate_succ]
        nth_rewrite 4 [h]
        nth_rewrite 2 [h]
        change ((f^[pred2] ∘ f) ∘ f) ∘ g = ((f^[p + pred2] ∘ f) ∘ f) ∘ g
        rw [← Function.iterate_succ, ← Function.iterate_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hpred2, ← hpred]
        rw [← Function.iterate_succ, ← Function.iterate_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc p,
          ← hpred2, Nat.add_assoc p, ← hpred]
        simp only [n_mem, Nat.add_comm]
      have : f^[n - 1] ≠ f^[n + p-1] := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_comm (by linarith)]
        by_contra nh2
        have t1 : n - 1 ∈ S := by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, nh2, S]
        have t2 : n - 1 < n := by omega
        apply n_min (n - 1) t1 t2
      tauto
    have : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with h | h
    . simp only [h, Function.iterate_zero, zero_add] at n_mem
      use p+1
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, lt_add_iff_pos_left, hpgt, Function.iterate_succ, ← n_mem,
        Function.id_comp, and_self]
    . simp only [h, Function.iterate_one] at n_mem
      use p+1
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, lt_add_iff_pos_left, hpgt, Function.iterate_succ, true_and]
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_comm, ← n_mem]
  obtain ⟨p, pgt, hp⟩ := periodic
  nth_rewrite 1 [← hp]
  obtain ⟨ppred, hppred⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero p (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨ppred2, hppred2⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero ppred (by linarith)
  rw [hppred, hppred2, Function.iterate_succ, Function.iterate_succ]
  nth_rewrite 2 [h]
  change ((f^[ppred2] ∘ f) ∘ f) ∘ g ∘ f = f ∘ g ∘ f
  rw [← Function.iterate_succ, ← Function.iterate_succ, ← hppred2, ← hppred, hp]

name: Finite.f_gff_implies_f_fgf
statement:
lemma Finite.f_gff_implies_f_fgf {G: Type*} [Finite G] (f g : G -> G) (h : f = g ∘ f ∘ f) :
    f = f ∘ g ∘ f
proof:
:= by
  have periodic : ∃ p : ℕ, p > 1 ∧ f^[p] = f := by
    obtain ⟨s, p, hpgt, hperiodic⟩ := Finite.fn_eventually_periodic f
    let S : Set ℕ := { n | f^[n] = f^[n+p] }
    have S_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      use s
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, S, hperiodic]
    classical
    set n : ℕ := Nat.find S_nonempty with hn
    have n_mem : f^[n] = f^[n + p] := Nat.find_spec S_nonempty
    have n_min : ∀ k ∈ S, ¬k < n := fun k hk hlt => Nat.find_min S_nonempty hlt hk
    have : n ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra nh
      simp at nh
      
      have : f^[n - 1] = f^[n + p - 1] := by
        obtain ⟨pred, hpred⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero n (by linarith)
        obtain ⟨pred2, hpred2⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_add_one_of_ne_zero pred (by linarith)
        simp only [hpred, hpred2, add_tsub_cancel_right, Nat.succ_add_sub_one]
        rw [Function.iterate_succ', Nat.add_comm, ← Nat.add_assoc, Function.iterate_succ']
        nth_rewrite 3 [h]
        nth_rewrite 1 [h]
        change g ∘ (f ∘ (f ∘ f^[pred2])) = g ∘ (f ∘ (f ∘ f^[p + pred2]))
        rw [← Function.iterate_succ', ← Function.iterate_succ', Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hpred2, ← hpred]
        rw [← Function.iterate_succ', ← Function.iterate_succ', Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc p,
          ← hpred2, Nat.add_assoc p, ← hpred]
        simp only [n_mem, Nat.add_comm]
      have : f^[n - 1] ≠ f^[n + p-1] := by
        rw [Nat.sub_add_comm (by linarith)]
        by_contra nh2
        have t1 : n - 1 ∈ S := by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, nh2, S]
        have t2 : n - 1 < n := by omega
        apply n_min (n - 1) t1 t2
      tauto
    have : n = 0 ∨ n = 1 := by omega
    rcases this with h | h
    . simp only [h, Function.iterate_zero, zero_add] at n_mem
      use p+1
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, lt_add_iff_pos_left, hpgt, Function.iterate_succ, ← n_mem,
        Function.id_comp, and_self]
    . simp only [h, Function.iterate_one] at n_mem
      use p+1
      simp only [gt_iff_lt, lt_add_iff_pos_left, hpgt, Function.iterate_succ, true_and]
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_comm, ← n_mem]
  obtain ⟨p, pgt, hp⟩ := periodic
  nth_rewrite 1 [← hp]
  obtain ⟨ppred, hppred⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero p (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨ppred2, hppred2⟩ := @Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero ppred (by linarith)
  rw [hppred, hppred2, Function.iterate_succ', Function.iterate_succ']
  nth_rewrite 2 [h]
  change f ∘ g ∘ (f ∘ (f ∘ f^[ppred2])) = f ∘ g ∘ f
  rw [← Function.iterate_succ', ← Function.iterate_succ', ← hppred2, ← hppred, hp]

name: Finite.Equation3308_implies_Equation3511
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Finite.Equation3308_implies_Equation3511 (G : Type*) [Magma G] [Finite G]
    (h : Equation3308 G) : Equation3511 G
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let f := (x ◇ ·)
  let g := (· ◇ x)
  change f y = (f ∘ g ∘ f) y
  rw [← Finite.f_ffg_implies_f_fgf f g]
  funext x
  apply h

name: Finite.Equation3549_implies_Equation3955
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Finite.Equation3549_implies_Equation3955 (G : Type*) [Magma G] [Finite G]
    (h : Equation3549 G) : Equation3955 G
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let f := (· ◇ y)
  let g := (y ◇ ·)
  change f x = (f ∘ g ∘ f) x
  rw [← Finite.f_gff_implies_f_fgf f g]
  funext x
  apply h

name: symm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm {α} (l : MagmaLaw α) : l.symm.symm = l
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: map_id
statement: theorem map_id {α} (m : MagmaLaw α) : m.map id = m
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, fmapHom_id]

name: map_comp
statement:
theorem map_comp {α β γ} (f : α → β) (g : β → γ) (m : MagmaLaw α) :
    (m.map f).map g = m.map (g ∘ f)
proof:
:= by
  simp [map, fmapHom_comp']

name: map_symm
statement: theorem map_symm {α β} (f : α → β) (m : MagmaLaw α) : m.symm.map f = (m.map f).symm
proof: := rfl

name: attach_map_val
statement: theorem attach_map_val {α} (m : MagmaLaw α) : m.attach.map (·.val) = m
proof:
:= by
  apply congrArg₂ MagmaLaw.mk <;> exact (evalInMagma_pmap _ (by simp)).trans (fmapHom_id _)

name: pmap_eq_map
statement:
theorem pmap_eq_map {α β} (m : MagmaLaw α)
    (f : (a : α) → Mem a m → β) (g : α → β) (h : ∀ a h, f a h = g a) :
    m.pmap f = m.map g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [pmap, map, mk.injEq]; constructor <;> exact FreeMagma.pmap_eq_map _ _ _ fun _ _ ↦ h _ _

name: satisfiesPhi_symm_law
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_symm_law {α G} [Magma G] (φ : α → G) (E : MagmaLaw α)
    (h : satisfiesPhi φ E) : satisfiesPhi φ E.symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [satisfiesPhi, MagmaLaw.symm]; exact h.symm

name: satisfiesPhi_map
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_map {α β G} [Magma G] {φ : β → G} {f : α → β} {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    satisfiesPhi φ (E.map f) ↔ satisfiesPhi (φ ∘ f) E
proof:
:= by
  simp [satisfiesPhi, MagmaLaw.map, evalInMagma_fmapHom]

name: satisfiesPhi_pmap
proof:
:= by
  simp only [satisfiesPhi, MagmaLaw.pmap]
  rw [evalInMagma_pmap _ fun a h => H a (.inl h), evalInMagma_pmap _ fun a h => H a (.inr h)]

name: satisfiesPhi_pmap_mk
proof:
:=
  satisfiesPhi_pmap _ _ (fun _ _ ↦ rfl)

name: satisfiesPhi_attach
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_attach {α G} [Magma G] {φ : α → G} {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    satisfiesPhi (φ ·.1) E.attach ↔ satisfiesPhi φ E
proof: := satisfiesPhi_pmap_mk ..

name: satisfiesPhi_symm
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_symm {α G} [Magma G] (φ : α → G) (w₁ w₂ : FreeMagma α)
    (h : satisfiesPhi φ (w₁ ≃ w₂)) : satisfiesPhi φ (w₂ ≃ w₁)
proof:
:=
  satisfiesPhi_symm_law φ (w₁ ≃ w₂) h

name: satisfiesPhi_evalHom
statement:
theorem satisfiesPhi_evalHom {α G : Type} [Magma G] (φ : α → G) (E : MagmaLaw α) (f : G →◇ G) :
    satisfiesPhi (f ∘ φ) E ↔ f (E.lhs ⬝ φ) = f (E.rhs ⬝ φ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [satisfiesPhi, ← @evalInMagma_hom, ← evalInMagma_hom]

name: equiv_satisfiesPhi
statement:
theorem equiv_satisfiesPhi {α G H} [Magma G] [Magma H] {φ : α → G} (e : G ≃◇ H) {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    satisfiesPhi (e ∘ φ) E ↔ satisfiesPhi φ E
proof:
:= by
  simp [satisfiesPhi, ← evalInMagma_equiv]

name: satisfies_symm_law
statement:
theorem satisfies_symm_law {α G} [Magma G] {E : MagmaLaw α} (h : G ⊧ E) :
    G ⊧ E.symm
proof:
:=
  fun φ ↦ satisfiesPhi_symm_law φ E (h φ)

name: satisfies_map
statement:
theorem satisfies_map {α β G} [Magma G] (f : α → β) {E : MagmaLaw α} (h : G ⊧ E) :
    G ⊧ E.map f
proof: := fun _ ↦ satisfiesPhi_map.2 (h _)

name: satisfies_map_injective
statement:
theorem satisfies_map_injective {α β G} [Magma G] (f : α → β) (hf : f.Injective) {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E.map f ↔ G ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H φ => ?_, satisfies_map _⟩
  have : Inhabited α := ⟨E.lhs.first⟩
  have ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf.hasLeftInverse
  rw [← MagmaLaw.map_id E, ← show g ∘ f = id from funext hg, ← MagmaLaw.map_comp, satisfiesPhi_map]
  exact H _

name: satisfies_map_equiv
statement:
theorem satisfies_map_equiv {α β G} [Magma G] (f : α ≃ β) {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E.map f ↔ G ⊧ E
proof:
:=
  satisfies_map_injective _ f.injective

name: satisfies_pmap_mk
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h φ => (satisfiesPhi_pmap_mk _ _).1 (h _), fun h φ => ?_⟩
  have : Inhabited G := ⟨φ ⟨E.lhs.first, hp _ <| .inl E.lhs.first_mem⟩⟩
  let ψ a := if h : E.Mem a then φ ⟨a, hp _ h⟩ else default
  exact (satisfiesPhi_pmap (ψ := ψ) _ _ (fun a h => by simp [ψ, h])).2 (h _)

name: satisfies_attach
statement:
theorem satisfies_attach {α G} [DecidableEq α] [Magma G] {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E.attach ↔ G ⊧ E
proof: := satisfies_pmap_mk ..

name: satisfies_toFin
statement:
theorem satisfies_toFin {α G} [DecidableEq α] [Magma G] {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E.toFin ↔ G ⊧ E
proof:
:=
  (satisfies_map_equiv _).trans satisfies_attach

name: satisfies_toNat
statement:
theorem satisfies_toNat {α G} [DecidableEq α] [Magma G] {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E.toNat ↔ G ⊧ E
proof:
:=
  (satisfies_map_injective _ Fin.val_injective).trans satisfies_toFin

name: satisfies_symm
statement:
theorem satisfies_symm {α G} [Magma G] {w₁ w₂ : FreeMagma α} (h : G ⊧ w₁ ≃ w₂) :
    G ⊧ w₂ ≃ w₁
proof:
:=
  satisfies_symm_law h

name: satisfies_equiv
statement:
theorem satisfies_equiv {α G H} [Magma G] [Magma H] (e : G ≃◇ H) {E : MagmaLaw α} :
    G ⊧ E ↔ H ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h φ
  · rw [← equiv_satisfiesPhi e.symm]; exact h _
  · rw [← equiv_satisfiesPhi e]; exact h _

name: satisfiesSet_symm
statement:
theorem satisfiesSet_symm {α G} [Magma G] {Γ : Ctx α}
  (h :  G ⊧ Γ) : G ⊧ (·.symm) '' Γ
proof:
:=
  fun _ ⟨_, ⟨hEsymm, hEsymmE⟩⟩ ↦ hEsymmE ▸ Law.satisfies_symm (h _ hEsymm)

name: satisfiesSet_singleton
statement: theorem satisfiesSet_singleton {α G} [Magma G] {E : MagmaLaw α} : G ⊧ {E} ↔ G ⊧ E

name: satisfiesSet_equiv

proof:
:=
  forall_congr' fun _ => forall_congr' fun _ => satisfies_equiv e

name: satisfiesSet_toNat

proof:
:=
  ⟨fun H _ h => satisfies_toNat.1 (H _ ⟨_, h, rfl⟩),
   fun | H, _, ⟨_, h, rfl⟩ => satisfies_toNat.2 (H _ h)⟩

proof:

name: derive'_map_injective
statement:
theorem derive'_map_injective {α β γ} {f : β → γ} (hf : f.Injective) {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E.map f) ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ?_, fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨derive'_map h⟩⟩
  have : Inhabited β := ⟨E.lhs.first⟩
  have ⟨g, hg⟩ := hf.hasLeftInverse
  rw [← MagmaLaw.map_id E, ← show g ∘ f = id from funext hg, ← MagmaLaw.map_comp]
  exact ⟨derive'_map h⟩

name: derive'_attach_iff
statement:
theorem derive'_attach_iff {α β} [DecidableEq β] {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E.attach) ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨(MagmaLaw.attach_map_val _ ▸ derive'_map h :)⟩, fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨derive'_attach h⟩⟩

name: derive'_toFin_iff
statement:
theorem derive'_toFin_iff {α β} [DecidableEq β] {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E.toFin) ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:=
  (derive'_map_injective (Equiv.injective _)).trans derive'_attach_iff

name: derive'_toNat_iff
statement:
theorem derive'_toNat_iff {α β} [DecidableEq β] {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E.toNat) ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:=
  (derive'_map_injective Fin.val_injective).trans derive'_toFin_iff

name: satisfies_fin_satisfies_nat

proof:

  satisfies_map_injective _ Fin.val_injective

name: comp1_2

name: MagmaLaw.models_iff_satisfies_
statement:
theorem MagmaLaw.models_iff_satisfies_ι (law : MagmaLaw α) :
    G α ⊧ law ↔ satisfiesPhi (G := G α) LiftingMagmaFamily.ι law
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h _, fun h f ↦ by rw [LiftingMagmaFamily.lift_factors f, satisfiesPhi_evalHom, h]⟩

name: LiftingMagmaFamily.establishNonimplication
statement:
lemma LiftingMagmaFamily.establishNonimplication {law law' : MagmaLaw Nat} {P P' : (M : Type _) → [Magma M] → Prop}
  (hlaw_iff : ∀ {G} [Magma G], G ⊧ law ↔ P G) (hlaw'_iff : ∀ {G} [Magma G], G ⊧ law' ↔ P' G)
  (h : G ℕ ⊧ law := by decide) (h' : ¬ G ℕ ⊧ law' := by decide) :
    ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), P G ∧ ¬ P' G
proof:
:=
  ⟨G ℕ, inferInstance, hlaw_iff.mp h, (not_iff_not.mpr hlaw'_iff).mp h'⟩

name: FreeMagma.vars_leaf

name: FreeMagma.count_vars
statement:
lemma FreeMagma.count_vars {w : FreeMagma α} {a : α} :
    w.vars.count a = w.count a
proof:
:= by
  induction w with
  | Leaf _ => simp [Multiset.count_singleton]
  | Fork _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => simp [ih₁, ih₂]

name: FreeMagma.count_subst'
statement:
lemma FreeMagma.count_subst' {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {t : FreeMagma ι} {σ : ι → FreeMagma α}
    {a : α} {s : Finset ι} (hs : t.vars ⊆ s.1) : (t ⬝ σ).count a = ∑ i ∈ s, t.count i * (σ i).count a
proof:
:= by
  induction t with
  | Leaf b =>
    rw [vars_leaf, Multiset.singleton_subset, Finset.mem_val] at hs
    simp [evalInMagma, hs]
  | Fork a b iha ihb =>
    rw [vars_fork] at hs
    simp [evalInMagma, iha (Multiset.Subset.trans Multiset.subset_add_left hs),
      ihb (Multiset.Subset.trans Multiset.subset_add_right hs),
        Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_mul]

name: FreeMagma.count_subst
statement:
lemma FreeMagma.count_subst {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] {t : FreeMagma ι} {σ : ι → FreeMagma α}
    {a : α} : (t ⬝ σ).count a = ∑ i ∈ t.vars.toFinset, t.count i * (σ i).count a
proof:
:=
  t.count_subst' (s := t.vars.toFinset) (hs := by simp)

name: Law.MagmaLaw.SameCount.vars_eq
statement:
lemma Law.MagmaLaw.SameCount.vars_eq {α} [DecidableEq α] {E : MagmaLaw α} (h : E.SameCount) :
    E.lhs.vars = E.rhs.vars
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp_rw [FreeMagma.count_vars, h a]

name: Law.MagmaLaw.SameCount.derive
statement:
theorem Law.MagmaLaw.SameCount.derive {α} [DecidableEq α] {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw α}
  (hE : Γ ⊢ E) (hΓ : ∀ E ∈ Γ, E.SameCount) : E.SameCount
proof:
:= by
  induction hE with
  | Ax h => exact hΓ _ h
  | Ref => intro a; rfl
  | Sym _ ih => intro a; symm; exact ih a
  | Trans _ _ ihu ihv => intro a; exact ihu a |>.trans <| ihv a
  | Subst σ _ ih => intro a; simp [FreeMagma.count_subst, ih _, ih.vars_eq]
  | Cong _ _ ih₁ ih₂ => intro a; simp_rw [FreeMagma.count, ih₁ a, ih₂ a]

proof:

  generalize h: rules (x ⋆ y) = e
  simp only [rules.elim] at h
  separate
  all_goals apply comp2

  · rw [NF, Everywhere]
    refine ⟨hx, hy, ?_⟩
    simp only [rules.elim]
    right
    constructorm* _ ∧ _

name: order_leaf
statement:
@[simp]
lemma order_leaf (a : X) : (Lf a).order = 0
proof: := rfl

name: order_fork

proof: := rfl

name: elementsOfNumNodesEq_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem elementsOfNumNodesEq_zero : elementsOfNumNodesEq X 0 =
    Finset.univ.map ⟨Lf, fun a b h ↦ by simpa using h⟩
proof: := by rw [elementsOfNumNodesEq]

name: elementsOfNumNodesEq_succ
statement:
theorem elementsOfNumNodesEq_succ {n : ℕ} : elementsOfNumNodesEq X (n + 1) =
    (Finset.antidiagonal n).biUnion fun ijh => pairwiseFork (elementsOfNumNodesEq X ijh.1)
      (elementsOfNumNodesEq X ijh.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [elementsOfNumNodesEq]
  ext
  simp

name: mem_elementsOfNumNodesEq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_elementsOfNumNodesEq {x : FreeMagma X} {n : ℕ} :
    x ∈ elementsOfNumNodesEq X n ↔ order x = n
proof:
:= by
  induction x generalizing n <;> cases n
  · simp
  · simp [elementsOfNumNodesEq_succ]
  · simp
  · simp [elementsOfNumNodesEq_succ, *]

name: elementsOfNumNodesEq_card_eq_catalan_mul_pow
statement:
theorem elementsOfNumNodesEq_card_eq_catalan_mul_pow (n : ℕ) :
    (elementsOfNumNodesEq X n).card = catalan n * (Fintype.card X) ^ (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Nat.case_strong_induction_on
  · simp
  case hi n ih =>
  rw [elementsOfNumNodesEq_succ, Finset.card_biUnion, catalan_succ', Finset.sum_mul]
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h
    rw [Finset.card_map, Finset.card_product, ih _ (Finset.antidiagonal.fst_le h),
      ih _ (Finset.antidiagonal.snd_le h)]
    rw [← Finset.mem_antidiagonal.1 h]
    ring
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ _ ⟨i', j'⟩ _ hne x hxs hxt
    dsimp only [pairwiseFork] at hxs hxt
    intro y hy
    have hy1 := hxs hy
    have hy2 := hxt hy
    aesop

name: fmapHom_id
statement: theorem fmapHom_id {α} (m : FreeMagma α) : fmapHom id m = m
