 theorem EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty {α : Type u} {G : Type v} [Magma G] (f : α → G) :
    ∀ g : FreeMagma α →◇ G, g.toFun ∘ Lf = f → evalInMagma f = g.toFun := by
   intro g glift
   let rec equiv : ∀ tx : FreeMagma α, evalInMagma f tx = g.toFun tx := fun tx ↦
      match tx with
      | FreeMagma.Leaf x => (congrFun glift x).symm
      | FreeMagma.Fork txleft txright =>
        (congrArg (fun t ↦ t ◇ evalInMagma f txright) (equiv txleft)).trans
          ((congrArg (fun t ↦ g.toFun txleft ◇ t) (equiv txright)).trans
            (g.map_op' txleft txright).symm)
   exact (funext equiv)

 theorem FmapFreeMagmaUniversalProperty {α : Type u} {β : Type u} (f : α → β) :
      ∀ g : FreeMagma α →◇ FreeMagma β, g ∘ Lf = Lf ∘ f → fmapFreeMagma f = g :=
    EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty (Lf ∘ f)

name: EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty
statement:
theorem EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty {α : Type u} {G : Type v} [Magma G] (f : α → G) :
    ∀ g : FreeMagma α →◇ G, g.toFun ∘ Lf = f → evalInMagma f = g.toFun
proof:
:= by
   intro g glift
   let rec equiv : ∀ tx : FreeMagma α, evalInMagma f tx = g.toFun tx := fun tx ↦
      match tx with
      | FreeMagma.Leaf x => (congrFun glift x).symm
      | FreeMagma.Fork txleft txright =>
        (congrArg (fun t ↦ t ◇ evalInMagma f txright) (equiv txleft)).trans
          ((congrArg (fun t ↦ g.toFun txleft ◇ t) (equiv txright)).trans
            (g.map_op' txleft txright).symm)
   exact (funext equiv)

 theorem FmapFreeMagmaUniversalProperty {α : Type u} {β : Type u} (f : α → β) :
      ∀ g : FreeMagma α →◇ FreeMagma β, g ∘ Lf = Lf ∘ f → fmapFreeMagma f = g :=
    EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty (Lf ∘ f)

name: FmapFreeMagmaUniversalProperty
statement:
theorem FmapFreeMagmaUniversalProperty {α : Type u} {β : Type u} (f : α → β) :
      ∀ g : FreeMagma α →◇ FreeMagma β, g ∘ Lf = Lf ∘ f → fmapFreeMagma f = g
proof:
:=
    EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty (Lf ∘ f)

name: first_mem
statement:
theorem first_mem {α} : ∀ m : FreeMagma α, Mem m.first m
  | Lf _ => rfl
  | lchild ⋆ _ => .inl lchild.first_mem

name: Fin0_impossible
statement: lemma Fin0_impossible (x : FreeMagma (Fin 0)) : False
proof: := nomatch x.first

name: forks_left_lt_self
statement: theorem forks_left_lt_self {α} (x y : FreeMagma α) : x.forks < (x ⋆ y).forks
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forks]
  omega

name: forks_right_lt_self
statement: theorem forks_right_lt_self {α} (x y : FreeMagma α) : y.forks < (x ⋆ y).forks
proof:
:= by
  simp only [forks]
  omega

name: map_forks
statement:
@[simp] theorem map_forks {α β} (m : FreeMagma α) (f : α → β) :
    (fmapHom f m).forks = m.forks
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | Leaf a => rfl
  | Fork m1 m2 ih1 ih2 => simp [fmapHom, evalInMagma, forks, ih1, ih2] at *

name: length_eq_succ_forks
statement: lemma length_eq_succ_forks {α} (x: FreeMagma α) : x.length = x.forks.succ
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | Leaf =>
    simp [length, forks]
  | Fork x y hx hy =>
    simp [hx, hy, length, forks]
    omega

name: length_pos
statement: theorem length_pos {α} (x : FreeMagma α): 0 < FreeMagma.length x
proof:
:= by
  rw [length_eq_succ_forks]
  exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _

name: length_ne_0
statement:
@[simp]
theorem length_ne_0 {α} (x : FreeMagma α) : FreeMagma.length x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  Nat.ne_zero_of_lt x.length_pos

name: length_left_lt_self
statement: theorem length_left_lt_self {α} (x y : FreeMagma α) : x.length < (x ⋆ y).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [length, Nat.lt_add_right_iff_pos]
  exact length_pos y

name: length_right_lt_self
statement: theorem length_right_lt_self {α} (x y : FreeMagma α) : y.length < (x ⋆ y).length
proof:
:= by
  simp only [length, Nat.lt_add_left_iff_pos]
  exact length_pos x

name: toList_eq_toListTR
statement: @[csimp] private theorem toList_eq_toListTR : @toList = @toListTR
proof:
:= by
  funext α m
  have h (m acc) : @toListTR.go α acc m = toList m ++ acc := by
    induction m generalizing acc <;> simp [toListTR.go, toList, *]
  simpa using (h m []).symm

name: toList_length
statement: theorem toList_length {α} (m : FreeMagma α) : m.toList.length = m.length
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> simp [*]

name: evalInMagma_pmap
proof:
:= by
  induction m <;> simp [pmap, evalInMagma, *]

name: attach_map_val
statement: theorem attach_map_val {α} (m : FreeMagma α) : fmapHom (·.val) m.attach = m
proof:
:=
  (evalInMagma_pmap _ (by simp)).trans (fmapHom_id _)

name: mem_evalInMagma_of_mem
statement:
theorem mem_evalInMagma_of_mem {α β a b} {f : α → FreeMagma β} :
    ∀ {m : FreeMagma α}, Mem b m → Mem a (f b) → Mem a (evalInMagma f m)
  | Lf _, rfl, h => h
  | _ ⋆ _, .inl h1, h2 => .inl <| mem_evalInMagma_of_mem h1 h2
  | _ ⋆ _, .inr h1, h2 => .inr <| mem_evalInMagma_of_mem h1 h2

name: pmap_evalInMagma
statement:
theorem pmap_evalInMagma {α β γ} (f : α → FreeMagma β) (m : FreeMagma α)
    (g : (a : β) → Mem a (evalInMagma f m) → γ)
    (k : α → FreeMagma γ)
    (h : ∀ a ha, ((f a).pmap fun b hb => g b (mem_evalInMagma_of_mem ha hb)) = k a) :
    (evalInMagma f m).pmap g = evalInMagma k m
proof:
:= by
  induction m with simp [evalInMagma, pmap, *]
  | Leaf => exact h _ rfl
  | Fork _ _ iha ihb => exact ⟨iha _ fun a ha => h a (.inl ha), ihb _ fun a ha => h a (.inr ha)⟩

name: pmap_eq_map
statement:
theorem pmap_eq_map {α β} (m : FreeMagma α)
    (f : (a : α) → Mem a m → β) (g : α → β) (h : ∀ a h, f a h = g a) :
    m.pmap f = fmapHom g m
proof:
:= by
  simp [fmapHom]; induction m <;> simp [evalInMagma, pmap, *]

name: existsFreshGeneratorName
statement:
theorem existsFreshGeneratorName (A : Finset (FreeGroup α)) :
    ∃ a, a ∉ A.biUnion generatorNames
proof: := by apply Finset.exists_notMem

name: generatorNames'_sublist
statement:
theorem generatorNames'_sublist (L₁ L₂ : List (α × Bool)) (hL : L₁.Sublist L₂) :
    generatorNames' L₁ ⊆ generatorNames' L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction hL with
  | slnil => rfl
  | cons a _ ih => simp [generatorNames', subset_trans ih]
  | cons₂ a _ ih => simp [generatorNames']; grind

name: generatorNames_mk_le
statement: theorem generatorNames_mk_le (L : List (α × Bool)) : generatorNames (FreeGroup.mk L) ⊆ generatorNames' L
proof:
:=
  generatorNames'_sublist _ _ FreeGroup.reduce.red.sublist

name: generatorNames'_append
statement:
theorem generatorNames'_append (L₁ L₂ : List (α × Bool)) :
    generatorNames' (L₁ ++ L₂) = generatorNames' L₁ ∪ generatorNames' L₂
proof:
:= by
  induction L₁ with
  | nil => simp [generatorNames']
  | cons _ _ ih => simp [generatorNames', ih]

name: generatorNames_mul_le
statement: theorem generatorNames_mul_le (x y : FreeGroup α) : generatorNames (x * y) ⊆ generatorNames x ∪ generatorNames y
proof:
:= by
  calc
    generatorNames (x * y) = generatorNames (FreeGroup.mk (x.toWord ++ y.toWord)) := by rw [← FreeGroup.mul_mk, FreeGroup.mk_toWord, FreeGroup.mk_toWord]
    _ ⊆ generatorNames' (x.toWord ++ y.toWord) := generatorNames_mk_le _
    _ = generatorNames x ∪ generatorNames y := generatorNames'_append _ _

name: generatorNames'_invRev
statement: theorem generatorNames'_invRev (L : List (α × Bool)) : generatorNames' (FreeGroup.invRev L) = generatorNames' L
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons _ _ ih =>
    unfold FreeGroup.invRev at *
    simp [generatorNames', generatorNames'_append, ih, Finset.union_comm]

name: generatorNames_inv
statement: theorem generatorNames_inv (x : FreeGroup α) : generatorNames x⁻¹ = generatorNames x
proof:
:= by
  unfold generatorNames
  rw [FreeGroup.toWord_inv]
  apply generatorNames'_invRev

name: freshGeneratorName_not_in_generatorNames
statement:
theorem freshGeneratorName_not_in_generatorNames {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} {g : FreeGroup α} (hgS : g ∈ S) :
    freshGeneratorName S ∉ generatorNames g
proof:
:= fun hc => by
  apply (existsFreshGeneratorName S).choose_spec
  simp [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  simp [freshGeneratorName] at hc
  use g

name: freshGeneratorName_not_in_closure_generatorNames
statement:
theorem freshGeneratorName_not_in_closure_generatorNames (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) (g : FreeGroup α) :
    g ∈ Subgroup.closure S → freshGeneratorName S ∉ generatorNames g
proof:
:= by
  apply Subgroup.closure_induction
  · simp only [Finset.mem_coe]
    apply freshGeneratorName_not_in_generatorNames
  · unfold generatorNames
    simp [generatorNames']
  · intro x y _ _ _ _
    have := generatorNames_mul_le x y
    apply mt (this ·)
    simp_all
  · intro x _ ineqx
    rw [generatorNames_inv x]
    assumption

name: generatorNames_fresh
statement: theorem generatorNames_fresh (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) : generatorNames (freshGenerator S) = {freshGeneratorName S}
proof:
:= by
  simp [freshGenerator, generatorNames, generatorNames']

name: freshGenerator_not_in_span
statement:
theorem freshGenerator_not_in_span (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) :
    freshGenerator S ∉ Subgroup.closure S
proof:
:= by
  intro contra
  have := freshGeneratorName_not_in_closure_generatorNames _ _ contra
  have := generatorNames_fresh S
  tauto

name: head_generatorNames
statement:
theorem head_generatorNames (x : FreeGroup α) (m : α) (f : Bool) :
    (m,f) ∈ (FreeGroup.toWord x).head? → m ∈ generatorNames x
proof:
:= by
  unfold generatorNames
  cases FreeGroup.toWord x
  · tauto
  · intro hmf
    injection hmf with hh
    rw [hh]
    simp [generatorNames']

name: freshGenerator_toWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freshGenerator_toWord (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) :
    FreeGroup.toWord (freshGenerator S) = [(freshGeneratorName S, true)]
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: freshGenerator_inv_toWord
statement:
@[simp]
theorem freshGenerator_inv_toWord (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) :
    FreeGroup.toWord (freshGenerator S)⁻¹ = [(freshGeneratorName S, false)]
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: fresh_old_no_cancellation
statement:
theorem fresh_old_no_cancellation {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} {x : FreeGroup α} (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) :
    FreeGroup.toWord (freshGenerator S * x) =
    FreeGroup.toWord (freshGenerator S) ++ FreeGroup.toWord x
proof:
:= by
  rw [toWord_mul]
  simp only [freshGenerator_toWord, List.singleton_append, FreeGroup.reduce.cons, Bool.true_eq,
    Bool.not_eq_eq_eq_not, Bool.not_true, FreeGroup.reduce_toWord]
  cases hx' : FreeGroup.toWord x
  case nil => rfl
  case cons head tail =>
    simp only [ite_eq_right_iff, and_imp]
    intro eq1 eq2
    exfalso
    have ineq1 := freshGeneratorName_not_in_closure_generatorNames S x hx
    refine ineq1 (head_generatorNames x (freshGeneratorName S) false ?_)
    simp [hx', eq1, ←eq2]

name: fresh_old_inv_no_cancellation
statement:
theorem fresh_old_inv_no_cancellation {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} {x : FreeGroup α} (hx : x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) :
    FreeGroup.toWord (x * (freshGenerator S)⁻¹) =
    FreeGroup.toWord x ++ (FreeGroup.toWord (freshGenerator S)⁻¹)
proof:
:= by
  have hxS : x * (freshGenerator S)⁻¹ = ((freshGenerator S) * x⁻¹)⁻¹ := by simp
  rw [hxS, FreeGroup.toWord_inv, fresh_old_no_cancellation (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx),
  invRev_append, ← FreeGroup.toWord_inv]
  simp [FreeGroup.invRev]

name: fresh_ineq
statement:
theorem fresh_ineq (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) (x y : FreeGroup α) (x_mem : x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (y_mem : y ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (eq : x = freshGenerator S * y)
    : False
proof:
:= by
  have eq' : x * y⁻¹ = freshGenerator S := by
    rw [eq]
    simp only [mul_inv_cancel_right]
  apply freshGenerator_not_in_span (α := α)
  rw [← eq']
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ x_mem (Subgroup.inv_mem _ y_mem)

name: fresh_ineq'
statement:
theorem fresh_ineq' (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) (x y : FreeGroup α) (x_mem :  x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (y_mem : y ∈ Subgroup.closure S)
    (eq : x * (freshGenerator S)⁻¹ =  y) : False
proof:
:= by
  have eq' : y⁻¹ * x = freshGenerator S := by
    rw [← eq]
    simp only [mul_inv_rev, inv_inv, inv_mul_cancel_right]
  apply freshGenerator_not_in_span (α := α)
  rw [← eq']
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ y_mem) x_mem

name: fresh_ineq''
statement:
theorem fresh_ineq'' (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) (x y : FreeGroup α) (x_mem : x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (y_mem : y ∈ Subgroup.closure S)
    (eq : x * (freshGenerator S)⁻¹ = (freshGenerator S) * y) : False
proof:
:= by
  apply_fun FreeGroup.toWord at eq
  revert eq
  rw [fresh_old_no_cancellation y_mem]
  rw [fresh_old_inv_no_cancellation x_mem]
  cases h : FreeGroup.toWord x with
  | nil => simp [invRev]
  | cons head tail =>
    simp only [freshGenerator_inv_toWord, List.cons_append, freshGenerator_toWord,
      List.cons.injEq]
    intro eq'
    
    exfalso
    have ineq1 := freshGeneratorName_not_in_closure_generatorNames S x x_mem
    refine ineq1 (head_generatorNames x (freshGeneratorName S) true ?_)
    simp [h, eq']

name: fresh_ineq'''
statement:
theorem fresh_ineq''' (S : Finset (FreeGroup α)) (x y : FreeGroup α) (x_mem : x ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (y_mem : y ∈ Subgroup.closure S) (eq : x = y * freshGenerator S)
    : False
proof:
:= by
  have eq' : y⁻¹ * x = freshGenerator S := by
    rw [eq]
    simp
  apply freshGenerator_not_in_span (α := α)
  rw [← eq']
  exact Subgroup.mul_mem _ (Subgroup.inv_mem _ y_mem) x_mem

name: dropGenerators_generatorNames'
statement:
theorem dropGenerators_generatorNames' (S : Finset α) (a : List (α × Bool)) :
    generatorNames' a ⊆ S → dropGenerators S (mk a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction a
  case nil => tauto
  case cons head _ ih =>
    rw [← List.singleton_append]
    intro hn
    simp only [generatorNames', List.singleton_append] at hn
    rw [← mul_mk, MonoidHom.map_mul, ih]
    · suffices head.1 ∈ S by simp [dropGenerators, this]
      exact Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mp (Finset.union_subset_left hn)
    · apply subset_trans _ hn; simp

name: dropGenerators_generatorNames
statement: theorem dropGenerators_generatorNames (S : Finset α) (a : FreeGroup α) : generatorNames a ⊆ S → dropGenerators S a = 1
proof:
:= by
  nth_rw 2 [← mk_toWord (x := a)]
  apply dropGenerators_generatorNames'

name: forgetOld_fresh
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forgetOld_fresh {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} : forgetOld S (freshGenerator S) = freshGenerator S
proof:
:= by
  simp [forgetOld, freshGenerator, dropGenerators]
  apply freshGeneratorName_not_in_generatorNames

name: forgetOld_old
statement:
@[simp]
theorem forgetOld_old {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} {x : FreeGroup α} (hxS : x ∈ S) : forgetOld S x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply dropGenerators_generatorNames
  exact Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem _ hxS

name: projectFresh_fresh
statement: @[simp] theorem projectFresh_fresh {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} : projectFresh S (freshGenerator S) = (1 : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp [projectFresh, projectFresh', freshGenerator]

name: projectFresh_old'
statement:
theorem projectFresh_old' {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} (L : List (α × Bool)) :
    generatorNames' L ⊆ S.biUnion generatorNames → projectFresh S (mk L) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction L
  case nil => simp [generatorNames', ← one_eq_mk]
  case cons head _ ih =>
    rw [← List.singleton_append]
    intro hn
    simp only [generatorNames', List.singleton_append] at hn
    rw [← mul_mk, projectFresh, MonoidHom.map_mul, ← projectFresh, ih]
    · have : head.1 ∈ S.biUnion generatorNames :=
        Finset.singleton_subset_iff.mp $ Finset.union_subset_left hn
      have : freshGeneratorName S ∉ S.biUnion generatorNames := (existsFreshGeneratorName S).choose_spec
      simp [projectFresh, projectFresh']
      by_cases head.2 <;> aesop
    · exact Finset.union_subset_right hn

name: projectFresh_old
statement: theorem projectFresh_old {S : Finset (FreeGroup α)} {x} (h : x ∈ S) : projectFresh S x = 1
proof:
:=
  mk_toWord (x := x) ▸ projectFresh_old' _ fun _ h' ↦ Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨x, h, h'⟩

name: AssocImpliesForkEquivRightJoin
statement:
theorem AssocImpliesForkEquivRightJoin {α : Type _} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (f : α → G) (tl tr : FreeMagma α) :
    evalInMagma f (tl ⋆ tr) = evalInMagma f (rightJoinTrees tl tr)
proof:
:=
  match tl with
    | Lf _        => rfl
    | (tl1 ⋆ tl2) =>
      (assoc (evalInMagma f tl1) (evalInMagma f tl2) (evalInMagma f tr)).symm.trans
      (congrArg (evalInMagma f tl1 ◇ ·) (AssocImpliesForkEquivRightJoin assoc f tl2 tr))

name: AssocFullyRightAssociate
statement:
theorem AssocFullyRightAssociate {α : Type _} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (f : α → G) (t : FreeMagma α) :
    evalInMagma f t = evalInMagma f (rightAssociateTree t)
proof:
:=
  match t with
    | Lf _      => rfl
    | (tl ⋆ tr) => Eq.trans
      (congrArg (· ◇ (evalInMagma f tr)) (AssocFullyRightAssociate assoc f tl)) $ Eq.trans
      (congrArg (evalInMagma f (rightAssociateTree tl) ◇ ·) (AssocFullyRightAssociate assoc f tr))
      (AssocImpliesForkEquivRightJoin assoc f (rightAssociateTree tl) (rightAssociateTree tr))

name: Assoc4
statement:
theorem Assoc4 {G : Type _} [Magma G] (assoc : Equation4512 G) :
    ∀ x y z w : G, ((x ◇ y) ◇ z) ◇ w = x ◇ (y ◇ (z ◇ w))
proof:
:=
  fun x y z w ↦ AssocFullyRightAssociate
    assoc
    (fun | 0 => x | 1 => y | 2 => z | 3 => w : Fin 4 → G)
    (((Lf 0 ⋆ Lf 1) ⋆ Lf 2) ⋆ Lf 3)

name: FreeSgrAssoc
statement: theorem FreeSgrAssoc {α : Type} : Equation4512 (FreeSemigroup α)
proof:
:=
  fun ls1 ls2 ls3 ↦ match ls1 with
    | _ .+      => rfl
    | a ,+ ls1' => congrArg (fun ls ↦ a ,+ ls) (FreeSgrAssoc ls1' ls2 ls3)

name: AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful
statement:
theorem AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful {α : Type _} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (f : α → G) (t : FreeMagma α) :
    evalInMagma f t = evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr t)
proof:
:=
  match t with
    | Lf a => rfl
    | Lf a ⋆ tr => congrArg (f a ◇ ·) (AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful assoc f tr)
    | (tl1 ⋆ tl2) ⋆ tr => by
      symm
      trans evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun (tl1 ⋆ tl2) ◇ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tr)
      · exact congrArg _ $ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.map_op' _ tr
      trans evalInSgr f ((freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl1 ◇ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl2) ◇ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tr)
      · exact congrArg (fun s ↦ evalInSgr f (s ◇ tr ↠Sgr)) $ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.map_op' tl1 tl2
      trans
        (evalInSgrHom assoc f).toFun (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl1 ◇ freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl2) ◇
          (evalInSgrHom assoc f).toFun (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tr)
      · apply (evalInSgrHom assoc f).map_op'
      trans
         ((evalInSgrHom assoc f).toFun (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl1) ◇
          (evalInSgrHom assoc f).toFun (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tl2)) ◇
          evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr.toFun tr)
      · exact congrArg (· ◇ _) $ (evalInSgrHom assoc f).map_op' (tl1 ↠Sgr) (tl2 ↠Sgr)
      symm
      trans (tl1 ⋆ tl2 ⬝ f) ◇ evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr tr)
      · exact congrArg _ (AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful assoc f tr)
      trans (evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr tl1) ◇ (tl2 ⬝ f)) ◇ evalInSgr f (freeMagmaToFreeSgr tr)
      · exact congrArg (fun s ↦ (s ◇ _) ◇ _) (AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful assoc f tl1)
      · exact congrArg (fun s ↦ (_ ◇ s) ◇ _) (AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful assoc f tl2)

name: CommSgrImpliesInsertSortedFaithful
statement:
theorem CommSgrImpliesInsertSortedFaithful {n : Nat} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (comm : Equation43 G) (f : Fin n → G) :
    ∀ i : Fin n, ∀ ls : FreeSemigroup (Fin n),
      evalInSgr f (insertSgrSorted i ls) = f i ◇ evalInSgr f ls
proof:
:=
  fun i ls ↦ match ls with
  | j .+ => by
    have eqor := ite_eq_or_eq (i ≤ j) (i ,+ j .+) (j ,+ i .+)
    cases eqor with
    | inl eq1 => exact (congrArg (evalInSgr f) eq1).trans rfl
    | inr eq2 => exact (congrArg (evalInSgr f) eq2).trans (comm _ _)
  | j ,+ lstail => by
    have eqor := ite_eq_or_eq (i ≤ j) (i ,+ j ,+ lstail) (j ,+ i ,+ lstail)
    cases eqor with
    | inl eq1 =>
      exact (congrArg (evalInSgr f) eq1).trans rfl
    | inr eq2 =>
      exact (congrArg (evalInSgr f) eq2).trans ((assoc (f j) (f i) _).trans
        (comm (f j) (f i) ▸ (assoc (f i) (f j) _).symm))

name: CommSgrImpliesInsertionSortFaithful
statement:
theorem CommSgrImpliesInsertionSortFaithful {n : Nat} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (comm : Equation43 G) (f : Fin n → G) :
    ∀ ls : FreeSemigroup (Fin n), evalInSgr f ls = evalInSgr f (insertionSortSgr ls)
  | _ .+        => rfl
  | i ,+ lstail =>
    (congrArg (f i ◇ ·) (CommSgrImpliesInsertionSortFaithful assoc comm f lstail)).trans
    (CommSgrImpliesInsertSortedFaithful assoc comm f i (insertionSortSgr lstail)).symm

def involutionReduce {α : Type _} [DecidableEq α] (ls : FreeSemigroup α) : FreeSemigroup α
proof:
:=
  match ls with
  | a .+             => a .+
  | a ,+ b .+        => a ,+ b .+
  | a ,+ b ,+ lstail => if a = b then involutionReduce lstail else a ,+ involutionReduce (b ,+ lstail)

name: AbGrpPow2ImpliesEquation1571ReducerFaithful
statement:
theorem AbGrpPow2ImpliesEquation1571ReducerFaithful {n : Nat} {G : Type _} [Magma G]
    (t : FreeMagma (Fin (n+1))) (f : Fin (n+1) → G)
    (assoc : Equation4512 G) (comm : Equation43 G) (invol : Equation16 G) :
    evalInMagma f t = evalInSgr f (equation1571Reducer t)
proof:
:=
  (((InvolutiveImpliesInvolutionReduceFaithful _ invol f).symm).trans
    (((CommSgrImpliesInsertionSortFaithful assoc comm f _).symm).trans
      (((AssocImpliesSgrProjFaithful assoc f _).symm).trans
        ((comm ..).trans (((assoc ..).symm).trans ((invol _ (f _)).symm)))))).symm

name: ExtendImg'
statement: theorem ExtendImg' (f : PartialSolution) : ∀ {a}, a ∈ f.Dom → f.f a ∉ f.Dom → a - f.f a ∉ f.Im
proof:
:= by
  intro a h₁ h₂
  convert f.ExtendImg h₁ h₂
  funext x
  simp only [Im, Finset.mem_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe]

name: DFinsuppInfinite_not_Finite
statement: theorem DFinsuppInfinite_not_Finite : ¬(Module.Finite ℤ A)
proof:
:= by
  /- Prove by giving a series of Module equivalences (LinearEquiv's) between DFinsupp,
  Finsupp, and finally Polynomial, where we can appeal to Polynomial.not_finite to do the
  lifting for us. -/
  have f : (Polynomial ℤ) ≃ₗ[ℤ] (Finsupp ℕ ℤ) := {
    toFun := Polynomial.toFinsupp
    invFun := Polynomial.ofFinsupp
    map_add' _ _ := by simp; rfl
    map_smul' := by
      intros
      rw [zsmul_eq_mul, eq_intCast, Int.cast_id, ← zsmul_eq_mul]
      rfl
    left_inv := by simp [Function.LeftInverse]
    right_inv := by simp [Function.RightInverse, Function.LeftInverse]
  }
  rw [← Module.Finite.equiv_iff (finsuppLequivDFinsupp ℤ), ← Module.Finite.equiv_iff f]
  exact Polynomial.not_finite

name: freshGeneratorExists
statement:
private lemma freshGeneratorExists (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    ∃ y, ∀ (k : ℤ), k ≠ 0 → k • y ∉ Submodule.span ℤ (f.Dom ∪ f.Im ∪ {x} : Set A)
proof:
:= by
  have hRankFin := rank_span_of_finset (R := ℤ) (f.Dom ∪ f.Im ∪ {x} : Finset A)
  rw [Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_union, Finset.coe_singleton] at hRankFin
  have hRankInfinite : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ Module.rank ℤ A := by
    by_contra! h
    rw [Module.rank_lt_aleph0_iff] at h
    exact DFinsuppInfinite_not_Finite h
  apply Submodule.exists_smul_notMem_of_rank_lt (R := ℤ)
  exact lt_of_lt_of_le hRankFin hRankInfinite

name: freshGenerator_not_smul_span
statement:
theorem freshGenerator_not_smul_span (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) {k : ℤ} (hk : k ≠ 0) :
    k • f.freshGenerator x ∉ Submodule.span ℤ (f.Dom ∪ f.Im ∪ {x})
proof:
:= by
  rw [freshGenerator]
  exact Classical.choose_spec (freshGeneratorExists f x) k hk

name: freshGenerator_not_span
statement:
theorem freshGenerator_not_span (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    f.freshGenerator x ∉ Submodule.span ℤ (f.Dom ∪ f.Im ∪ {x})
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.freshGenerator_not_smul_span x (one_ne_zero)

name: freshGenerator_not_dom
statement: lemma freshGenerator_not_dom : f.freshGenerator a ∉ f.Dom
proof:
:= by
  have hf := f.freshGenerator_not_span a
  contrapose! hf
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_set']
  use 1, fun _ ↦ 1, fun _ ↦ ⟨f.freshGenerator a, by simp [hf]⟩
  simp

name: fresh_ne_sum
statement:
lemma fresh_ne_sum (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) (hy : y ∈ f.Dom) (h i j k l m : ℤ := 0) (hh : h ≠ 0 := by decide):
    h • f.freshGenerator a ≠ i • a + j • x + k • y + l • f.f x + m • f.f y
proof:
:= by
  have hf := f.freshGenerator_not_smul_span a hh
  contrapose! hf
  rw [Submodule.mem_span_set']
  use 5
  use fun n ↦ if n = 0 then i else if n = 1 then j else if n = 2 then k
    else if n = 3 then l else m
  use fun n ↦
    if n = 0 then ⟨a, by simp⟩
    else if n = 1 then ⟨x, by simp [hx]⟩
    else if n = 2 then ⟨y, by simp [hy]⟩
    else if n = 3 then ⟨f.f x, by simp [show f.f x ∈ f.Im by simp [Im]; use x]⟩
    else ⟨f.f y, by simp [show f.f y ∈ f.Im by simp [Im]; use y]⟩
  simp [hf, Fin.sum_univ_def, List.finRange_succ]
  abel

name: fresh_sum_ne_sum
statement:
lemma fresh_sum_ne_sum (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) (hy : y ∈ f.Dom)
    (h₁ i₁ j₁ k₁ l₁ m₁ h₂ i₂ j₂ k₂ l₂ m₂ : ℤ := 0) (hh : h₁ ≠ h₂ := by decide) :
  h₁ • f.freshGenerator a + i₁ • a + j₁ • x + k₁ • y + l₁ • f.f x + m₁ • f.f y ≠
  h₂ • f.freshGenerator a + i₂ • a + j₂ • x + k₂ • y + l₂ • f.f x + m₂ • f.f y
proof:
:= by
  have hf := (f.fresh_ne_sum a hx hy (h₂ - h₁) (i₁ - i₂) (j₁ - j₂) (k₁ - k₂) (l₁ - l₂) (m₁ - m₂)
    (sub_ne_zero_of_ne hh.symm)).symm
  contrapose! hf
  rw [← neg_add_eq_zero] at hf ⊢
  rw [← hf, ← neg_add_eq_zero]
  simp [sub_smul]
  abel

name: fresh_ne_f
statement: lemma fresh_ne_f (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) : f.freshGenerator a ≠ f.f x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.fresh_ne_sum a hx f.Dom0 1 0 0 0 1

name: fresh_ne_add_f
statement: lemma fresh_ne_add_f (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) (hy : y ∈ f.Dom) : f.freshGenerator a ≠ x + f.f y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using f.fresh_ne_sum a hx hy 1 0 1 0 0 1

name: extend_mono
statement:
theorem extend_mono (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, y ∈ (f.extend hx).Dom ∧ (f.extend hx).f y = f.f y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  by_cases hf : f.f x ∈ f.Dom
  · simp [extend, hf, hy]
  · simp [extend, hf]
    by_cases hyf : y = f.f x
    · exact (hf (hyf ▸ hy)).elim
    · have : y ≠ f.freshGenerator - f.f x := (f.fresh_ne_add_f _ hy hx).symm ∘ add_eq_of_eq_sub
      simp [hyf, hy, this]

name: extend_mono_dom
statement:
theorem extend_mono_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, y ∈ (f.extend hx).Dom
proof:
:=
  fun y hy ↦ ((f.extend_mono hx) y hy).1

name: extend_mono_f
statement:
theorem extend_mono_f (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, (f.extend hx).f y = f.f y
proof:
:=
  fun y hy ↦ ((f.extend_mono hx) y hy).2

name: extend_dom
statement:
theorem extend_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    (f.extend hx).f x ∈ (f.extend hx).Dom
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : f.f x ∈ f.Dom
  · simp [extend, hf]
  · simp [extend, hf]
    by_cases hxf : x = f.f x
    · exact (hf (hxf ▸ hx)).elim
    · have : x ≠ f.freshGenerator - f.f x := (f.fresh_ne_add_f _ hx hx).symm ∘ add_eq_of_eq_sub
      simp [hxf, this]

name: extend_valid
statement:
theorem extend_valid (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ f.Dom) :
    let f'
proof:
:= (f.extend hx).f; f' (f' (f' x) - f' x) = x - f' x :=
  (f.extend hx).Valid (f.extend_mono_dom hx x hx) (f.extend_dom hx)

name: add_mono
statement:
theorem add_mono (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∉ f.Dom) (hxi : x ∉ f.Im)
    (hxs : ¬∃ w, w ∈ f.Dom ∧ w - f.f w = x) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, y ∈ (f.add hx hxi hxs).Dom ∧ (f.add hx hxi hxs).f y = f.f y
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hxy : x ≠ y := fun h ↦ hx (h ▸ hy)
  simp [add, hy, hxy]

name: add_mono_dom
statement:
theorem add_mono_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∉ f.Dom) (hxi : x ∉ f.Im)
    (hxs : ¬∃ w, w ∈ f.Dom ∧ w - f.f w = x) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, y ∈ (f.add hx hxi hxs).Dom
proof:
:=
  fun y hy ↦ (f.add_mono hx hxi hxs y hy).1

name: add_mono_f
statement:
theorem add_mono_f (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∉ f.Dom) (hxi : x ∉ f.Im)
    (hxs : ¬∃ w, w ∈ f.Dom ∧ w - f.f w = x) :
    ∀ y ∈ f.Dom, (f.add hx hxi hxs).f y = f.f y
proof:
:=
  fun y hy ↦ (f.add_mono hx hxi hxs y hy).2

name: add_dom
statement:
theorem add_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} (hx : x ∉ f.Dom) (hxi : x ∉ f.Im)
    (hxs : ¬∃ w, w ∈ f.Dom ∧ w - f.f w = x) :
    x ∈ (f.add hx hxi hxs).Dom
proof:
:= by
  simp [add]

name: closeImg.lem_1
statement:
private lemma closeImg.lem_1 {f : PartialSolution} {x : Obelix.A} (hxi : x ∈ f.Im) :
    ∃! a, a ∈ f.Dom ∧ (fun x_1 ↦ f.f x_1 = x) a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y,hy₁,hy₂⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hxi;
  use y
  simp [hy₁, hy₂]
  exact fun _ hz ↦ hy₂ ▸ (f.Inj hz hy₁)

name: closeImg.lem_2
statement:
private lemma closeImg.lem_2 {f : PartialSolution} {x : Obelix.A} (hxi : x ∈ f.Im) :
    let y

name: closeImg.lem_3
statement:
private lemma closeImg.lem_3 {f : PartialSolution} {x : Obelix.A} (hxi : x ∈ f.Im) :
    let y
proof:
:= Finset.choose (fun x_1 ↦ f.f x_1 = x) f.Dom (lem_1 hxi);
    ∀ (hy : y ∈ f.Dom := lem_2 hxi), x ∈ (f.extend hy).Dom := by
  intro y hy
  rw [← show (f.extend hy).f y = x from (f.extend_mono_f _ _ hy).trans
    (Finset.choose_spec (f.f · = x) _ _).2]
  exact f.extend_dom hy

name: close.lem_1
proof:
:= Finset.choose (fun w ↦ w - f.f w = x) f.Dom hw₀;
    ∀ (hw : w ∈ f.Dom), x ∈ (f.extend hw).Im := by
  intro w hw
  have hw₂ := f.extend_mono_dom hw _ hw
  simp only [Im, Finset.mem_image]
  use (f.extend hw).f ((f.extend hw).f w) - (f.extend hw).f w
  constructor
  · exact (f.extend hw).Closed_sub hw₂ (f.extend_dom hw)
  · have hfw₂ : w - (f.extend hw).f w = x := (f.extend_mono_f _ w hw) ▸
      (Finset.choose_spec (fun w ↦ w - f.f w = x) _ _).2
    rw [← hfw₂]
    exact (f.extend hw).Valid hw₂ (f.extend_dom hw)

name: close_dom
statement:
theorem close_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} :
    x ∈ (f.close x).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [close]
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  · apply extend_mono_dom
    exact h₁
  · rw [closeImg]
    apply extend_mono_dom
    exact closeImg.lem_3 h₂
  · rename_i h
    simp only [closeImg]
    apply extend_mono_dom
    exact closeImg.lem_3 (close.lem_1 _ _)
  · apply extend_mono_dom
    apply add_dom

name: close_f_dom
statement:
theorem close_f_dom (f : PartialSolution) {x : A} :
    (f.close x).f x ∈ (f.close x).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [close]
  split_ifs
  · apply extend_dom
  · rw [closeImg]
    apply extend_dom
  · simp only [closeImg]
    apply extend_dom
  · apply extend_dom

name: close_mono
statement:
theorem close_mono (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    ∀ y, y ∈ f.Dom → y ∈ (f.close x).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [close]
  split_ifs
  · apply extend_mono_dom
  · intro y hy
    rw [closeImg]
    apply extend_mono_dom
    apply extend_mono_dom _ _ _ hy
  · simp only [closeImg]
    intro y hy
    repeat apply extend_mono_dom
    exact hy
  · intro y hy
    apply extend_mono_dom
    exact add_mono_dom _ _ _ _ _ hy

name: close_extend
statement:
theorem close_extend (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    ∀ y, y ∈ f.Dom → (f.close x).f y = f.f y
proof:
:= by
  rw [close]
  split_ifs
  · apply extend_mono_f
  · intro y hy
    rw [closeImg, extend_mono_f]
    apply extend_mono_f _ _ _ hy
    exact extend_mono_dom _ _ _ hy
  · simp only [closeImg]
    intro y hy
    repeat rw [extend_mono_f _ _ _]
    all_goals repeat apply extend_mono_dom
    all_goals assumption
  · intro y hy
    rw [extend_mono_f]
    exact add_mono_f _ _ _ _ _ hy
    exact add_mono_dom _ _ _ _ _ hy

name: mem_closureSeq
statement:
theorem mem_closureSeq (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    x ∈ (f.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [closureSeq.eq_def]
  simp only [Denumerable.ofNat_encode _]
  apply close_dom

name: mem_f_closureSeq
statement:
theorem mem_f_closureSeq (f : PartialSolution) (x : A) :
    (f.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).f x ∈ (f.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).Dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [closureSeq.eq_def]
  simp only [Denumerable.ofNat_encode _]
  apply close_f_dom

name: closureSeq_mono
statement:
theorem closureSeq_mono (f : PartialSolution) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ f.Dom → x ∈ (f.closureSeq n).Dom
proof:
:= by
  induction n
  · simp [closureSeq]
  next k ih =>
    rw [closureSeq]
    intro x hx
    apply (f.closureSeq k).close_mono _ _ (ih x hx)

name: closureSeq_extends
statement:
theorem closureSeq_extends (f : PartialSolution) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ f.Dom → (f.closureSeq n).f x = f.f x
proof:
:= by
  induction n
  · simp [closureSeq]
  next k ih =>
    rw [closureSeq]
    intro x hx
    rw [(f.closureSeq k).close_extend _ x (f.closureSeq_mono _ _ hx)]
    exact ih x hx

name: closureSeq_ascDom
statement:
theorem closureSeq_ascDom (f : PartialSolution) (n k : ℕ) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ (f.closureSeq n).Dom → x ∈ (f.closureSeq (n+k)).Dom
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  · simp
  next k ih =>
    intro x hx
    rw [← add_assoc, closureSeq]
    exact (f.closureSeq _).close_mono _ _ (ih x hx)

name: closureSeq_asc
statement:
theorem closureSeq_asc (f : PartialSolution) (n k : ℕ) :
    ∀ x, x ∈ (f.closureSeq n).Dom → (f.closureSeq (n+k)).f x = (f.closureSeq n).f x
proof:
:= by
  induction k
  · simp
  next k ih =>
    intro x hx
    rw [← add_assoc, closureSeq]
    rw [(f.closureSeq _).close_extend _ x (f.closureSeq_ascDom _ _ _ hx)]
    exact ih x hx

name: closureLinear_eq_closureSeq
statement:
theorem closureLinear_eq_closureSeq (f : PartialSolution) (n : ℕ) (a : A) (hn : a ∈ (closureSeq f n).Dom) :
    f.closureLinear a = (f.closureSeq n).f a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [closureLinear]
  rcases le_total n (Encodable.encode a + 1) with h | h
  · obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.le.dest h
    rw [← hk]
    exact closureSeq_asc _ _ _ _ hn
  · obtain ⟨k,hk⟩ := Nat.le.dest h
    rw [← hk]
    symm
    apply closureSeq_asc
    apply mem_closureSeq

name: closureLinear_funeq
statement:
theorem closureLinear_funeq (f₀ : PartialSolution) :
    let f
proof:
:= closureLinear f₀;
    ∀ x, f (f (f x) - f x) = x - f x := by
  dsimp
  intro x
  have hx₁ : x ∈ (f₀.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).Dom :=
    f₀.mem_closureSeq x
  have hx₂ : (f₀.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).f x ∈ (f₀.closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)).Dom :=
    f₀.mem_f_closureSeq x
  rw [f₀.closureLinear_eq_closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1) x hx₁]
  rw [f₀.closureLinear_eq_closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1) _ hx₂]
  rw [f₀.closureLinear_eq_closureSeq (Encodable.encode x + 1)]
  · apply PartialSolution.Valid _ hx₁ hx₂
  · apply PartialSolution.Closed_sub _ hx₁ hx₂

name: closureLinear_extends
statement:
theorem closureLinear_extends (f₀ : PartialSolution) :
    ∀ x, (h : x ∈ f₀.Dom) → closureLinear f₀ x = f₀.f x
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ closureSeq_extends _ _ x

name: closure_prop
statement:
theorem closure_prop (f : PartialSolution) : ∀ x y,
    x = closure f (closure f y x) (closure f y (closure f y x))
proof:
:=
  fun x y ↦ by simp [closure, closureLinear_funeq f (x - y)]

name: Equation1491_facts
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Equation1491_facts : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Facts G [1491] [65]
proof:
:= by
  use A, ⟨initial.closure⟩
  simp only [Equation1491, not_forall]
  constructor
  · exact closure_prop initial
  · use 0, -x₁
    nth_rewrite 3 [closure]
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, initial.closureLinear_extends x₁ (by decide)]
    rw [show initial.f x₁ = x₂ by decide]
    nth_rewrite 2 [closure]
    rw [sub_zero, zero_add, add_comm, initial.closureLinear_extends (x₂+(-x₁)) (by decide)]
    rw [show initial.f (x₂+(-x₁)) = x₃ by decide]
    rw [closure]
    rw [sub_neg_eq_add, add_comm x₃, initial.closureLinear_extends (x₁+x₃) (by decide)]
    rw [show initial.f (x₁+x₃) = x₄ by decide]
    decide

name: MagmaHom.mk_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma MagmaHom.mk_apply {G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] {toFun : G → H}
    {map_op' : ∀ x y : G, toFun (x ◇ y) = toFun x ◇ toFun y} {x : G} :
  (MagmaHom.mk toFun map_op') x = toFun x
proof: := rfl

name: MagmaHom.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma MagmaHom.ext {G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] {f₁ f₂ : G →◇ H}
    (hf : ∀ x : G, f₁ x = f₂ x) :
    f₁ = f₂
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext f₁ f₂ hf

name: MagmaHom.map_op
statement:
lemma MagmaHom.map_op {G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] (f : G →◇ H) (x y : G) :
    f (x ◇ y) = f x ◇ f y
proof: := f.map_op' _ _

name: MagmaHom.comp_apply
statement:
lemma MagmaHom.comp_apply {G H I : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] [Magma I]
    (f₁ : G →◇ H) (f₂ : H →◇ I) (x : G) :
    (f₁.comp f₂) x = f₂ (f₁ x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagmaHom.comp_assoc
statement:
lemma MagmaHom.comp_assoc {G H I J : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] [Magma I] [Magma J]
    (f₁ : G →◇ H) (f₂ : H →◇ I) (f₃ : I →◇ J) :
    f₁.comp (f₂.comp f₃) = (f₁.comp f₂).comp f₃
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagmaHom.cancel_right
proof:
:=
  ⟨MagmaHom.ext ∘ hf.forall.2 ∘ DFunLike.ext_iff.1, (· ▸ rfl)⟩

name: MagmaHom.cancel_left
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun hf₁₂ ↦ MagmaHom.ext (fun _ ↦ hf (by rw [←MagmaHom.comp_apply, hf₁₂, MagmaHom.comp_apply])),
    (· ▸ rfl)⟩

name: MagmaHomClass.toMagmaHom_injective
statement:
lemma MagmaHomClass.toMagmaHom_injective {F G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] [FunLike F G H]
    [MagmaHomClass F G H] :
    Function.Injective ((↑) : F → (G →◇ H))
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ f ↦ DFunLike.ext _ _ (fun x ↦ congr_arg (·.toFun x) f)

name: MagmaHom.coe_coe
statement:
lemma MagmaHom.coe_coe {F G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] [FunLike F G H]
    [MagmaHomClass F G H] (f : F) :
    ((f : G →◇ H) : G → H) = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: MagmaEquiv.ext
statement:
@[ext]
lemma MagmaEquiv.ext {G H : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] {e₁ e₂ : G ≃◇ H}
    (hf : ∀ x : G, e₁ x = e₂ x) :
    e₁ = e₂
proof:
:=
  DFunLike.ext e₁ e₂ hf

name: MagmaEquiv.comp_assoc
statement:
lemma MagmaEquiv.comp_assoc {G H I J : Type*} [Magma G] [Magma H] [Magma I] [Magma J]
    (e₁ : G ≃◇ H) (e₂ : H ≃◇ I) (e₃ : I ≃◇ J) :
    e₁.comp (e₂.comp e₃) = (e₁.comp e₂).comp e₃
proof:

name: models_iff_n
statement:
theorem models_iff_n (law : NatMagmaLaw) (n) (h : law.bounded n) (G : Type _) [Magma G] :
    G ⊧ law ↔ ModelsIffType G law n [] h
proof:
:= by
  suffices ∀ n k (h : law.bounded (n + k)),
      G ⊧ law ↔ ∀ xs (h' : xs.length = k), ModelsIffType G law n xs (h' ▸ h) by
    refine (this n 0 h).trans ?_
    exact ⟨fun H => H [] rfl, fun H xs h => by cases List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 h; assumption⟩
  intro n k h
  induction n generalizing k with
  | succ n ih =>
    refine (ih (k+1) (by rwa [Nat.succ_add] at h)).trans ?_
    simp only [ModelsIffType]
    exact ⟨fun H xs hxs x => H _ (hxs ▸ rfl), fun | H, x::xs, h => H xs (Nat.succ.inj h) x⟩
  | zero =>
    simp only [Nat.zero_add, Law.MagmaLaw.bounded_iff] at h
    rw [← satisfies_pmap_mk _ h, satisfies]
    let eqv : {xs : List G // xs.length = k} ≃ ({a // a < k} → G) := {
      toFun := fun ⟨xs, hx⟩ ⟨i, hi⟩ => xs[i]'(hx ▸ hi)
      invFun := fun f => ⟨List.ofFn fun i => f ⟨i.1, i.2⟩, by simp⟩
      left_inv := fun ⟨_, _⟩ => by subst k; simp
      right_inv := fun _ => by simp
    }
    let rev : {xs : List G // xs.length = k} ≃ {xs : List G // xs.length = k} := {
      toFun := fun ⟨xs, hx⟩ => ⟨xs.reverse, by simp [hx]⟩
      invFun := fun ⟨xs, hx⟩ => ⟨xs.reverse, by simp [hx]⟩
      left_inv := fun ⟨_, _⟩ => by simp
      right_inv := fun ⟨_, _⟩ => by simp
    }
    simp only [← eqv.forall_congr_right, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, eqv,  ModelsIffType]
    refine Iff.trans (forall_congr' fun ⟨xs, hx⟩ => ?_)
      ((rev.forall_congr_right
        (q := fun xs => law.evalBounded xs.1 (by simpa [xs.2] using h))).symm.trans Subtype.forall)
    clear eqv rev; subst k
    have (m : FreeMagma Nat) (h) : m.evalBounded xs h =
        (m.pmap fun a h' ↦ ⟨a, h a h'⟩) ⬝ (fun x : {a//a<xs.length} ↦ xs.get ⟨x.1, x.2⟩) := by
      induction m <;> simp [FreeMagma.pmap, FreeMagma.evalInMagma, FreeMagma.evalBounded, *]
    simp [satisfiesPhi, MagmaLaw.pmap, MagmaLaw.evalBounded, this]

name: PartialSolution.le_def
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_def {a b : PartialSolution G} : a ≤ b ↔
  a.E0 ≤ b.E0 ∧ a.E1 ≤ b.E1 ∧ Set.EqOn a.f.uncurry b.f.uncurry a.E1
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: PartialSolution.t_mem_of_mem_E0
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.t_mem_of_mem_E0 (f : PartialSolution G) {x : G × G} (hx : x ∈ f.E0) :
    f.g x ∈ f.E1
proof: := f.t_mem_of_mem_E0' x hx

name: PartialSolution.undef_of_not_mem_E0
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.undef_of_not_mem_E0 (f : PartialSolution G) (x : G × G) (hx : x ∉ f.E0)
    (hx2 : x ∈ f.E1) : f.g x ∉ f.E1
proof: := f.undef_of_not_mem_E0' x (by simp [*])

name: PartialSolution.le_move_rev_good
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_move_rev_good (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) :
    f ≤ f.move_rev_good x y z h1 h2 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy
proof:
:= by
  simp only [move_rev_good, Finset.union_assoc, le_def, Finset.le_eq_subset,
    Finset.subset_union_left, true_and]
  rintro ⟨x', y'⟩ mem
  simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair]
  rw [if_neg, if_neg]
  · exact hz1 _ mem
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact h1 mem

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) :
    (y, x) ∈ (f.move_rev_good x y z h1 h2 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy).E1
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_good]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.move_rev_good x y z h1 h2 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy).E0
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_good, hbm, hp]

name: PartialSolution.le_move_rev_bad
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_move_rev_bad (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) :
    f ≤ f.move_rev_bad x y z h1 h2 h22 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy
proof:
:= by
  simp only [move_rev_bad, Finset.union_assoc, le_def, Finset.le_eq_subset,
    Finset.subset_union_left, true_and]
  rintro ⟨x', y'⟩ mem
  simp only [Function.uncurry_apply_pair]
  rw [if_neg, if_neg]
  · exact hz1 _ mem
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    exact h1 mem

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) :
    (y, x) ∈ (f.move_rev_bad x y z h1 h2 h22 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy).E1
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_bad]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (z : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) (hz1 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.2 ≠ z)
    (hz2 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, f.f x.1 x.2 ≠ z) (hz3 : ∀ x ∈ f.E1, x.1 ≠ z)
    (hzx : z ≠ x) (hzy : z ≠ y) (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.move_rev_bad x y z h1 h2 h22 hz1 hz2 hz3 hzx hzy).E0
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_bad, hbm, hp]

name: Denumerable.notMemFinset_prop
statement: theorem Denumerable.notMemFinset_prop (s : Finset G) : Denumerable.notMemFinset s ∉ s
proof:
:= by
  simp only [notMemFinset, Finset.mem_image, not_exists, not_and]
  intro mem
  have : Nat.find (Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (s.image Encodable.encode)) ∈ s.image Encodable.encode := by
    rw [Finset.mem_image]
    exact ⟨_, mem, by simp⟩
  have : Nat.find (Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (s.image Encodable.encode)) ∉ s.image Encodable.encode :=
    Nat.find_spec (Infinite.exists_notMem_finset (s.image Encodable.encode))
  contradiction

name: PartialSolution.le_move_rev_good'
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_move_rev_good' (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) : f ≤ f.move_rev_good' x y h1 h2
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_good', le_move_rev_good]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good'
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good' (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) : (y, x) ∈ (f.move_rev_good' x y h1 h2).E1
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_good', mem_move_rev_good]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good'_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_good'_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1 → f.f x y ≠ x) (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.move_rev_good' x y h1 h2).E0
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_good', mem_move_rev_good_of_app_eq, hbm, hp]

name: PartialSolution.le_move_rev_bad'
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_move_rev_bad' (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) : f ≤ f.move_rev_bad' x y h1 h2 h22
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_bad', le_move_rev_bad]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad'
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad' (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) : (y, x) ∈ (f.move_rev_bad' x y h1 h2 h22).E1
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_bad', mem_move_rev_bad]

name: PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad'_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_move_rev_bad'_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (h2 : (x, y) ∈ f.E1) (h22 : f.f x y = x) (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.move_rev_bad' x y h1 h2 h22).E0
proof:
:= by
  simp [move_rev_bad', mem_move_rev_bad_of_app_eq, hbm, hp]

name: PartialSolution.le_act
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_act (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1) :
    f ≤ f.act x y h1
proof:
:= by
  unfold act
  split
  · apply le_move_rev_good'
  · apply le_move_rev_bad'

name: PartialSolution.mem_act
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_act (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1) :
    (y, x) ∈ (f.act x y h1).E1
proof:
:= by
  unfold act
  split
  · apply mem_move_rev_good'
  · apply mem_move_rev_bad'

name: PartialSolution.mem_act_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_act_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) (h1 : (y, x) ∉ f.E1)
    (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.act x y h1).E0
proof:
:= by
  unfold act
  split
  · apply mem_move_rev_good'_of_app_eq <;> assumption
  · apply mem_move_rev_bad'_of_app_eq <;> assumption

name: PartialSolution.le_add_e1
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_add_e1 (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) :
    f ≤ f.add_e1 x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold add_e1
  split
  · rfl
  · apply le_act

name: PartialSolution.mem_add_e1
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_add_e1 (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) :
    (y, x) ∈ (f.add_e1 x y).E1
proof:
:= by
  unfold add_e1
  split
  · assumption
  · apply mem_act

name: PartialSolution.mem_add_e1_of_app_eq
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_add_e1_of_app_eq (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G)
    (a : G) (hbm : (a, y) ∈ f.E1) (hp : f.f a y = x) :
    (a, y) ∈ (f.add_e1 x y).E0
proof:
:= by
  unfold add_e1
  split
  · by_contra! nh
    apply f.undef_of_not_mem_E0 _ nh hbm
    simpa [g, hp]
  · apply mem_act_of_app_eq <;> assumption

name: PartialSolution.le_add_e0
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.le_add_e0 (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) :
    f ≤ f.add_e0 x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold add_e0
  trans f.add_e1 x y <;> apply le_add_e1

name: PartialSolution.mem_add_e0
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.mem_add_e0 (f : PartialSolution G) (x y : G) :
    (y, x) ∈ (f.add_e0 x y).E0
proof:
:= by
  apply mem_add_e1_of_app_eq
  · apply mem_add_e1
  · rfl

name: closureSeq_le_closureSeq_succ
statement:
lemma closureSeq_le_closureSeq_succ (f : PartialSolution G) (n : ℕ) :
    closureSeq f n ≤ closureSeq f (n + 1)
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.le_add_e0 ..

name: mem_closureSeq_e0
statement:
lemma mem_closureSeq_e0 (f : PartialSolution G) (a b : G) :
    (a, b) ∈ (closureSeq f (Encodable.encode (a, b) + 1)).E0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [closureSeq, Denumerable.ofNat_encode]
  apply PartialSolution.mem_add_e0

name: closureSeq_mono
statement: lemma closureSeq_mono (f : PartialSolution G) : Monotone (closureSeq f)
proof:
:= by
  intro n m hnm
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hnm
  clear hnm
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m hm => exact hm.trans (closureSeq_le_closureSeq_succ ..)

name: le_closureSeq
statement: lemma le_closureSeq (f : PartialSolution G) (n : ℕ) : f ≤ closureSeq f n
proof:
:=
  closureSeq_mono f (Nat.zero_le n)

name: closure_eq_of_mem_e1
statement:
lemma closure_eq_of_mem_e1 (f : PartialSolution G) (n : ℕ) (a b : G) (hn : (a, b) ∈ (closureSeq f n).E1) :
    closure f a b = (closureSeq f n).f a b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [closure]
  rcases le_total n (Encodable.encode (a, b) + 1) with h | h
  · exact (closureSeq_mono f h).2.2.symm hn
  · exact (closureSeq_mono f h).2.2 (PartialSolution.E0_subset_E1 _ (mem_closureSeq_e0 f a b))

name: closure_prop
statement: theorem closure_prop (f : PartialSolution G) : ∀ x y, closure f x (closure f y (closure f x y)) = y
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  rw [closure_eq_of_mem_e1 f (Encodable.encode (x, y) + 1) x y,
    closure_eq_of_mem_e1 f (Encodable.encode (x, y) + 1) y,
    closure_eq_of_mem_e1 f (Encodable.encode (x, y) + 1)]
  · exact PartialSolution.eq_of_mem_E0 _ _ (mem_closureSeq_e0 ..)
  · exact PartialSolution.mem_2_of_mem_E0 _ _ (mem_closureSeq_e0 ..)
  · exact PartialSolution.t_mem_of_mem_E0' _ _ (mem_closureSeq_e0 ..)
  · exact PartialSolution.E0_subset_E1 _ (mem_closureSeq_e0 ..)

name: Equation65_facts
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Equation65_facts : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Facts G [65] [614, 817, 1426, 3862, 4065]
proof:
:= by
  use ℕ, ⟨closure initial⟩
  simp only [Equation65, closure_prop, implies_true, not_forall, true_and]
  split_ands
  repeat {
    use 0
    nth_rw 4 [closure_eq_of_mem_e1 _ 0]
    nth_rw 3 [closure_eq_of_mem_e1 _ 0]
    nth_rw 2 [closure_eq_of_mem_e1 _ 0]
    nth_rw 1 [closure_eq_of_mem_e1 _ 0]
    · decide
    · decide
    · decide
    · decide
    · decide
  }

name: Soundness'_u
statement:
theorem Soundness'_u {α β G : Type*} [Magma G] {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} (h : Γ ⊢' E) :
    G ⊧ Γ → G ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | @SubstAx E mem σ =>
    intro H φ
    simp only [satisfiesPhi, SubstEval]
    exact H E mem _
  | Ref => exact fun _ ↦ congrFun rfl
  
  | @Sym t u _ ih =>
    intro φ mset
    rw [satisfiesPhi]
    symm; apply ih; trivial
  | Trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro φ mset
    rw [satisfiesPhi, ih₁, ih₂] <;> trivial
  | Cong _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro _ _
    rw [satisfiesPhi, evalInMagma]
    rw [ih₁, ih₂] <;> trivial

name: Soundness'
statement: theorem Soundness' {α β : Type*} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} (h : Γ ⊢' E) : Γ ⊧ E
proof:
:=
  fun _ => Soundness'_u h

name: Soundness
statement: theorem Soundness {α : Type*} {Γ : Ctx α} {E} (h : Γ ⊢ E) : Γ ⊧ E
proof:
:=
  Soundness' (derive'_of_derive h)

name: RelOfLaws.isEquivalence
statement: theorem RelOfLaws.isEquivalence {α} (β) (Γ : Ctx α) : Equivalence (RelOfLaws β Γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> simp [RelOfLaws]
  case refl => exact fun _ ↦ ⟨derive'.Ref⟩
  case symm => exact fun h ↦ ⟨derive'.Sym h⟩
  case trans => exact fun h₁ h₂ ↦ ⟨derive'.Trans h₁ h₂⟩

name: SetoidOfLaws.iff
statement:
theorem SetoidOfLaws.iff {α} (β) (Γ : Ctx α) (x y : FreeMagma β) :
    let _
proof:
:= SetoidOfLaws β Γ; x ≈ y ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' x ≃ y) := by
  rfl

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.inductionOn
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.inductionOn {α β} {Γ : Ctx α} {motive : FreeMagmaWithLaws β Γ → Prop}
    (q : FreeMagmaWithLaws β Γ)
    (h : (a : FreeMagma β) → motive (embed _ a))
    : motive q
proof: := Quotient.inductionOn q h

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.eq
statement:
theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.eq {α β} {Γ : Ctx α} {x y : FreeMagma β} :
    embed Γ x = embed Γ y ↔ Nonempty (Γ ⊢' x ≃ y)
proof: := Quotient.eq

name: embed_fork
statement:
theorem embed_fork {α β} (Γ : Ctx α) (a b : FreeMagma β) :
    embed Γ (a ◇ b) = embed Γ a ◇ embed Γ b
proof: := rfl

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalInMagmaIsQuot
statement:
theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalInMagmaIsQuot {α β γ} (Γ : Ctx α)
    (t : FreeMagma β) (σ : β → FreeMagma γ) :
    t ⬝ (embed Γ ∘ σ) = embed Γ (t ⬝ σ)
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rw [evalInMagma]
  case Leaf => rfl
  case Fork =>
    simp only [Magma.op, ForkWithLaws]
    repeat rw [FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalInMagmaIsQuot]
    rw [Quotient.lift₂]
    apply Quot.sound; rw [evalInMagma]
    exact ⟨derive'.Ref⟩

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.isDerives
statement:
theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.isDerives {α β} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    FreeMagmaWithLaws β Γ ⊧ E → Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:= by
  simp [satisfies, satisfiesPhi]
  intro eq; have h := eq (LfEmbed Γ)
  simp only [LfEmbed] at h
  repeat rw [FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalInMagmaIsQuot] at h
  have h' := Quotient.exact h
  simp [SetoidOfLaws.iff] at h'
  repeat rw [evalInMagma_leaf] at h'
  exact h'

name: PhiAsSubst_aux
statement:
theorem PhiAsSubst_aux {α β γ} (Γ : Ctx α) (φ : β → FreeMagmaWithLaws γ Γ) :
    ∃ (σ : β → FreeMagma γ), ∀ x, φ x = embed Γ (σ x)
proof:
:= by
  refine Classical.axiomOfChoice (r := λ x y ↦ φ x = (embed Γ) y) fun x ↦ ?_
  have ⟨a, h⟩ := (Quotient.exists_rep (φ x))
  exact ⟨a, h.symm⟩

name: PhiAsSubst
statement:
theorem PhiAsSubst {α β γ} (Γ : Ctx α) (φ : β → FreeMagmaWithLaws γ Γ) :
  ∃ (σ : β → FreeMagma γ), φ = (embed Γ) ∘ σ
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨σ, h⟩ := PhiAsSubst_aux Γ φ
  exact ⟨σ, funext fun _ ↦ h _⟩

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.isModel
statement: theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.isModel {α} (β) (Γ : Ctx α) : FreeMagmaWithLaws β Γ ⊧ Γ
proof:
:= by
  intro E mem φ
  simp only [satisfiesPhi]
  have ⟨σ, eq_sig⟩ := (PhiAsSubst _ φ)
  rw [eq_sig]
  repeat rw [FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalInMagmaIsQuot]
  exact Quotient.sound ⟨derive'.SubstAx mem _⟩

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.models_iff_u.
statement:
theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.models_iff_u.{u} {α} {β : Type u} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    (∀ (G : Type u) [Magma G], G ⊧ Γ → G ⊧ E) ↔ FreeMagmaWithLaws β Γ ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun H => H _ (FreeMagmaWithLaws.isModel _ _), fun H => ?_⟩
  have ⟨h'⟩ := FreeMagmaWithLaws.isDerives H
  exact fun G => Soundness'_u h'

name: models_def'
statement:
theorem models_def' {α β} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} :
    Γ ⊧ E ↔ ∀ (G : Type*) [Magma G], G ⊧ Γ → G ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro H G _ h
  · classical
    rw [← models_toNat] at H
    have ⟨h'⟩ := FreeMagmaWithLaws.isDerives (FreeMagmaWithLaws.models_iff_u.1 H)
    exact satisfies_toNat.1 (Soundness'_u h' h)
  · exact (satisfies_equiv uliftMagmaEquiv).2 (H _ ((satisfiesSet_equiv uliftMagmaEquiv).1 h))

name: Completeness'
statement: theorem Completeness' {α β} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw β} (h : Γ ⊧ E) : Nonempty (Γ ⊢' E)
proof:
:=
  FreeMagmaWithLaws.isDerives (models_def'.1 h _ (FreeMagmaWithLaws.isModel β Γ))

name: Completeness
statement: theorem Completeness {α} {Γ : Ctx α} {E : MagmaLaw α} (h : Γ ⊧ E) : Nonempty (Γ ⊢ E)
proof:
:=
  match Completeness' h with
  | .intro x => .intro (derive_of_derive' x)

name: FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalHom_leaf
statement:
@[simp] theorem FreeMagmaWithLaws.evalHom_leaf {α β G} {Γ : Ctx α} (φ : β → G) [Magma G]
    (modelsG : G ⊧ Γ) (a : β) : evalHom φ modelsG (embed _ (Leaf a)) = φ a
proof: := rfl

name: eq_app
statement: lemma eq_app : ∀ α β (f g : α → β), f = g → ∀ x, f x = g x
proof: := fun _ _ _ _ a x ↦ congrFun a x

name: Quot.liftEq
statement:
lemma Quot.liftEq {α β} [s : Setoid α] (f g : Quotient s → β) (h : f ∘ (⟦.⟧) = g ∘ (⟦.⟧)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine funext fun x => ?_
  let ⟨ x_bar, eq_x ⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep x
  exact eq_x ▸ congrFun h x_bar

name: FreeMagma.EvalFreeMagmaWithLawsUniversalProperty
proof:
:= by
  intro eq
  let ψ' := (FreeMagmaWithLaws.mkMor Γ).comp ψ
  let φ' := FreeMagmaWithLaws.eval φ modelsG ∘ (⟦.⟧)
  have h : φ' = ψ' := by
    simp only [DFunLike.coe]
    rw [← EvalFreeMagmaUniversalProperty φ]
    . simp only [FreeMagmaWithLaws.eval, φ']
      exact funext fun x ↦ rfl
    . rw [← eq]
      simp only [MagmaHom.comp, FreeMagmaWithLaws.mkMor, ψ']
      rfl
  exact Quot.liftEq (s := _) _ _ h

name: eqn1485
statement: theorem eqn1485 : Equation1485 G
proof:
:= fun _ _ _ => (eqn ..).symm

  /

name: dual_eqn
statement: theorem dual_eqn (x y z : G) : ((y ◇ z) ◇ x) ◇ (x ◇ y) = x
proof:
:= by
  conv in _ ◇ y => rw [← eqn y, eqn z z z]
  apply eqn

name: Path.def'
statement: theorem Path.def' {x y : G} : Path x y ↔ ∃ z, x ◇ z = y
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨z, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨_, by rw [← eqn z z z, dual_eqn]⟩
  · exact ⟨_, by rw [← eqn z z z, eqn]⟩

name: isGood_five
statement: theorem isGood_five {a b c d e : G} : IsGood a b c → IsGood c d e → Path e a → IsGood b c d
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl rfl ⟨_, rfl⟩; exact (eqn ..).symm

name: toRelaxed.isStrict
statement: theorem toRelaxed.isStrict : (toRelaxed G).IsStrict
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ _ _ rfl; rfl

name: PreExtension.induced_mono
statement:
theorem PreExtension.induced_mono {E E' : PreExtension G} (H : E ≤ E') {x y : ExtBase G} :
    E.induced x y ⊆ E'.induced x y

name: Extension.next
statement:
theorem Extension.next (E : Extension G) (a b) :
    ∃ E' : Extension G, E ≤ E' ∧ (E'.1.induced a b).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical if h : (E.1.induced a b).Nonempty then exact ⟨_, le_rfl, h⟩ else
  let ⟨l, hl⟩ := Infinite.exists_notMem_finset <|
    (insert a <| insert b <| E.1.image (·.1) ∪ E.1.image (·.2)).image (·.2)
  let c : ExtBase G := (a.1 ◇ b.1, l)
  refine ⟨⟨insert (a, c) (insert (c, b) E.1), ?_, fun x y z hz w hw => ?_⟩,
    fun _ => (by simp [·]), c, op_isGood .., by simp⟩
  · simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Prod.mk.injEq, or_imp, and_imp, forall_and,
      forall_eq_apply_imp_iff, forall_eq]
    exact have ⟨h1, h2⟩ := (isGood_path (op_isGood ..)); ⟨h1, h2, E.2.1⟩
  · simp only [PreExtension.induced, Finset.mem_insert, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hz hw
    have ⟨hl1, hl2, hl3⟩ : a ≠ c ∧ b ≠ c ∧ ∀ {x y} (h : (x, y) ∈ E.1), x ≠ c ∧ y ≠ c := by
      simp only [Finset.image_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_union,
        Prod.exists, exists_and_right, exists_eq_right, not_or, not_exists, not_and, or_imp,
        forall_exists_index, forall_and] at hl

name: exists_extension
statement:
theorem exists_extension :
    ∃ op : ExtBase G → ExtBase G → ExtBase G, ∃ E : ExtBase G → ExtBase G → Prop,
    (∀ a b c, c = op a b ↔ IsGood a.1 c.1 b.1 ∧ E a c ∧ E c b) ∧
    (∀ a b, (a, b) ∈ e₀.1 → E a b) ∧
    (∀ a b, E a b → Path a.1 b.1)
proof:
:= by
  have ⟨c, hc, h1, _, h3⟩ := exists_greedy_chain
    (task := fun x : _ × _ => {e | (e.1.induced x.1 x.2).Nonempty}) (fun E ⟨a, b⟩ => E.next a b) e₀
  simp only [Subtype.exists, Prod.forall] at h3
  choose f hf1 hf2 op hop using h3
  refine ⟨op, fun a b => ∃ e ∈ c, (a, b) ∈ e.1, ?_, fun a b H => ⟨_, h1, H⟩, ?_⟩
  · refine fun a b c => ⟨fun H => ?_, fun ⟨h1, ⟨i, hi, h2⟩, ⟨j, hj, h3⟩⟩ => ?_⟩
    · exact let ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hop a b; H ▸ ⟨h1, ⟨_, hf2 _ _, h2⟩, ⟨_, hf2 _ _, h3⟩⟩
    · have ⟨k, hk, ik, jk⟩ := hc.directedOn _ hi _ hj
      have ⟨l, _, kl, fl⟩ := hc.directedOn _ hk _ (hf2 a b)
      exact l.2.2 _ _ ⟨h1, le_trans ik kl h2, le_trans jk kl h3⟩ ((f ..).induced_mono fl (hop a b))
  · exact fun a b ⟨i, _, hi⟩ => i.2.1 a b hi

  obtain ⟨G', G'Magma, h3994, h3588⟩ := Equation3994_not_implies_Equation3588
  refine ⟨Op G', opMagma, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h1 : Equation3994 G' ↔ Equation3588 (Op G') := forall_comm
    rwa [h1] at h3994
  · have h2 : Equation3994 (Op G') ↔ Equation3588 G' := forall_comm
    rwa [←h2] at h3588

name: Finite.Equation206_implies_Equation1648
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Finite.Equation206_implies_Equation1648 (G : Type*) [Magma G] [Finite G] (h : Equation206 G) : Equation1648 G
proof:
:= by
  intro x y
  let S : Set G := Set.univ
  have m1 : S.MapsTo (· ◇ y) S := by
    intro
    simp [S]
  have t : S.SurjOn (· ◇ y) S := by
    intro x _
    let z := x ◇ (x ◇ y)
    use z
    simp [S, z]
    apply Eq.symm (h x y)
  rw [Set.Finite.surjOn_iff_bijOn_of_mapsTo (Set.toFinite _) m1] at t
  apply t.injOn (by simp [S]) (by simp [S])
  simp
  apply h (x ◇ y)

name: zero_lt_degree_word_polynomial
statement:
theorem zero_lt_degree_word_polynomial (w: FreeMagma (Fin 2)) :
  FreeMagma.Mem 0 w → w.first = 1 → w.last = 1
  → 0 < (word_polynomial w).degree
proof:
:= by
  intros zero_mem_w first_w_eq_one last_w_eq_one
  suffices 2 ≤ (word_polynomial w).degree from
    Trans.trans (show 0 < 2 from by norm_num) this
  suffices word_polynomial w ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.X * (1 - Polynomial.X) ∣ word_polynomial w by
    have ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
    have : (Polynomial.X * (1 - Polynomial.X): Polynomial ℤ).degree = 2 := by
      compute_degree
        <;> decide
    rw [←this]
    apply Polynomial.degree_le_of_dvd
      <;> first | exact h1 | exact h2
  split_ands
  · clear * - zero_mem_w
    let r' := Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) (word_polynomial w)
    suffices ∀ (q: ℚ), 0 < q → q < 1 → 0 < Polynomial.eval q r' by
      unfold r' at *
      clear zero_mem_w
      revert this
      apply Function.mtr
      intro this
      simp_all only [ne_eq, Decidable.not_not, Polynomial.map_zero,
        Polynomial.eval_zero, lt_self_iff_false, imp_false, not_lt,
        not_forall, not_le, exists_prop]
      exists 1/2
      norm_num
    intros q zero_lt_q q_lt_one
    revert q zero_mem_w zero_lt_q q_lt_one
    suffices ∀ (q: ℚ), 0 < q → q < 1 → (0 ≤ Polynomial.eval q r' ∧
                (FreeMagma.Mem 0 w → 0 < Polynomial.eval q r')) by
      simp_all only [implies_true]
    induction w
    · rename_i z
      fin_cases z
      all_goals {
        simp_all only [word_polynomial, CharP.cast_eq_zero, sub_zero,
          Polynomial.map_one, Polynomial.eval_one, zero_le_one,
          FreeMagma.Mem, Fin.zero_eta, zero_lt_one, imp_self,
          and_self, implies_true, r', word_polynomial,
          Nat.cast_one, sub_self, Polynomial.map_zero,
          Polynomial.eval_zero, le_refl, FreeMagma.Mem, Fin.mk_one,
          zero_ne_one, lt_self_iff_false, and_self,
          implies_true, r']
      }
    · rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
      intros q zero_lt_q q_lt_one
      replace h1 := h1 q zero_lt_q q_lt_one
      replace h2 := h2 q zero_lt_q q_lt_one
      simp_all [r', word_polynomial]
      split_ands
      · replace h1 := h1.1
        replace h2 := h2.1
        generalize Polynomial.eval q (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)
                                      (word_polynomial w1)) = q1 at *
        generalize Polynomial.eval q (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)
                                      (word_polynomial w2)) = q2 at *
        apply add_nonneg <;> apply mul_nonneg
        all_goals {
          try simp_all only [sub_nonneg]
          try { apply le_of_lt; assumption }
        }
      · have h12 := h1.2
        have h22 := h2.2
        intro mem_zero_w
        simp_all [FreeMagma.Mem]
        cases mem_zero_w
        · rename_i mem_zero_w1
          replace h12 := h12 mem_zero_w1
          apply add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
          · apply mul_pos <;> simp_all only [sub_pos]
          · simp_all only [mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left]
        · rename_i mem_zero_w2
          replace h22 := h22 mem_zero_w2
          apply add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
          · simp_all only [sub_pos, mul_nonneg_iff_of_pos_left]
          · positivity
  · clear * - first_w_eq_one last_w_eq_one
    revert w
    suffices (∀ (w: FreeMagma (Fin 2)), w.first = 1 → Polynomial.X ∣ word_polynomial w)
             ∧ (∀ (w: FreeMagma (Fin 2)), w.last = 1 → (1 - Polynomial.X) ∣ word_polynomial w) by
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := this
      intros w first_w_eq_one last_w_eq_one
      cases w
      · rename_i z
        fin_cases z
        all_goals {
          simp_all only [Fin.zero_eta, word_polynomial, CharP.cast_eq_zero, sub_zero, Fin.mk_one, Nat.cast_one, sub_self, dvd_zero, FreeMagma.first, FreeMagma.last]
          try contradiction
        }
      · rename_i w1 w2
        simp_all only [FreeMagma.first, FreeMagma.last, word_polynomial]
        replace h1 := h1 w1 first_w_eq_one
        replace h2 := h2 w2 last_w_eq_one
        obtain ⟨q1, hq1⟩ := h1
        obtain ⟨q2, hq2⟩ := h2
        exists q1 + q2
        simp only [hq1, hq2]
        ring_nf
    split_ands <;> intros w h
    · induction w
      · rename_i z
        simp_all only [FreeMagma.first, word_polynomial]
        norm_num
      · rename_i w1 w2 h1 _
        simp_all only [FreeMagma.first, word_polynomial, true_implies]
        clear * - h1
        obtain ⟨q1, hq1⟩ := h1
        simp_all only
        exists q1 * (1 - Polynomial.X) + (word_polynomial w2)
        ring_nf
    · induction w
      · rename_i z
        simp_all only [FreeMagma.last, word_polynomial]
        norm_num
      · rename_i w1 w2 _ h2
        simp_all only [FreeMagma.last, word_polynomial, true_implies]
        clear * - h2
        obtain ⟨q2, hq2⟩ := h2
        simp_all only
        exists q2 * Polynomial.X + (word_polynomial w1)
        ring_nf

name: Finite.two_variable_laws
statement:
theorem Finite.two_variable_laws {α: Type} [ht : Fintype α] (hc : Fintype.card α = 2) (E: Law.MagmaLaw α) :
  ∀ (z: α),
  FreeMagma.Mem z E.lhs
  → FreeMagma.Mem z E.rhs
  → ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Finite G ∧ ¬Equation2 G ∧ G ⊧ E
proof:
:= by
  intro x mem_x_lhs mem_x_rhs
  suffices hs: ∃ (k: ℕ), 1 < k ∧ (∃ (M: Magma (ZMod k)), ZMod k ⊧ E) by
    obtain ⟨k, hk, M, hm⟩ := hs
    exists ZMod k, M
    split_ands
    · refine' @Finite.of_fintype (ZMod k) ?_
      refine' @ZMod.fintype k ?_
      simp_all only [neZero_iff, ne_eq]
      omega
    · simp only [not_forall]
      refine' @Nontrivial.exists_pair_ne (ZMod k) ?_
      rw [ZMod.nontrivial_iff]
      omega
    · assumption
  revert α
  suffices hs: ∀ (E: Law.MagmaLaw (Fin 2)),
               FreeMagma.Mem 0 E.lhs
               → FreeMagma.Mem 0 E.rhs
               → ∃ (k: ℕ), 1 < k ∧ (∃ (M: Magma (ZMod k)), ZMod k ⊧ E) by
    intros α ht hc E x mem_x_lhs mem_x_rhs
    have := Classical.typeDecidableEq α
    let f : α → Fin 2 := fun z => if z = x then 0 else 1
    replace hs := hs (Law.MagmaLaw.map f E)
    have : Function.Injective f := by
      intro z1 z2 eq_z1_z2
      simp only [f] at eq_z1_z2
      split_ifs at eq_z1_z2
        <;> simp_all only [one_ne_zero, zero_ne_one]
      by_contra!
      rename_i ne_z2_x ne_z1_x ne_z1_z2
      have : Fintype.card α < Fintype.card α := by
        conv =>
          lhs
          rw [hc]
        apply Fintype.two_lt_card_iff.2
        exists x, z1, z2
        simp_rw [eq_comm] at ne_z2_x ne_z1_x
        grind only
      simp only [lt_self_iff_false] at this
    simp only [Law.satisfies_map_injective f this] at hs
    apply hs <;> simp only [Law.MagmaLaw.map]
    · clear * - mem_x_lhs
      generalize E.lhs = w at *
      revert mem_x_lhs
      induction w
        <;> simp_all only [FreeMagma.fmapHom, FreeMagma.evalHom, FreeMagma.evalInMagma,
          FreeMagma.Mem, MagmaHom.mk_apply, Function.comp_apply]
      · have : 0 = f x := by simp_all only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, f]
        rw [this]
        simp_all only [implies_true]
      · rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
        intro h
        cases h with
        | inl h =>
          replace h1 := h1 h
          apply Or.inl
          assumption
        | inr h =>
          replace h2 := h2 h
          apply Or.inr
          assumption
    · clear * - mem_x_rhs
      generalize E.rhs = w at *
      revert mem_x_rhs
      induction w
        <;> simp_all only [FreeMagma.fmapHom, FreeMagma.evalHom, FreeMagma.evalInMagma,
          FreeMagma.Mem, MagmaHom.mk_apply, Function.comp_apply]
      · have : 0 = f x := by simp_all only [Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, f]
        rw [this]
        simp_all only [implies_true]
      · rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
        intro h
        cases h with
        | inl h =>
          replace h1 := h1 h
          apply Or.inl
          assumption
        | inr h =>
          replace h2 := h2 h
          apply Or.inr
          assumption
  suffices hs: ∀ (w: FreeMagma (Fin 2)),
               (hw: FreeMagma.Mem 0 w)
               → ∃ (k: ℕ), 1 < k ∧ (∃ (M: Magma (ZMod k)), ZMod k ⊧ (Lf 0 ≃ w)) by
    intro E hz1 hz2
    match E with
    | ⟨FreeMagma.Fork w1 w2, FreeMagma.Fork w3 w4⟩
    | ⟨FreeMagma.Leaf a, FreeMagma.Leaf b⟩ =>
      exists 2
      simp_all only [Nat.one_lt_ofNat, true_and]
      exists Magma.mk fun _ _ => 0
      simp_all only [satisfies, satisfiesPhi, FreeMagma.Mem]
      intro _
      simp_all only [FreeMagma.evalInMagma, Magma.op]
    | ⟨FreeMagma.Leaf x, w ⋆ w'⟩
    | ⟨w ⋆ w', FreeMagma.Leaf x⟩ =>
      replace hs := hs (w ⋆ w')
      simp_all only [(by simp_all only [FreeMagma.Mem]: x = 0)]
      try
        .
          simp_all only [true_implies]
          obtain ⟨G, hm, hf, hex⟩ := hs
          exists G, hm, hf
          simp_all only [satisfies]
          intro φ
          replace hex := Law.satisfiesPhi_symm_law φ _ (hex φ)
          simp_all only [Law.MagmaLaw.symm]
  intros w hw
  by_cases h: w.first = 0 ∨ w.last = 0
  · clear hw
    exists 2
    simp_all only [Nat.one_lt_ofNat, true_and]
    cases h with
    | inl h =>
      exists Magma.mk fun x _ => x
      intro f
      simp_all only [←h]
      induction w
        <;> first | rfl | assumption
    | inr h =>
      exists Magma.mk fun _ y => y
      intro f
      simp_all only [←h]
      induction w
        <;> first | rfl | assumption
  · simp only [Fin.isValue, not_or] at h
    obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := h
    replace hl: w.first = 1 := by omega
    replace hr: w.last = 1 := by omega
    let r: Polynomial ℤ := word_polynomial w
    obtain ⟨b0, hb0⟩ := show ∃ (b0: ℤ), (Polynomial.eval b0 r - 1).natAbs ≠ 1 by
      suffices ∃ (b0: ℤ), Polynomial.eval b0 (r * (r - 2)) ≠ 0 by
        obtain ⟨b0, h⟩ := this
        exists b0
        revert h
        apply mt
        intro h
        simp only [Int.natAbs_eq_iff, Nat.cast_one, Int.reduceNeg, sub_eq_neg_self] at h
        cases h
        all_goals {
          simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub,
                    Polynomial.eval_ofNat, mul_eq_zero]
          first | { apply Or.inr; linarith } | { apply Or.inl; linarith }
        }
      suffices 0 < r.degree by
        replace this : 0 < (r * (r - 2)).degree := by
          suffices hr : r.degree ≤ (r * (r - 2)).degree from
            Trans.trans this hr
          simp only [Polynomial.degree_mul]
          suffices 0 < (r - 2).degree by
            have' := WithBot.add_lt_add_left (x := r.degree) _ this
            · simp_all only [add_zero, ge_iff_le]
              apply le_of_lt
              assumption
            · rename_i hr
              revert hr
              apply Function.mtr
              simp only [ne_eq, Polynomial.degree_eq_bot, Decidable.not_not, not_lt]
              intro hr0
              rw [hr0]
              simp only [Polynomial.degree_zero, bot_le]
          suffices (r - 2).degree = r.degree by simp_all only
          apply Polynomial.degree_sub_C
          assumption
        generalize r * (r - 2) = p at *
        revert this
        apply Function.mtr
        intro this
        simp_all only [ne_eq, not_exists, Decidable.not_not, not_lt]
        suffices p.degree = ⊥ by rw [this]; exact bot_le
        suffices p = 0 by subst this; exact Polynomial.degree_zero
        apply Polynomial.eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot
        simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot.def]
        simp_all only [Set.setOf_true]
        rw [Set.infinite_univ_iff]
        exact Int.infinite
      apply zero_lt_degree_word_polynomial <;> assumption
    suffices ∃ (k: ℕ), 1 < k ∧ Polynomial.eval b0 r = (1: ZMod k) by
      obtain ⟨k, ⟨one_lt_k, hk⟩⟩ := this
      exists k
      simp_all only [ne_eq, true_and]
      let M: Magma (ZMod k) := Magma.mk fun u v => (1 - b0) * u + b0 * v
      exists Magma.mk fun u v => (1 - b0) * u + b0 * v
      intro f
      simp only [satisfiesPhi]
      let g1 : Fin 2 → ZMod k := fun z => if z = 0 then f 0 - f 1 else 0
      let g2 : Fin 2 → ZMod k := fun z => if z = 0 then f 1 else f 1
      exact by symm; calc w ⬝ f
        _ = (w ⬝ g1) + (w ⬝ g2) := by
          clear * -
          simp only [Fin.isValue, ite_self, g1, g2]
          induction w <;> simp only [FreeMagma.evalInMagma, Fin.isValue]
          · rename_i z
            fin_cases z <;> simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, ↓reduceIte, sub_add_cancel,
                                       Fin.mk_one, one_ne_zero, zero_add]
          · rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
            simp only [h1, h2, Magma.op, Fin.isValue, M]
            ring_nf
        _ = (Polynomial.eval b0 r) * g1 0 + (w ⬝ g2) := by
          congr
          simp only [Fin.isValue, r, g1, ite_true]
          generalize f 0 - f 1 = u at *
          clear_value r
          clear * -
          induction w
            <;> simp only [FreeMagma.evalInMagma, word_polynomial]
          · rename_i z
            fin_cases z <;> simp_all only [Fin.zero_eta, ite_true, CharP.cast_eq_zero,
                              sub_zero, Polynomial.eval_one, Int.cast_one, one_mul, Fin.mk_one,
                              one_ne_zero, ite_false, Nat.cast_one, sub_self, Polynomial.eval_zero,
                              Int.cast_zero, zero_mul]
          · unfold M at *
            rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
            simp only [h1,
              h2,
              ←mul_assoc (c := u),
              ←right_distrib (c := u),
              ←Int.coe_castRingHom,
              ←RingHom.map_mul]
            simp only [Int.coe_castRingHom, Polynomial.eval_add,
                        Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_one,
                        Polynomial.eval_X]
            simp_all only [Fin.isValue, Int.cast_mul, Int.cast_add, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_one]
        _ = (Polynomial.eval b0 r) * (f 0 - f 1) + (w ⬝ g2) := by
          simp_all only [ite_true, g1]
        _ = f 0 - f 1 + (w ⬝ g2) := by
          congr
          rw [hk]
          ring_nf
        _ = f 0 - f 1 + f 1 := by
          congr
          clear * -
          simp only [g2]
          induction w
          · rename_i z
            fin_cases z <;> simp only [FreeMagma.evalInMagma, Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue,
                                       ↓reduceIte, Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero]
          · rename_i w1 w2 h1 h2
            simp_all only [mul_sub_right_distrib, one_mul, ite_self, FreeMagma.evalInMagma,
              Magma.op, M]
            ring_nf
        _ = f 0 := by
          simp_all only [sub_add_cancel]
    by_cases (Polynomial.eval b0 r - 1).natAbs = 0
    · exists 2
      simp only [Nat.one_lt_ofNat, true_and]
      apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      rw [←Int.cast_one]
      simp only [←Int.coe_castRingHom, ←RingHom.map_sub]
      simp only [Int.coe_castRingHom]
      rw [←Int.cast_zero]
      simp only [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff']
      norm_num
      rename_i h
      simp_all only [ne_eq, zero_ne_one, not_false_eq_true, Int.natAbs_eq_zero, Int.zero_emod]
    · let k: ℕ := (Polynomial.eval b0 r - 1).natAbs
      exists k
      split_ands
      · omega
      apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
      rw [←Int.cast_one]
      simp only [←Int.coe_castRingHom, ←RingHom.map_sub]
      simp only [Int.coe_castRingHom]
      rw [←Int.cast_zero]
      simp only [ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff']
      norm_num
      simp only [k, ←Int.dvd_iff_emod_eq_zero, Int.natAbs_dvd, dvd_refl]

  have sqRotate : ∀ x y z : G, (x ◇ y) ◇ (x ◇ y) = (y ◇ z) ◇ (y ◇ z) :=
    fun x y z ↦

  have sqConstInImage : ∀ x y z w : G, (x ◇ y) ◇ (x ◇ y) = (z ◇ w) ◇ (z ◇ w) :=
    fun x y z w ↦ (sqRotate x y z).trans (sqRotate y z w)
  exact fun x y ↦ h x x x ▸ h y y y ▸ sqConstInImage (x ◇ x) (x ◇ (x ◇ x)) (y ◇ y) (y ◇ (y ◇ y))

name: lem_fixf_implies_eq2
statement:
lemma lem_fixf_implies_eq2 {G: Type*} [Magma G] (h: Equation1689 G)
    (hfixf: ∀ b : G, ∃ c : G, f b c = b) : Equation2 G
proof:
:= by
  have fproj (a b : G) : f a b = b := by
    obtain ⟨c, hfbc⟩ := hfixf b
    unfold f at hfbc
    exact (hfbc ▸ (h b a c)).symm
  have eq30 (a b c : G) : a = (b ◇ a) ◇ c := by rw [← fproj a c, ← h]
  have eq6 (a b : G) : a = b ◇ b := by rw [eq30 a, ← eq30 b a]
  intro a b ; rw [eq6 a b, ← eq6]

name: lem_fixf
statement:
lemma lem_fixf {G: Type*} [Magma G] (h: Equation1689 G) :
    ∀ a : G, ∃ b : G, f a b = a
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have h1 : pow3 a = a ◇ pow5 a := (lem_1 h ..).symm
  have h2 : g (pow3 a) a = f a (pow5 a) := congrArg (· ◇ _) h1
  have h3 : g a (pow5 a) = f a (pow3 a) := by rw [← lem_2 h, h2]
  have h4 : a ◇ (g a (pow5 a)) = pow3 a := by rw [lem_2 h]
  use (g a (pow5 a))
  rw [f, h4, h3, ← h]

  simp only [Equiv.coe_fn_mk, lt_dom_bound (dom_l h), ↓reduceIte, lt_dom_bound (dom_r h),

name: full_spectrum_Equation1482
statement: theorem full_spectrum_Equation1482 : HasFullSpectrum [1482]
proof:
:= by
  intro n
  if h : n > 1 then
    let op (x y : Fin n) : Fin n := ⟨
      if y.1 = 1 then
        if x.1 > 1 then x.1
        else if x.1 = 1 then 0
        else 1
      else if x.1 = 1 && y.1 > 1 then y.1
      else 1,
      by
        repeat' split
        all_goals simp only [x.2, y.2, h, Nat.zero_lt_of_lt h]⟩
    use ⟨op⟩
    intro x _
    apply Fin.eq_mk_iff_val_eq.mpr

        and_false, ↓reduceIte, *]
      split
      . simp [*]
      . split
        . rfl
        . simp [show x.1 = 0 by omega]
    . simp only [false_and, ↓reduceIte, ite_eq_right_iff, imp_false, not_lt, *]
      split
      . simp [show ¬x.1 = 1 by omega, *]

        . simp [*]
        . simp [show x.1 = 0 by omega]
