name: IsChain.IsDirected
statement: lemma IsChain.IsDirected {α: Type} [Preorder α] {s: Set α} (h: IsChain (fun x y ↦ x ≤ y) s) [Nonempty s] : IsDirected s (fun x y ↦ x ≤ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← directedOn_univ_iff]
  convert (directedOn_image (s := Set.univ) (f := Subtype.val) (r := fun x y ↦ x ≤ y)).mp _
  convert IsChain.directedOn h
  exact Subtype.coe_image_univ s

name: use_chain
statement: lemma use_chain {sols : Set PartialSolution} (hchain: IsChain (fun (sol1 sol2 : PartialSolution) => sol1 ≤ sol2) sols ) (hnon: Nonempty sols) (htotal_L₀' : ∀ x : N, ∃ sol ∈ sols, x ∈ sol.Dom_L₀') (htotal_S' : ∀ x : N, ∃ sol ∈ sols, x ∈ sol.Dom_S') (htotal_op : ∀ (x y : N), ∃ sol ∈ sols, (x,y) ∈ sol.Dom_op) : ∃ (G: Type) (_: Magma G), Equation1729 G ∧ ¬ Equation817 G
proof:
:= by
  let f := Filter.atTop (α := sols)
  have fnon : f.NeBot := Filter.atTop_neBot_iff.mpr ⟨hnon, IsChain.IsDirected hchain⟩
  let S' (x : N) := (Set.choose (htotal_S' x)).1.S' x
  have S'_lim (x : N) : ∀ᶠ sol in f, x ∈ sol.1.Dom_S' ∧ sol.1.S' x = S' x := by
    set sol := Set.choose (htotal_S' x)
    set sol_spec := Set.choose_spec (htotal_S' x)
    apply Filter.Eventually.mono (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop sol)
    exact fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.2.2.1 sol_spec, (h.2.2.2.2.2 x sol_spec).symm⟩
  let op (x y:N) := (Set.choose (htotal_op x y)).1.op x y
  have op_lim (x y:N) : ∀ᶠ sol in f, (x,y) ∈ sol.1.Dom_op ∧ sol.1.op x y = op x y := by
    set sol := Set.choose (htotal_op x y)
    set sol_spec := Set.choose_spec (htotal_op x y)
    apply Filter.Eventually.mono (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop sol)
    exact fun _ h ↦ ⟨h.2.1 sol_spec, (h.2.2.2.2.1 (x,y) sol_spec).symm⟩
  classical 
  let L₀' (x : N) := (Set.choose (htotal_L₀' x)).1.L₀' x
  have L₀'_lim (x : N) : ∀ᶠ sol in f, x ∈ fill sol.1.Predom_L₀' ∧ sol.1.L₀' x = L₀' x := by
    set sol := Set.choose (htotal_L₀' x)
    set sol_spec := Set.choose_spec (htotal_L₀' x)
    apply Filter.Eventually.mono (Filter.eventually_ge_atTop sol)
    exact fun _ h ↦ ⟨fill_mono h.1 sol_spec , (h.2.2.2.1 x sol_spec).symm⟩
  apply @reduce_to_new_axioms S' L₀' op
  · ext x
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [L₀'_lim x, L₀'_lim (L₀' x)] with sol h1 h2
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨m, hx⟩, hy⟩ := h1.1
    change L₀' (L₀' x) = (e 0)⁻¹ * x
    have := sol.1.axiom_i'' y (sol.1.L₀' y) hy rfl m
    rw [← h2.2, ←h1.2, hx, this.2.1, this.2.2, <-mul_assoc]
    congr
    group
  · intro a x y h
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [L₀'_lim ((R' (S (a - S' x))) y), L₀'_lim ((R' (S (S' y))) ((R' (a - S' x)).symm (L₀' ((R' (S (a - S' x))) y)))), S'_lim x, S'_lim y] with sol h1 h2 h3 h4
    rw [← h2.2, ← h1.2, ← h3.2, ← h4.2]
    exact (sol.1.axiom_iii'' x y a h3.1 h4.1 h).2.2
  · intro x
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [L₀'_lim ((R' (S (S' x))) x), L₀'_lim ((R' (S (S' x))) ((R' (S' x)).symm (L₀' ((R' (S (S' x))) x)))), S'_lim x] with sol h1 h2 h3
    rw [← h2.2, ←h1.2, ←h3.2]
    exact (sol.1.axiom_iv'' x h3.1).2.2
  · intro x
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [op_lim x x, S'_lim x] with sol h1 h2
    rw [← h2.2, ←h1.2]
    exact (sol.1.axiom_v'' x h1.1).2
  · intro y a
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [op_lim (R' a y) y, S'_lim y] with sol h1 h2
    rw [← h2.2, ←h1.2]
    exact (sol.1.axiom_vi'' y a h1.1).2
  
  intro x y h h'
  have : ∃ z, op x y = Sum.inr z := by
    apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
    filter_upwards [op_lim x y] with sol h1
    rw [← h1.2]
    obtain ⟨z, this, _⟩ :=  sol.1.axiom_vii'' x y h h' h1.1
    exact ⟨z, this⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := this
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  apply (Filter.eventually_const (f := f)).mp
  filter_upwards [op_lim z x, op_lim x y, L₀'_lim ((R' 0) ((R' (S' x)) y)), S'_lim x] with sol h1 h2 h3 h4
  rw [← h1.2, ←h3.2, ←h4.2]
  have := sol.1.axiom_vii'' x y h h' h2.1
  obtain ⟨z', hz1, hz2⟩ := this
  rcases hz2 with hz2 | ⟨hz3, hz4, hz5, hz6⟩
  · have := (sol.1.axiom_P x y z' hz2).2.1
    aesop
  aesop

name: PartialSolution.see_direct
statement: lemma PartialSolution.see_direct (sol:PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {x : N} (h: sol.directly_sees extras x) : sol.sees extras x
proof: := generators_mono h

name: PartialSolution.see_direct'
statement: lemma PartialSolution.see_direct' (sol:PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {x : M} (h: sol.directly_sees' extras x) : sol.sees' extras x
proof: := generators_mono h

name: PartialSolution.sees_mul
statement: lemma PartialSolution.sees_mul (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {x y:N} (hx: sol.sees extras x) (hy: sol.sees extras y) : sol.sees extras (x * y)
proof:
:= calc
  _ ⊆ generators (basis_elements x ∪ basis_elements y)  := generators_mono <| basis_elements_of_mul x y
  _ = generators (basis_elements x) ∪ generators (basis_elements y) := generators_union ..
  _ ⊆ _ := Finset.union_subset hx hy

name: PartialSolution.sees_inv
statement: lemma PartialSolution.sees_inv (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {x : N} (hx: sol.sees extras x)  : sol.sees extras x⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [PartialSolution.sees]
  convert hx using 2
  exact basis_elements_of_inv x

name: PartialSolution.sees_iff
statement: lemma PartialSolution.sees_iff (sol:PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (x : N) : sol.sees extras x ↔ ∀ a ∈ basis_elements x, sol.reaches extras a
proof: := generators_subset_iff

name: PartialSolution.reaches_S
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_S (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} (h: sol.reaches extras a) : sol.reaches extras (S a)
proof: := S_in_generators h

name: PartialSolution.reaches_sum
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_sum (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a b : SM} (ha: sol.reaches extras a) (hb: sol.reaches extras b) : sol.reaches extras (a + b)
proof: := sum_in_generators ha hb

name: PartialSolution.reaches_diff
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_diff (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a b : SM} (ha: sol.reaches extras a) (hb: sol.reaches extras b) : sol.reaches extras (a - b)
proof: := diff_in_generators ha hb

name: PartialSolution.sees_e
statement: lemma PartialSolution.sees_e (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} (ha: sol.reaches extras a) : sol.sees extras (e a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sees_iff, basis_elements_of_generator, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
    forall_eq_or_imp, ha, forall_eq, zero_in_generators', and_self]

name: PartialSolution.reaches_zero
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_zero (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} : sol.reaches extras 0
proof: := zero_in_generators' _

name: PartialSolution.reaches_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_involved (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} (h: a ∈ sol.involved_elements extras) : sol.reaches extras a
proof: := mem_in_generators h

name: PartialSolution.reaches_shift_from_parent
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_shift_from_parent  (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} {x : N} (h: x = R' a (parent x)) (hx: sol.sees extras x) : sol.reaches extras a
proof: :=  (mem_in_generators <| shift_from_parent_mem_basis h).trans hx

name: PartialSolution.reaches_shift_to_parent
statement: lemma PartialSolution.reaches_shift_to_parent  (sol: PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} {x : N} (h: R' a x = parent x) (hx: sol.sees extras x) : sol.reaches extras a
proof: :=  (mem_in_generators <| shift_to_parent_mem_basis h).trans hx

name: PartialSolution.sees_R'_inv
statement: lemma PartialSolution.sees_R'_inv (sol:PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} {a : SM} {x : N} (ha: sol.reaches extras a) (hx: sol.sees extras x) : sol.sees extras <| (R' a).symm x
proof:
:= by
  change generators (basis_elements _) ⊆ _
  dsimp only [R', Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
  apply (generators_mono <| basis_elements_of_mul ..).trans
  rw [basis_elements_of_inv, basis_elements_of_generator, generators_union]
  apply Finset.union_subset _ hx
  rw [generators_subset_iff]
  intro b hb
  rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hb
  rcases hb with hb | hb <;> rw [hb]
  · exact ha
  · exact zero_in_generators' (sol.involved_elements extras)

name: PartialSolution.extras_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.extras_involved (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x : N} (hx: Sum.inr x ∈ extras) : sol.sees extras x
proof:
:= by
  apply sol.see_direct
  calc
    _ ⊆ Finset.biUnion extras basis_elements' := Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem _ hx
    _ ⊆ _ := Finset.subset_union_right

name: PartialSolution.dom_L
statement: lemma PartialSolution.dom_L₀'_involved' (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x : N} (hx: x ∈ sol.Dom_L₀') : sol.sees extras x
proof:
:= by
  apply sol.see_direct
  exact calc
    _ ⊆ Finset.biUnion sol.Predom_L₀' basis_elements := by
      obtain ⟨y, hxy, hy⟩ := hx
      exact basis_elements_of_rel hxy ▸ Finset.subset_biUnion_of_mem _ hy
    _ ⊆ _ := by norm_num

name: PartialSolution.dom_L
statement: lemma PartialSolution.dom_L₀'_involved (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x : N} (hx: x ∈ sol.Dom_L₀') : sol.sees extras x ∧ sol.sees extras (sol.L₀' x)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨sol.dom_L₀'_involved' extras hx, sol.dom_L₀'_involved' extras ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hxy, hy⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hxy
  have := sol.axiom_i'' y (sol.L₀' y) hy rfl n
  rw [hn, this.2.1]
  exact (fill_invar' _ _ n).mpr this.1

name: PartialSolution.dom_S'_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.dom_S'_involved (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x : N} (hx: x ∈ sol.Dom_S') : sol.sees extras x ∧ sol.S' x ∈ sol.involved_elements extras
proof:
:= by
    constructor
    · apply sol.see_direct
      intro a ha
      apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right ..
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨x, hx, ha⟩
    apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right ..
    exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem S' hx

name: PartialSolution.dom_op_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.dom_op_involved (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x y : N} (hxy: (x,y) ∈ sol.Dom_op) : sol.sees extras x ∧ sol.sees extras y ∧ sol.sees' extras (sol.op x y)
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine see_direct _ fun a ha ↦ ?_
      apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right _ _
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨(x,y), hxy, ha⟩
    · apply see_direct
      intro a ha
      apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right ..
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨(x,y), hxy, ha⟩
    apply see_direct'
    intro a ha
    apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right ..
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨(x,y), hxy, ha⟩

name: PartialSolution.I_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.I_involved (sol: PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) {x y z: N} (hxyz: (x,y,z) ∈ sol.I) : sol.sees extras x ∧ sol.sees extras y ∧ sol.sees extras z
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply see_direct
      intro a ha
      apply Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right ..
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨(x,y,z), hxyz, ha⟩
    · refine see_direct _ fun a ha ↦ Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion]
      exact ⟨(x,y,z), hxyz, ha⟩
    refine see_direct _ fun a ha ↦ Finset.mem_union_left _ <| Finset.mem_union_right _ ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
    exact ⟨(x,y,z), hxyz, ha⟩

name: PartialSolution.fresh_not_involved
statement: lemma PartialSolution.fresh_not_involved (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) : E (sol.fresh_generator extras n) ∉ sol.involved_elements extras
proof:
:= by
  have := fresh_not_in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) n
  contrapose! this
  exact mem_in_generators this

name: PartialSolution.fresh_not_in_gen
statement: lemma PartialSolution.fresh_not_in_gen (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) : ¬ in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n))
proof: := fresh_not_in_generators _ n

name: PartialSolution.fresh_invis
statement: lemma PartialSolution.fresh_invis (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) : ¬ sol.sees extras (e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)))
proof:
:= by
    by_contra h
    simp only [basis_elements_of_generator, sees_iff,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq, zero_in_generators', and_true, E_in_generators_iff] at h
    exact fresh_ne_generator (sol.involved_elements extras) n h

name: PartialSolution.fresh_invis_pow
statement: lemma PartialSolution.fresh_invis_pow (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) {m:ℕ} (hm: m ≠ 0): ¬ sol.sees extras ((e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)))^m)
proof:
:= by
    by_contra h
    simp only [basis_elements_of_generator_pow _ hm, sees_iff,
      Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq, zero_in_generators', and_true, E_in_generators_iff] at h
    exact fresh_ne_generator (sol.involved_elements extras) n h

name: PartialSolution.extend_not_rel
statement: lemma PartialSolution.extend_not_rel {sol:PartialSolution} {x y:N} {z : N} (hx: ¬ z ≈ x) (hy: ¬ z ≈ y) : sol.extend x y z = sol.L₀' z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [extend, hx, hy, if_false, if_false]

name: PartialSolution.enlarge_L
statement: lemma PartialSolution.enlarge_L₀'_extends {sol : PartialSolution} {x y:N} (hx: x ∉ sol.Dom_L₀') (hy: y ∉ sol.Dom_L₀') {z:N} (hz: z ∈ sol.Dom_L₀') : sol.extend x y z = sol.L₀' z
proof: := sol.enlarge_L₀'_extends' hx hy hz

name: PartialSolution.enlarge_L
statement: lemma PartialSolution.enlarge_L₀'_new {sol : PartialSolution} {x y:N} (hneq: ¬ y ≈ x) (n: ℤ) : sol.extend x y (e 0 ^ n * x) = e 0 ^ n * y ∧ sol.extend x y (e 0 ^ n * y) = e 0 ^ (n-1) * x
proof:
:= by
  unfold PartialSolution.extend
  have h1 : (e 0)^n * x ≈ x := Setoid.symm <| rel_of_mul ..
  have h2 : (e 0)^n * y ≈ y := Setoid.symm <| rel_of_mul ..
  have h3 : ¬ (e 0)^n * y ≈ x := by contrapose! hneq; exact Setoid.trans (Setoid.symm h2) hneq
  simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte, mul_inv_cancel_right, h3, h2, mul_left_inj, true_and]
  group

name: PartialSolution.enlarge_L
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.enlarge_L₀'_new' {sol : PartialSolution} {x y:N} (hneq: ¬ y ≈ x) : sol.extend x y x= y ∧
sol.extend x y y = (e 0)⁻¹ * x
proof:
:= by
  convert sol.enlarge_L₀'_new hneq 0
  all_goals group

name: PartialSolution.extend_axiom_i''
statement: lemma PartialSolution.extend_axiom_i'' {sol : PartialSolution} {x y:N} (hx: x ∉ sol.Dom_L₀') (hy: y ∉ sol.Dom_L₀') (hneq : ¬ y ≈ x) : Eq1729.axiom_i'' (sol.extend x y) (sol.Predom_L₀' ∪ {x,y})
proof:
:= by
  intro z w hz hw n
  simp only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] at hz
  rcases hz with rfl | hz | rfl
  · rw [(sol.enlarge_L₀'_new' hneq).1] at hw
    rw [← hw]
    refine ⟨?_, sol.enlarge_L₀'_new hneq n⟩
    simp only [fill, Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    use y
    simp only [or_true, and_true, Setoid.refl]
  · rw [← hw]
    rw [sol.enlarge_L₀'_extends' hx hy (subset_fill _ hz), sol.enlarge_L₀'_extends' hx hy ((fill_invar _ (rel_of_mul (L₀' z) n)).mp (axiom_i'' z (L₀' z) hz rfl 0).1), sol.enlarge_L₀'_extends' hx hy ((fill_invar' _ _ n).mpr (subset_fill _ hz))]
    refine ⟨?_, (axiom_i'' z (L₀' z) hz rfl n).2.1, (axiom_i'' z (L₀' z) hz rfl n).2.2⟩
    have h := (axiom_i'' z (L₀' z) hz rfl 0).1
    simp only [fill, Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := h
    refine ⟨u, hu, Or.inr (Or.inl hu')⟩
  have hyx : ¬ (e 0)^n * z ≈ x := by
    contrapose! hneq
    exact Setoid.trans (rel_of_mul z n) hneq
  rw [(sol.enlarge_L₀'_new' hneq).2] at hw
  rw [← hw]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [fill_union, Set.mem_union, fill_pair, fill_singleton]
    right; left
    use 1; group
  · rw [(sol.enlarge_L₀'_new hneq n).2]
    group
  group
  exact (sol.enlarge_L₀'_new hneq _).1

name: gen_fresh_not_in_fill
statement: lemma gen_fresh_not_in_fill (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) : e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)) ∉ sol.Dom_L₀'
proof:
:= by
  have := fresh_not_in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) n
  contrapose! this
  have h := (sol.dom_L₀'_involved extras this).1
  simp only [sol.sees_iff] at h
  simp only [h, basis_elements_of_generator, Finset.mem_insert_self]

name: gen_fresh_not_in_dom_S'
statement: lemma gen_fresh_not_in_dom_S' (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) : e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)) ∉ sol.Dom_S'
proof:
:= by
  have := fresh_not_in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) n
  contrapose! this
  have h := (sol.dom_S'_involved extras this).1
  simp only [sol.sees_iff] at h
  apply h
  simp only [basis_elements_of_generator, Finset.mem_insert_self]

name: gen_fresh_pow_not_in_dom_S'
statement: lemma gen_fresh_pow_not_in_dom_S' (sol : PartialSolution) (extras: Finset M) (n:ℕ) {m:ℕ} (hm: m ≠ 0): (e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)))^m ∉ sol.Dom_S'
proof:
:= by
  have := fresh_not_in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) n
  contrapose! this
  have h := (sol.dom_S'_involved extras this).1
  rw [sol.sees_iff] at h
  apply h
  simp only [basis_elements_of_generator_pow _ hm, Finset.mem_insert_self]

name: gen_fresh_not_rel_extra
statement: lemma gen_fresh_not_rel_extra (sol : PartialSolution) {extras: Finset M} (n:ℕ) {x : N} (hx: Sum.inr x ∈ extras) : ¬ e (E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)) ≈ x
proof:
:= by
  set d:= E (sol.fresh_generator extras n)
  by_contra! h
  replace h := basis_elements_of_rel h
  rw [basis_elements_of_generator] at h
  have : in_generators (sol.involved_elements extras) d := by
    have := sol.extras_involved extras hx
    rw [sol.sees_iff] at this
    simp only [this, ← h, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_or]
  simp only [in_generators, d, support_E, Finset.singleton_subset_iff] at this
  exact fresh_ne_generator (sol.involved_elements extras ) n this

name: enlarge_L
statement: lemma enlarge_L₀' (sol : PartialSolution) (x : N)  : ∃ sol', sol ≤ sol' ∧ x ∈ fill sol'.Predom_L₀' ∧ sol.Dom_S' = sol'.Dom_S'
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ sol.Dom_L₀'
  · exact ⟨sol, sol.refl, hx, rfl⟩
  set extras : Finset M := {Sum.inr x}
  set d := E <| sol.fresh_generator extras 0
  have hed : e d ∉ sol.Dom_L₀' := gen_fresh_not_in_fill sol extras 0
  have h_see_x : sol.sees extras x := by apply sol.extras_involved extras; simp [extras]
  have hd : 0 ≠ d := (E_ne_zero _).symm
  have hsd : S d ≠ d := (E_ne_SE _ _).symm
  have hsd' : 0 ≠ S d := (SE_ne_zero _).symm
  have hvalx : val d x = 0 := by
      apply val_of_nonsupp_eq_zero
      have : ¬ sol.reaches extras d := fresh_not_in_generators _ _
      contrapose! this
      rw [PartialSolution.reaches, in_generators]
      exact this.trans h_see_x
  have hvalx' : val (S d) x = 0 := by
      apply val_of_nonsupp_eq_zero
      have : ¬ sol.reaches extras (S d) := Sfresh_not_in_generators _ _
      contrapose! this
      rw [PartialSolution.reaches, in_generators]
      exact this.trans h_see_x
  have hcol1 (a : SM) (n:ℤ) : (e 0)^n * e d ≠ (R' a <| (R' (S a)).symm <| (e 0)^n * x)  := by
    by_contra! this
    by_cases h : a = d
    · rw [h] at this
      apply_fun val (S d) at this
      simp [R', hsd.symm, hvalx'] at this
    apply_fun val d at this
    by_cases h' : S a = d
    all_goals simp [R',hvalx,h,h'] at this
    linarith
  have hcol2 (a : SM) (n:ℤ): (e 0)^(n-1) * x ≠ (R' a <| (R' (S a)).symm <| (e 0)^n * e d) := by
    by_contra this
    by_cases h : a = d
    · rw [h] at this
      apply_fun val (S d) at this
      simp [R', hsd.symm, hsd', hvalx'] at this
    apply_fun val d at this
    by_cases h' : S a = d
    all_goals simp [R',hvalx,h,h',hd] at this
    exact E_ne_S _ _ h'.symm
  set sol' : PartialSolution := enlarge_L₀'_by hx hed (gen_fresh_not_rel_extra sol 0 (Finset.mem_singleton.mpr rfl)) hcol1 hcol2
  refine ⟨sol', ?_, ?_, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨Finset.subset_union_left, by rfl, by rfl, fun _ hx' ↦ ?_, fun _ _ ↦ rfl, fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩
    exact (sol.enlarge_L₀'_extends hx hed hx').symm
  apply subset_fill
  rw [Finset.mem_coe]
  apply Finset.mem_union_right
  simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_or]

name: enlarge_L
statement:
lemma enlarge_L₀'_multiple (sol : PartialSolution) (A: Finset N) :
    ∃ sol', sol ≤ sol' ∧ ↑A ⊆ fill sol'.Predom_L₀' ∧ sol.Dom_S' = sol'.Dom_S'
proof:
:= by
  induction' A using Finset.induction_on with x B hx hprev
  · exact ⟨sol, by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨sol_prev, hsol_le_solprev, hb_subset, h_sol_eq_solprev_dom⟩ := hprev
    obtain ⟨solx, hsol_prev_le_solx, hx_solx, h_solprev_eq_solx_dom⟩ := enlarge_L₀' sol_prev x
    refine ⟨solx, Preorder.le_trans sol sol_prev solx hsol_le_solprev hsol_prev_le_solx, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.coe_insert]
      exact Set.insert_subset_iff.mpr
        ⟨hx_solx, subset_trans hb_subset <| fill_mono <| hsol_prev_le_solx.1⟩
    . exact h_solprev_eq_solx_dom ▸ h_sol_eq_solprev_dom

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.x_in_extras
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.x_in_extras (sol : PartialSolution_with_axioms) : Sum.inr sol.x ∈ sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_or]

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.y
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.y₀_in_extras (sol : PartialSolution_with_axioms) : Sum.inr sol.y₀ ∈ sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, or_true, true_or]

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sy
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sy₀_in_extras (sol : PartialSolution_with_axioms) : Sum.inl (sol.S' sol.y₀) ∈ sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, or_true, true_or]

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_in_extras
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_in_extras (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀) : Sum.inl a ∈ sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ a, R' a sol.x = sol.y₀ := ⟨a, h⟩
  have h' : a = this.choose := by rwa [←this.choose_spec, R'_axiom_iia'] at h
  have h'' : a = sol.a_left := by simp [h', PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_left, this]
  simp [h'']

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_in_extras'
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_in_extras' (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: sol.x = R' a sol.y₀)  : Sum.inl a ∈ sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  have : ∃ a, sol.x = R' a sol.y₀ := ⟨a, h⟩
  have h' : this.choose = a := by rwa [this.choose_spec, R'_axiom_iia'] at h
  have h'' : a = sol.a_right := by simp [← h', PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_right, this]
  simp [h'']

name: enum_injective
statement: lemma enum_injective : Function.Injective enum
proof:
:= by
  intro _ _ h
  simp only [add_left_inj, enum] at h
  exact Exists.choose_spec (Countable.exists_injective_nat (N × N)) h

name: enum_ne_0
statement: lemma enum_ne_0 (p : N × N) : enum p ≠ 0
proof: := by dsimp [enum]; linarith

name: enum_ne_1
statement: lemma enum_ne_1 (p : N × N) : enum p ≠ 1
proof: := by dsimp [enum]; linarith

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras_mem
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras_mem (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: Sum.inl a ∈ sol.extras) : a ∈ sol.involved_elements sol.extras
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.mem_union_right
  rw [Finset.mem_biUnion]
  exact ⟨Sum.inl a, h, by simp [basis_elements']⟩

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras_supp
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.extras_supp (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: Sum.inl a ∈ sol.extras) (i:ℕ) : a (sol.m i) = 0
proof: := not_in_generators (mem_in_generators (sol.extras_mem h)) (fresh_ne_generator (sol.involved_elements sol.extras) i)

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_supp
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_supp (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀) (i:ℕ) : a (sol.m i) = 0
proof: := sol.extras_supp (sol.a_in_extras h) i

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_supp'
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.a_supp' (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: sol.x = R' a sol.y₀) (i:ℕ) : a (sol.m i) = 0
proof: := sol.extras_supp (sol.a_in_extras' h) i

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sy
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sy₀_supp (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) (i:ℕ) : sol.S' sol.y₀ (sol.m i) = 0
proof: := sol.extras_supp sol.Sy₀_in_extras i

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.d
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.d₀_neq_d₁ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) : sol.d₀ ≠ sol.d₁
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! this
  exact zero_ne_one <| fresh_injective _ <| E_inj this

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.d_injective
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.d_injective (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {y z y' z': N} (h: sol.d y z = sol.d y' z') : y = y' ∧ z = z'
proof: :=  (Prod.mk.injEq _ _ _ _) ▸ (enum_injective <| fresh_injective _ <| E_inj h)

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.test
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.test (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a b : SM} (i:ℕ) (h: a (sol.m i) ≠ b (sol.m i)) : a ≠ b
proof:
:=
  fun x ↦ h (congrFun (congrArg DFunLike.coe x) (sol.m i))

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sd
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sd₀_neq_d₀ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) : S sol.d₀ ≠ sol.d₀

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.d_neq_zero

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad₀_neq_zero (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀):  a - sol.d₀ ≠ 0

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad₀_neq_d₀ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀):  a - sol.d₀ ≠ sol.d₀
proof:

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad₀_neq_d (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀) {y z: N} :  a - sol.d₀ ≠ sol.d y z

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.ad₀_neq_d₁ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀):  a - sol.d₀ ≠ sol.d₁

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.Sad

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.SSy
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.SSy₀_neq_d₁ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) : S ( sol.S' sol.y₀ ) ≠ sol.d₁

statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.SSy₀_neq_ad₀ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (ha: R' a sol.x = sol.y₀) : S ( sol.S' sol.y₀ ) ≠ a - sol.d₀

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.SSy

statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.aSy₀_neq_d₀ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: sol.x = R' a sol.y₀):  a - sol.S' sol.y₀ ≠ sol.d₀

  apply sol.test 0
  rw [DirectSum.sub_apply, sol.a_supp' h, sol.Sy₀_supp, DirectSum.of_eq_same]

name: PartialSolution_with_axioms.aSy
statement: lemma PartialSolution_with_axioms.aSy₀_neq_d₁ (sol: PartialSolution_with_axioms) {a : SM} (h: sol.x = R' a sol.y₀):  a - sol.S' sol.y₀ ≠ sol.d₁

  simp only [E_apply, add_right_inj, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.reduceEqDiff, enum_ne_1, DirectSum.of_eq_same]
