name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X1 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X3 X4 ∨ ps.compl X0 X4 X1
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X3) (max (Nat.pair X0 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation906
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation906 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation906 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation906]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X1 X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun X0 X0) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun X0 X0))

name: _root_.Equation906_not_implies_Equation3862
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation906_not_implies_Equation3862 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation906 G ∧ ¬Equation3862 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter3862.toMagma,
    PartialSolution.counter3862.toMagma_equation906, ?_⟩
  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter3862.of_R 1 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3862; decide)
  have h2 := PartialSolution.counter3862.of_R 1 2 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3862; decide)
  have h3 := PartialSolution.counter3862.of_R 2 1 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3862; decide)
  intro h
  specialize h 1
  change PartialSolution.counter3862.complFun 1 1 =
    PartialSolution.counter3862.complFun
      (PartialSolution.counter3862.complFun 1 (PartialSolution.counter3862.complFun 1 1)) 1 at h
  rw [h1, h2, h3] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

  have eq181 : a = sk3 ∨ c = sk2 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq174 preserve_2 
  have eq186 : a ≠ sk0 ∨ c = sk2 ∨ c = sk1 := eq181.imp_left (fun h : a = sk3 ↦ superpose h preserve_2) 
  have eq191 : (old sk3 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq123 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq227 : c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 ∨ sk0 = sk3 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq191 eq120 
  have eq238 : c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq227 preserve_2 
  have eq239 : c = sk2 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq238 eq186 
  have eq248 : (old sk0 sk1 c) ∨ a = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 := Or.assoc2 (eq239.imp_left (fun h : c = sk2 ↦ superpose h eq117)) 
  have eq251 : (old sk3 sk1 c) ∨ a = sk3 ∨ c = sk1 := Or.assoc2 (eq239.imp_left (fun h : c = sk2 ↦ superpose h eq125)) 
  have eq263 : c = sk1 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq248 p4XY 
  have eq264 : a = sk3 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq251 p4XY 
  have eq272 : (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq263.imp_left (fun h : c = sk1 ↦ superpose h eq99)) 
  have eq289 : (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq272 p4XZ 
  have eq290 : (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq289 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq291 : a = sk0 := resolve eq290 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq293 : a ≠ sk3 := Eq.mp (by grind only) preserve_2 
  have eq348 : a ≠ a ∨ c = sk1 := eq264.imp_left (fun h : a = sk3 ↦ superpose h eq293) 
  have eq349 : c = sk1 := resolve eq348 rfl 
  have eq357 : (old sk3 c sk2) ∨ a = sk3 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq125 
  have eq387 : a = sk3 := resolve eq357 p4XZ

name: rule_3_preserved
statement: theorem rule_3_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old c X1 X2) (old_3 : (∀ X0 X1 X2, ¬ old X0 X1 X1 ∨ ¬ old X2 X1 X0 ∨ old X1 X2 X0)) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z a (sF0 X Y Z) ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (imp_new_0 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ old X Y Z ∨ new X Y Z) : (∀ X0 X1 X2, ¬ new X0 X1 X1 ∨ ¬ new X2 X1 X0 ∨ new X1 X2 X0)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2⟩ := nh
  have eq86 (X0 X1 : G) : ¬(sP1 X0 X1 c) := resolve rule_def_1_2 p4YZ 
  have eq106 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk1) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq107 : (sP1 sk2 sk1 sk0) ∨ (old sk2 sk1 sk0) ∨ (sP0 sk2 sk1 sk0) := resolve new_imp preserve_1 
  have eq126 : (old sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq106 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq127 : (old sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq106 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq128 : (old sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq126 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq129 : (old sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq127 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq135 : (sP0 sk2 sk1 sk0) ∨ (old sk2 sk1 sk0) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq107 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq178 : (old sk2 sk1 sk0) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq135 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq188 : c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ (old sk1 sk2 sk0) ∨ ¬(old sk0 sk1 sk1) := resolve eq178 old_3 
  have eq192 : (old sk1 sk2 sk0) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq188 eq128 
  have eq210 : c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ (new sk1 sk2 sk0) := resolve eq192 imp_new_0 
  have eq211 : c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq210 preserve_2 
  have eq225 : (old sk0 c c) ∨ a = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc2 (eq211.imp_left (fun h : c = sk1 ↦ superpose h eq129)) 
  have eq235 : c = sk0 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq225 p4XZ 
  have eq248 : (old c sk1 sk1) ∨ a = c ∨ a = sk0 := Or.assoc2 (eq235.imp_left (fun h : c = sk0 ↦ superpose h eq129)) 
  have eq260 : a = c ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq248 p4YZ 
  have eq261 : a = sk0 := resolve eq260 ac 
  have eq269 : (sP0 a sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk1) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk1) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq106 
  have eq307 : a = c ∨ c = sk1 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq211 
  have eq322 : (sP1 a sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP0 a sk1 sk1) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk1) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq269 
  have eq323 : (old a sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP0 a sk1 sk1) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq322 
  have eq359 : c = sk1 := resolve eq307 ac 
  have eq374 : (sP0 a c c) ∨ (old a sk1 sk1) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk1) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq323 
  have eq397 : (old a c c) ∨ (sP0 a c c) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk1) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq374 
  have eq398 : (sP0 a c c) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk1) := resolve eq397 p4XZ 
  have eq399 : (sP1 a c c) ∨ (sP0 a c c) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq398 
  have eq400 : (sP0 a c c) := resolve eq399 eq86 
  have eq462 : c = b := resolve eq400 rule_def_0_1 
  subsumption bc eq462

name: rule_finite_0_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_0_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ X = a ∨ X = b ∨ memold X ∨ X = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq105 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq118 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq105 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq120 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq118 preserve_1 
  have eq134 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq120 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq135 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq134 preserve_1 
  have eq149 : memold sk0 := resolve eq135 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq149

name: rule_finite_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem2 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Y) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Y = a ∨ Y = b ∨ memold Y ∨ Y = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq105 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq117 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq105 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq120 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq117 preserve_4 
  have eq130 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq120 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq132 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq130 preserve_2 
  have eq142 : memold sk1 := resolve eq132 old_mem2 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq142

name: rule_finite_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z a (sF0 X Y Z) ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq92 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : ¬(sP1 X0 X1 X2) ∨ memold X2 := resolve rule_def_1_2 old_mem1 
  have eq105 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq115 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ memold sk2 := resolve eq105 eq92 
  have eq119 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq115 preserve_3 
  have eq120 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq119 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq123 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq120 preserve_4

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z a sF0 ∧ ps.R sF0 a b
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_2 ps.rule_3 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_0 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_1 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_2 new_imp ps.mem_1 ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X3 X4 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X1 X3 ∨ ps.compl X1 X4 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X3) (max (Nat.pair X2 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation707
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation707 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation707 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation707]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X0 X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X0 X1) X1) (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X0 X1) X1))

name: _root_.Equation707_not_implies_Equation1223
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation707_not_implies_Equation1223 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation707 G ∧ ¬Equation1223 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter1223.toMagma,
    PartialSolution.counter1223.toMagma_equation707, ?_⟩
  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 1 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h2 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 1 2 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h3 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 1 3 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h4 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 1 4 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h5 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 2 1 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h6 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 2 3 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h7 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 3 1 4 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  have h8 := PartialSolution.counter1223.of_R 3 4 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1223; decide)
  intro h
  specialize h 1
  change 1 =
    PartialSolution.counter1223.complFun 1 (PartialSolution.counter1223.complFun (PartialSolution.counter1223.complFun (PartialSolution.counter1223.complFun 1 1) 1) 1) at h
  simp only [h1, h4, h5, h7] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

name: _root_.Equation707_not_implies_Equation1316

name: rule_finite_0_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_0_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ X = a ∨ X = b ∨ memold X ∨ X = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq104 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq119 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk0 := resolve eq104 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq121 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq119 preserve_2 
  have eq137 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq121 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq138 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq137 preserve_1 
  have eq145 : memold sk0 := resolve eq138 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq145

name: rule_finite_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem2 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Y) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Y = a ∨ Y = b ∨ memold Y ∨ Y = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq104 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq118 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq104 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq121 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq118 preserve_4 
  have eq134 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq121 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq136 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq134 preserve_2 
  have eq145 : memold sk1 := resolve eq136 old_mem2 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq145

name: rule_finite_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z b (sF0 X Y Z) ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq93 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : ¬(sP1 X0 X1 X2) ∨ memold X2 := resolve rule_def_1_2 old_mem1 
  have eq104 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq116 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ memold sk2 := resolve eq104 eq93 
  have eq120 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq116 preserve_3 
  have eq123 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq120 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq126 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq123 preserve_4 
  have eq135 : memold sk2 := resolve eq126 old_mem3

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, b = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z b sF0 ∧ ps.R b sF0 a
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 bc p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 prev_1 prev_2 ps.rule_3 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_0 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_1 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_2 new_imp ps.mem_1 ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X2 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X3 X1 X4 ∨ ps.compl X1 X4 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X2) (max (Nat.pair X3 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:

  have eq217 : a = sk0 := resolve eq216 preserve_3 
  have eq221 : (sP0 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq200 
  have eq222 : (sP1 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq201 
  have eq228 : (sP0 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (old a sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq221 
  have eq229 : (sP0 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq222 
  have eq230 : (old a sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 a sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 a sk1 sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq229 
  have eq240 : (old a sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq228 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq243 : (old a sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq240 preserve_4

  have eq252 : c = sk1 := resolve eq251 preserve_3

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, c = Y ∧ b = Z ∧ ps.R b X sF0 ∧ ps.R X sF0 a
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3
  let sP2 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF1, a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ b = Z ∧ ps.R a a sF1 ∧ ps.R a sF1 b
  choose! sF1 hsP2 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP2 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP2
  obtain ⟨rule_def_2_0, rule_def_2_1, rule_def_2_2, rule_def_2_3, rule_def_2_4⟩ := hsP2
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 rule_def_2_4

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_3 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP2, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_3
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 sP2 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 bc p3 p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_0 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_2 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 imp_new_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_2_0 new_imp ps.mem_1 ps.mem_2
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) p4XZ rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains

proof:

  · simp

    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :

proof:

  induction hij

    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X2 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X3 X0 X4 ∨ ps.compl X1 X4 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X2) (max (Nat.pair X3 X0) (max (Nat.pair X1 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation1112
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation1112 :
    letI

:= ps.toMagma

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z a sF0 ∧ ps.R a sF0 b
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3
  let sP2 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF1 sF2, b = X ∧ a = Y ∧ c = Z ∧ ps.R b sF1 sF2 ∧ ps.R a sF1 sF2
  choose! sF1 sF2 hsP2 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP2 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP2
  obtain ⟨rule_def_2_0, rule_def_2_1, rule_def_2_2, rule_def_2_3, rule_def_2_4⟩ := hsP2
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 rule_def_2_4
  let sP3 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF3, b = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R a sF3 a ∧ ps.R b sF3 a ∧ ps.R Z b sF3
  choose! sF3 hsP3 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP3 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP3
  obtain ⟨rule_def_3_0, rule_def_3_1, rule_def_3_2, rule_def_3_3, rule_def_3_4⟩ := hsP3
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_3_0 rule_def_3_1 rule_def_3_2 rule_def_3_3 rule_def_3_4
  let sP4 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF4, a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R a sF4 a ∧ ps.R b a sF4
  choose! sF4 hsP4 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP4 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP4
  obtain ⟨rule_def_4_0, rule_def_4_1, rule_def_4_2, rule_def_4_3, rule_def_4_4⟩ := hsP4
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_4_0 rule_def_4_1 rule_def_4_2 rule_def_4_3 rule_def_4_4

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z ∨ sP3 X Y Z ∨ sP4 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_3 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_4 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_5 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z ∨ sP3 X Y Z ∨ sP4 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X2 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X3 X4 ∨ ps.compl X1 X4 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X2) (max (Nat.pair X1 X3) (max (Nat.pair X1 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation511
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation511 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation511 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation511]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X0 X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1) (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1)) (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1)))

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R a Z sF0 ∧ ps.R Z sF0 b
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 bc p3 p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_0 ps.rule_6 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_3 ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac p4YZ ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_4 := rule_4_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 prev_1 ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp
  have prev_5 := rule_5_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_5 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp
  have prev_6 := rule_6_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 prev_1 ps.rule_6 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    rule_4 := prev_4
    rule_5 := prev_5
    rule_6 := prev_6
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_0 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_1 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_2 new_imp ps.mem_2 ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X0 X3 X4 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X2 X3 ∨ ps.compl X0 X4 X1
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X0 X3) (max (Nat.pair X1 X2) (max (Nat.pair X0 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation503
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation503 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation503 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation503]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X1 X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0)) (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0)))

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X1 X3 ∨ ps.compl X0 X3 X1
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X1) (max (Nat.pair X0 X3) 0))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation124
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation124 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation124 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation124]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X1 X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X1 X0) X0)

name: _root_.Equation124_not_implies_Equation1924
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation124_not_implies_Equation1924 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation124 G ∧ ¬Equation1924 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter1924.toMagma,
    PartialSolution.counter1924.toMagma_equation124, ?_⟩
  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 1 1 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h2 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 1 2 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h3 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 1 3 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h4 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 2 1 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h5 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 2 3 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h6 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 3 1 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  have h7 := PartialSolution.counter1924.of_R 3 3 1 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter1924; decide)
  intro h
  specialize h 2 1
  change 2 =
    PartialSolution.counter1924.complFun (PartialSolution.counter1924.complFun 1 (PartialSolution.counter1924.complFun 1 2)) (PartialSolution.counter1924.complFun 1 2) at h
  simp only [h2, h3] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

statement: theorem rule_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ old a b X0) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old c X1 X2) (prev_0 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X0 X1 X3 ∨ X2 = X3)) (old_1 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X2 X1 X3 ∨ old X2 X3 X0)) (imp_new_1 : ∀ X Y Z, a ≠ X ∨ b ≠ Y ∨ c ≠ Z ∨ new X Y Z) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (imp_new_2 : ∀ X Y Z, a ≠ X ∨ c ≠ Y ∨ ¬ old Z b a ∨ new X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z b a ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (imp_new_0 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ old X Y Z ∨ new X Y Z) : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X2 X1 X3 ∨ new X2 X3 X0)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, sk3, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2⟩ := nh
  have eq66 (X0 X1 : G) : (new X0 X1 c) ∨ b ≠ X1 ∨ a ≠ X0 := resolve imp_new_1 rfl

  have eq69 (X0 X2 : G) : (new X0 c X2) ∨ ¬(old X2 b a) ∨ a ≠ X0 := resolve imp_new_2 rfl

  have eq73 (X0 : G) : ¬(new a b X0) ∨ c = X0 := resolve prev_0 eq68 
  have eq75 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq76 : (sP1 sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ (old sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ (sP0 sk2 sk1 sk3) := resolve new_imp preserve_1 
  have eq85 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk2 b a) := resolve eq75 rule_def_1_2

  have eq93 : (sP0 sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ (old sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq76 rule_def_1_1

  have eq95 : (old sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq94 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq100 (X0 : G) : ¬(old X0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk2 sk3 X0) ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq95 old_1 
  have eq106 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq86 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq107 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq86 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq112 : (old sk2 sk1 sk3) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq93 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq116 : (old sk2 b a) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq85 rule_def_0_2

  have eq367 : (old c sk1 sk3) ∨ a = c ∨ c = sk1 ∨ a = sk2 := Or.assoc2 (eq355.imp_left (fun h : c = sk2 ↦ superpose h eq95)) 
  have eq399 : a = c ∨ c = sk1 ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq367 p4YZ

  have eq414 : (old sk0 sk1 a) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ a = c ∨ c = sk1 := Or.assoc3 (eq400.imp_left (fun h : a = sk2 ↦ superpose h eq106)) 
  have eq436 : (old sk0 sk1 a) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ a = c := resolve eq414 rfl 
  have eq442 : (old sk0 sk1 a) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq436 ac 
  have eq463 : b = sk1 ∨ (old sk2 sk3 sk0) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq144 eq107 
  have eq474 : (old sk2 sk3 sk0) ∨ b = sk1 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq463 rfl 
  have eq502 : b = sk1 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ (new sk2 sk3 sk0) := resolve eq474 imp_new_0 
  have eq510 : b = sk1 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq502 preserve_2 
  have eq553 : (new a b sk3) ∨ c = b ∨ c = sk1 := Or.assoc2 (eq510.imp_left (fun h : b = sk1 ↦ superpose h eq403))

  have eq567 : (new a b sk3) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq553 bc

name: rule_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (old_2 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X3 X1 X2 ∨ X3 = X0)) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X3 X1 X2 ∨ X3 = X0)

:= by

  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, sk3, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2⟩ := nh
  have eq82 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0

  have eq163 : a ≠ sk0 ∨ c = sk2 ∨ c = sk1 := eq153.imp_left (fun h : a = sk3 ↦ superpose h preserve_2)

statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z b a ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c

:= by

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z b a
  have hsP1 (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z b a := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X1 X3 ∨ ps.compl X2 X3 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X3) 0))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation1648
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation1648 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation1648 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation1648]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X0 X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X0 X1) X1)

name: _root_.Equation1648_not_implies_Equation3253
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation1648_not_implies_Equation3253 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation1648 G ∧ ¬Equation3253 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter3253.toMagma,
    PartialSolution.counter3253.toMagma_equation1648, ?_⟩
  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter3253.of_R 1 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3253; decide)
  have h2 := PartialSolution.counter3253.of_R 1 2 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3253; decide)
  have h3 := PartialSolution.counter3253.of_R 1 3 3 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter3253; decide)
  intro h
  specialize h 1
  change PartialSolution.counter3253.complFun 1 1 =
    PartialSolution.counter3253.complFun 1 (PartialSolution.counter3253.complFun 1 (PartialSolution.counter3253.complFun 1 1)) at h
  simp only [h1, h2, h3] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := b = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z b a
  have hsP1 (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) : b = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R Z b a := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2
  let sP2 (X Y Z) := c = X ∧ b = Y ∧ b = Z ∧ ps.R b b a
  have hsP2 (X Y Z) (h : sP2 X Y Z) : c = X ∧ b = Y ∧ b = Z ∧ ps.R b b a := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP2
  obtain ⟨rule_def_2_0, rule_def_2_1, rule_def_2_2, rule_def_2_3⟩ := hsP2
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3
  let sP3 (X Y Z) := b = X ∧ a = Y ∧ c = Z ∧ ps.R b b a
  have hsP3 (X Y Z) (h : sP3 X Y Z) : b = X ∧ a = Y ∧ c = Z ∧ ps.R b b a := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP3
  obtain ⟨rule_def_3_0, rule_def_3_1, rule_def_3_2, rule_def_3_3⟩ := hsP3
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_3_0 rule_def_3_1 rule_def_3_2 rule_def_3_3
  let sP4 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R a a b
  have hsP4 (X Y Z) (h : sP4 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R a a b := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP4
  obtain ⟨rule_def_4_0, rule_def_4_1, rule_def_4_2, rule_def_4_3⟩ := hsP4
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_4_0 rule_def_4_1 rule_def_4_2 rule_def_4_3
  let sP5 (X Y Z) := c = X ∧ a = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R a a b
  have hsP5 (X Y Z) (h : sP5 X Y Z) : c = X ∧ a = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R a a b := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP5
  obtain ⟨rule_def_5_0, rule_def_5_1, rule_def_5_2, rule_def_5_3⟩ := hsP5
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_5_0 rule_def_5_1 rule_def_5_2 rule_def_5_3
  let sP6 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R b b a ∧ ps.R Z a b
  have hsP6 (X Y Z) (h : sP6 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ c = Y ∧ ps.R b b a ∧ ps.R Z a b := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP6
  obtain ⟨rule_def_6_0, rule_def_6_1, rule_def_6_2, rule_def_6_3⟩ := hsP6
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_6_0 rule_def_6_1 rule_def_6_2 rule_def_6_3
  let sP7 (X Y Z) := a = b ∧ c = X ∧ b = Y ∧ ps.R Z b b
  have hsP7 (X Y Z) (h : sP7 X Y Z) : a = b ∧ c = X ∧ b = Y ∧ ps.R Z b b := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP7
  obtain ⟨rule_def_7_0, rule_def_7_1, rule_def_7_2, rule_def_7_3⟩ := hsP7
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_7_0 rule_def_7_1 rule_def_7_2 rule_def_7_3
  let sP8 (X Y Z) := b = X ∧ a = Y ∧ c = Z ∧ ps.R a a b

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z ∨ sP3 X Y Z ∨ sP4 X Y Z ∨ sP5 X Y Z ∨ sP6 X Y Z ∨ sP7 X Y Z ∨ sP8 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_3 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_4 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_5 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_6 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_7 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_8 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_9 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z ∨ sP3 X Y Z ∨ sP4 X Y Z ∨ sP5 X Y Z ∨ sP6 X Y Z ∨ sP7 X Y Z ∨ sP8 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0

  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP2, or_assoc] at imp_new_3
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP3, or_assoc] at imp_new_4
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP4, or_assoc] at imp_new_5
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP5, or_assoc] at imp_new_6
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP6, or_assoc] at imp_new_7
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP7, or_assoc] at imp_new_8
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP8, or_assoc] at imp_new_9
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 sP2 sP3 sP4 sP5 sP6 sP7 sP8 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 sP2 sP3 sP4 sP5 sP6 sP7 sP8 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 ps.rule_4 ps.rule_8 ps.rule_10 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 rule_def_3_0 rule_def_3_1 rule_def_3_2 rule_def_3_3 rule_def_4_0 rule_def_4_1 rule_def_4_2 rule_def_4_3 rule_def_5_0 rule_def_5_1 rule_def_5_2 rule_def_5_3 rule_def_6_0 rule_def_6_1 rule_def_6_2 rule_def_6_3 rule_def_7_0 rule_def_7_1 rule_def_7_2 rule_def_7_3 rule_def_8_0 rule_def_8_1 rule_def_8_2 rule_def_8_3 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 sP2 sP3 sP4 sP5 sP6 sP7 sP8 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_3 ps.rule_8 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 imp_new_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 imp_new_4 rule_def_3_0 rule_def_3_1 rule_def_3_2 rule_def_3_3 imp_new_5 rule_def_4_0 rule_def_4_1 rule_def_4_2 rule_def_4_3 imp_new_6 rule_def_5_0 rule_def_5_1 rule_def_5_2 rule_def_5_3 imp_new_7 rule_def_6_0 rule_def_6_1 rule_def_6_2 rule_def_6_3 rule_def_7_0 rule_def_7_1 rule_def_7_2 rule_def_7_3 imp_new_9 rule_def_8_0 rule_def_8_1 rule_def_8_2 rule_def_8_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 sP2 sP3 sP4 sP5 sP6 sP7 sP8 prev_1

  have prev_4 := rule_4_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 sP2 sP3 sP4 sP5 sP6 sP7 sP8 prev_1 prev_2
