name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X1 X3 ∨ ps.compl X1 X3 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X3) 0))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation118
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation118 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation118 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation118]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X0 X1 (ps.complFun X0 X1) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X0 X1) X1)

theorem _root_.Equation118_not_implies_Equation222 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation118 G ∧ ¬Equation222 G

statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation118_not_implies_Equation4435 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation118 G ∧ ¬Equation4435 G

  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter4435.toMagma,

name: rule_0_preserved
statement: theorem rule_0_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ old a b X0) (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (old_0 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X0 X1 X3 ∨ X2 = X3)) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = Z ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X0 X1 X3 ∨ X2 = X3)

  have eq98 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk3) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk3) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk3) := resolve new_imp preserve_1

  have eq111 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq97 rule_def_1_0

  have eq118 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk3) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk3) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq98 rule_def_1_0

  have eq158 (X0 : G) : ¬(old sk0 sk1 X0) ∨ a = sk0 ∨ sk2 = X0 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq142 old_0

name: rule_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ old a b X0) (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old c X1 X2) (old_0 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X0 X1 X3 ∨ X2 = X3)) (prev_0 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X0 X1 X3 ∨ X2 = X3)) (old_1 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3 X4, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X1 X3 X4 ∨ ¬ old X2 X0 X3 ∨ old X0 X4 X1)) (old_4 : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3, ¬ old X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ old X1 X3 X0 ∨ ¬ old X2 X1 X3 ∨ old X2 X3 X1)) (imp_new_1 : ∀ X Y Z, a ≠ X ∨ b ≠ Y ∨ c ≠ Z ∨ new X Y Z) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (imp_new_2 : ∀ X Y Z X2, c ≠ Y ∨ a ≠ Z ∨ ¬ old X a X2 ∨ ¬ old X2 X b ∨ new X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = Z ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old X a (sF0 X Y Z) ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_3 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old (sF0 X Y Z) X b ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (imp_new_0 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ old X Y Z ∨ new X Y Z) : (∀ X0 X1 X2 X3 X4, ¬ new X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ new X1 X3 X4 ∨ ¬ new X2 X0 X3 ∨ new X0 X4 X1)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, sk3, sk4, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3⟩ := nh
  have eq77 (X0 X1 : G) : (new X0 X1 c) ∨ b ≠ X1 ∨ a ≠ X0 := resolve imp_new_1 rfl 
  have eq78 (X0 : G) : (new X0 b c) ∨ a ≠ X0 := resolve eq77 rfl

name: rule_finite_0_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_0_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old X a (sF0 X Y Z) ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ X = a ∨ X = b ∨ memold X ∨ X = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq94 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : ¬(sP1 X0 X1 X2) ∨ memold X0 := resolve rule_def_1_2 old_mem1 
  have eq110 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq130 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ memold sk0 := resolve eq110 eq94 
  have eq134 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq130 preserve_3 
  have eq142 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq134 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq143 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq142 preserve_1 
  have eq151 : memold sk0 := resolve eq143 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq151

name: rule_finite_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem2 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Y) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Y = a ∨ Y = b ∨ memold Y ∨ Y = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq110 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq133 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq110 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq135 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq133 preserve_4 
  have eq151 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq135 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq153 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq151 preserve_2 
  have eq161 : memold sk1 := resolve eq153 old_mem2 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq161

name: rule_finite_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = Z ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq110 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq132 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq110 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq135 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq132 preserve_1 
  have eq148 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq135 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq151 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq148 preserve_4 
  have eq160 : memold sk2 := resolve eq151 old_mem3 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq160

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R X a sF0 ∧ ps.R sF0 X b
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 bc p3 p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_0 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_4 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4YZ ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp
  have prev_4 := rule_4_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    rule_4 := prev_4
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_2 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_0 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_1 new_imp ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X3 X4 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X0 X3 ∨ ps.compl X0 X4 X1
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X3) (max (Nat.pair X2 X0) (max (Nat.pair X0 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation677
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation677 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation677 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation677]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X1 X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X1 X0) X1) (ps.complFun X0 (ps.complFun (ps.complFun X1 X0) X1))

name: _root_.Equation677_not_implies_Equation255
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation677_not_implies_Equation255 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation677 G ∧ ¬Equation255 G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter255.toMagma,
    PartialSolution.counter255.toMagma_equation677, ?_⟩
  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter255.of_R 1 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter255; decide)
  have h2 := PartialSolution.counter255.of_R 2 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter255; decide)
  intro h

  change 1 =
    PartialSolution.counter255.complFun (PartialSolution.counter255.complFun (PartialSolution.counter255.complFun 1 1) 1) 1 at h
  simp only [h1, h2] at h

  have eq202 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq199 preserve_3 
  have eq207 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq202 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq208 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq207 preserve_1 
  have eq216 : memold sk0 := resolve eq208 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq216

name: rule_finite_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF1 : G → G → G → G) (sP2 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_2_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP2 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z) (old_mem2 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Y) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Y = a ∨ Y = b ∨ memold Y ∨ Y = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq149 : (sP2 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq188 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq149 rule_def_2_1 
  have eq194 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq188 preserve_4 
  have eq195 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq194 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq202 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq195 preserve_4 
  have eq206 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq202 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq208 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq206 preserve_2 
  have eq217 : memold sk1 := resolve eq208 old_mem2 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq217

name: rule_finite_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF0 : G → G → G → G) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (sF1 : G → G → G → G) (sP2 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = Z ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_2_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP2 X Y Z) (rule_def_2_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = Z ∨ ¬sP2 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq149 : (sP2 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq188 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq149 rule_def_2_1 
  have eq189 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq149 rule_def_2_2 
  have eq194 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq188 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq195 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq189 preserve_1 
  have eq196 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq194 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq199 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq196 preserve_4 
  have eq208 : c = sk1 ∨ memold sk2 := resolve eq199 old_mem3 
  have eq209 : c = sk1 := resolve eq208 preserve_3 
  have eq214 : (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq195 
  have eq223 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq214 
  have eq224 : (old sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP1 sk0 c sk2) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq223 
  have eq225 : (sP1 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) := resolve eq224 p4XZ 
  have eq235 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ a = sk2 := resolve eq225 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq242 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) := resolve eq235 preserve_1 
  have eq245 : c = sk2 := resolve eq242 rule_def_0_2 
  subsumption preserve_4 eq245

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF0, c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R X a sF0 ∧ ps.R X sF0 b
  choose! sF0 hsP1 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2, rule_def_1_3⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3
  let sP2 (X Y Z) := ∃ sF1, b = X ∧ c = Y ∧ a = Z ∧ ps.R b b sF1 ∧ ps.R b sF1 a
  choose! sF1 hsP2 using fun (X Y Z) (h : sP2 X Y Z) ↦ h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP2
  obtain ⟨rule_def_2_0, rule_def_2_1, rule_def_2_2, rule_def_2_3, rule_def_2_4⟩ := hsP2
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 rule_def_2_4

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_3 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z ∨ sP2 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [not_and, not_exists, imp_iff_not_or, sP2, ← forall_or_right, or_assoc] at imp_new_3
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 sP2 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ ps.rule_0 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_3 ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4YZ ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 prev_0 prev_1 ps.rule_3 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_4 := rule_4_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_4 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_1_3 imp_new_3 rule_def_2_0 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 rule_def_2_3 rule_def_2_4 new_imp imp_new_0

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    rule_4 := prev_4
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_0 rule_def_1_2 rule_def_2_0 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_2_1 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sF0 sP1 sF1 sP2 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) p4XZ rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_2_1 rule_def_2_2 new_imp ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X0 X2 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X3 X4 ∨ ps.compl X0 X4 X1
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X0 X2) (max (Nat.pair X1 X3) (max (Nat.pair X0 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
  · intro h
    have : ps.compl a b (ps.complFun a b) := (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec
    exact ps.compl_rule0 a b _ _ this h

name: PartialSolution.of_R
statement: lemma PartialSolution.of_R (a b c : ℕ) (h : ps.R a b c) : ps.complFun a b = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff]
  apply PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ 0 _ (by simp) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.toMagma_equation476
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.toMagma_equation476 :
    letI
proof:
:= ps.toMagma
    Equation476 ℕ := by
  simp only [Equation476]
  intro X0 X1
  simpa [← PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff, eq_comm] using
    ps.compl_rule1 X1 X0 (ps.complFun X1 X0) (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X1 X0)) (ps.complFun X0 (ps.complFun X1 (ps.complFun X1 X0)))

name: _root_.Equation476_not_implies_Equation359

@[equational_result]
theorem _root_.Equation476_not_implies_Equation359 : ∃ (G : Type) (_ : Magma G), Equation476 G ∧ ¬Equation359 G
proof:

  refine ⟨ℕ, PartialSolution.counter359.toMagma,

  have h1 := PartialSolution.counter359.of_R 1 1 2 (by unfold PartialSolution.counter359; decide)

  specialize h 1
  change PartialSolution.counter359.complFun 1 1 =
    PartialSolution.counter359.complFun (PartialSolution.counter359.complFun 1 1) 1 at h
  simp only [h1, h2] at h
  exact absurd h (by decide)

  have eq143 : (old sk0 sk0 sk1) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq134 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq145 : (sP0 sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ (old sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ (old sk3 sk2 a) := resolve eq112 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq146 : (sP0 sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ (old sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ c = sk4 := resolve eq112 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq152 (X0 X1 X2 : G) : ¬(old X1 sk0 X2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ sk0 = X0 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ ¬(old X1 X0 X2) ∨ ¬(old X0 X0 sk1) := resolve eq141 old_4 
  have eq153 : (sP0 sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk4 sk4 b) := resolve eq113 rule_def_1_2 
  have eq154 : (sP0 sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk1 sk4 a) := resolve eq113 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq155 : (sP0 sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk4 := resolve eq113 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq168 : (old sk2 sk0 sk3) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk3 := resolve eq140 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq169 : (old sk2 sk0 sk3) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ b = sk0 := resolve eq140 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq186 : (old sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ c = sk4 ∨ c = sk3 := resolve eq146 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq194 : (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq155 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq196 : (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk4 ∨ a = sk4 := resolve eq155 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq203 : (old sk0 sk0 sk1) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 b) ∨ b = sk0 := resolve eq132 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq247 : (old sk3 sk2 a) ∨ (old sk2 sk4 sk3) ∨ b = sk4 := resolve eq145 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq266 : (old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ (old sk1 sk4 a) ∨ a = sk4 := resolve eq154 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq1741 (X0 : G) : c = sk1 ∨ sk0 = X0 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ ¬(old sk2 X0 sk3) ∨ ¬(old X0 X0 sk1) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk3 := resolve eq152 eq168 
  have eq1746 (X0 : G) : ¬(old sk2 X0 sk3) ∨ sk0 = X0 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ ¬(old X0 X0 sk1) ∨ c = sk3 := resolve eq1741 rfl 
  have eq3492 : sk0 = sk4 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ ¬(old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk4 ∨ c = sk3 := resolve eq1746 eq186 
  have eq3497 : sk0 = sk4 ∨ c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ ¬(old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk4 := resolve eq3492 rfl 
  have eq3510 : c = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ ¬(old sk4 sk4 sk1) ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk4 := resolve eq3497 preserve_4 
  have eq3511 : c = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3510 eq194 
  have eq3529 : (sP0 c c sk1) ∨ (old c c sk1) ∨ (old c c b) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq3511.imp_left (fun h : c = sk4 ↦ superpose h eq153)) 
  have eq3632 : (sP0 c c sk1) ∨ (old c c b) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3529 p4YZ 
  have eq3633 : (sP0 c c sk1) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk3 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3632 p4YZ 
  have eq3634 : c = sk3 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3633 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq3667 : (old sk2 sk0 c) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq3634.imp_left (fun h : c = sk3 ↦ superpose h eq169)) 
  have eq3683 : (old c sk2 a) ∨ (old sk2 sk4 c) ∨ b = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq3634.imp_left (fun h : c = sk3 ↦ superpose h eq247)) 
  have eq3755 : (old sk2 sk0 c) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq3667 rfl 
  have eq3763 : c = sk1 ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3755 p4XY 
  have eq3767 : (old sk2 sk4 c) ∨ b = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3683 p4YZ 
  have eq3768 : b = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3767 p4XY 
  have eq3793 : (sP1 sk0 sk0 c) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 c) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk0 c) ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq3763.imp_left (fun h : c = sk1 ↦ superpose h eq110)) 
  have eq3882 : (sP1 sk0 sk0 c) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk0 c) ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3793 p4XY 
  have eq3883 : (sP0 sk0 sk0 c) ∨ b = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3882 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq3884 : b = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq3883 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq4276 : b ≠ sk0 ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := eq3768.imp_left (fun h : b = sk4 ↦ superpose h preserve_4) 
  have eq4405 : c = sk1 ∨ c = sk0 := resolve eq4276 eq3884 
  have eq4436 : (old sk0 sk0 c) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ a = sk0 ∨ c = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq4405.imp_left (fun h : c = sk1 ↦ superpose h eq143)) 
  have eq4504 : (old sk0 sk0 c) ∨ c = sk0 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq4436 rfl 
  have eq4511 : c = sk0 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq4504 p4XY 
  have eq4558 : (old c c sk1) ∨ (old c c b) ∨ c = b ∨ a = sk0 := Or.assoc3 (eq4511.imp_left (fun h : c = sk0 ↦ superpose h eq203)) 
  have eq4640 : (old c c b) ∨ c = b ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq4558 p4YZ 
  have eq4641 : c = b ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq4640 p4YZ 
  have eq4642 : a = sk0 := resolve eq4641 bc 
  have eq4645 : a ≠ sk4 := Eq.mp (by grind only) preserve_4 
  have eq5202 : a = c ∨ b = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq3768 
  have eq5209 : a = c ∨ b = sk0 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq3884 
  have eq6114 : b = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq5202 ac 
  have eq6131 : b = sk0 := resolve eq5209 ac 
  have eq6132 : a = b := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq6131 
  have eq6317 : a = sk4 ∨ c = sk1 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq6114 
  have eq6392 : c = sk1 := resolve eq6317 eq4645 
  have eq6402 : (old sk4 sk4 c) ∨ c = sk4 ∨ a = sk4 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq196 
  have eq6410 : (old sk4 sk4 c) ∨ (old sk1 sk4 a) ∨ a = sk4 := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq266 
  have eq6451 : c = sk4 ∨ a = sk4 := resolve eq6402 p4XY 
  have eq6452 : c = sk4 := resolve eq6451 eq4645 
  have eq6585 : (old sk1 sk4 a) ∨ a = sk4 := resolve eq6410 p4XY 
  have eq6586 : (old sk1 sk4 a) := resolve eq6585 eq4645 
  have eq6587 : (old sk1 c a) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq6586 
  subsumption p4XZ eq6587

name: rule_finite_0_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_0_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (bc : c ≠ b) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (rule_def_0_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), a = X ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old X X b ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ X = a ∨ X = b ∨ memold X ∨ X = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq86 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq96 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 b) := resolve eq86 rule_def_1_2 
  have eq98 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq86 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq104 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ a = sk0 := resolve eq98 rule_def_0_0 
  have eq105 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq104 preserve_1 
  have eq111 : c = sk1 ∨ memold sk0 := resolve eq105 old_mem1 
  have eq114 : c = sk1 := resolve eq111 preserve_3 
  have eq117 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 b) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq96 
  have eq126 : (old sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 b) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq117 
  have eq127 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk0 b) := resolve eq126 p4XZ 
  have eq135 : (old sk0 sk0 b) ∨ c = b := resolve eq127 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq137 : (old sk0 sk0 b) := resolve eq135 bc 
  have eq147 : memold sk0 := resolve eq137 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq147

name: rule_finite_1_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_1_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (rule_def_0_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), b = Y ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem2 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Y) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Y = a ∨ Y = b ∨ memold Y ∨ Y = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq86 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq98 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq86 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq99 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq98 preserve_4 
  have eq101 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ b = sk1 := resolve eq99 rule_def_0_1 
  have eq103 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve eq101 preserve_2 
  have eq113 : memold sk1 := resolve eq103 old_mem2 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq113

name: rule_finite_2_preserved
statement: theorem rule_finite_2_preserved (G : Type*) (a b c : G) (old : G → G → G → Prop) (new : G → G → G → Prop) (sP0 : G → G → G → Prop) (sP1 : G → G → G → Prop) (memold : G → Prop) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ old X1 c X2) (rule_def_0_2 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Z ∨ ¬sP0 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_0 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), c = Y ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (rule_def_1_1 : ∀ (X Y Z : G), old Z X a ∨ ¬sP1 X Y Z) (new_imp : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬ new X Y Z ∨ old X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z) (old_mem1 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold X) (old_mem3 : ∀ (X Y Z), ¬old X Y Z ∨ memold Z) : ∀ (X Y Z : G), ¬new X Y Z ∨ Z = a ∨ Z = b ∨ memold Z ∨ Z = c
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! nh
  obtain ⟨sk0, sk1, sk2, preserve_0, preserve_1, preserve_2, preserve_3, preserve_4⟩ := nh
  have eq86 : (sP1 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) := resolve new_imp preserve_0 
  have eq97 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk2 sk0 a) := resolve eq86 rule_def_1_1 
  have eq98 : (sP0 sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq86 rule_def_1_0 
  have eq102 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq98 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq105 : (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ c = sk1 := resolve eq102 preserve_4 
  have eq113 : c = sk1 ∨ memold sk2 := resolve eq105 old_mem3 
  have eq114 : c = sk1 := resolve eq113 preserve_3 
  have eq118 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk0 sk1 sk2) ∨ (old sk2 sk0 a) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq97 
  have eq126 : (old sk0 c sk2) ∨ (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk2 sk0 a) := Eq.mp (by grind only) eq118 
  have eq127 : (sP0 sk0 c sk2) ∨ (old sk2 sk0 a) := resolve eq126 p4XZ 
  have eq136 : (old sk2 sk0 a) ∨ c = sk2 := resolve eq127 rule_def_0_2 
  have eq139 : (old sk2 sk0 a) := resolve eq136 preserve_4 
  have eq155 : memold sk2 := resolve eq139 old_mem1 
  subsumption preserve_3 eq155

name: PartialSolution.adjoin
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.adjoin (a b c : G) (ac : a ≠ c) (bc : c ≠ b) (p3 : ∀ X0, ¬ ps.R a b X0)
    (p4XY : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 X2 c) (p4XZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R X1 c X2) (p4YZ : ∀ X1 X2, ¬ ps.R c X1 X2)
    : ∃ next : PartialSolution G, next.R a b c ∧ ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → next.R x y z
proof:
:= by classical
  let sP0 (X Y Z) := a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z
  have hsP0 (X Y Z) (h : sP0 X Y Z) : a = X ∧ b = Y ∧ c = Z := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP0
  obtain ⟨rule_def_0_0, rule_def_0_1, rule_def_0_2⟩ := hsP0
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2
  let sP1 (X Y Z) := c = Y ∧ ps.R Z X a ∧ ps.R X X b
  have hsP1 (X Y Z) (h : sP1 X Y Z) : c = Y ∧ ps.R Z X a ∧ ps.R X X b := h
  simp only [imp_and, imp_iff_not_or, forall_and] at hsP1
  obtain ⟨rule_def_1_0, rule_def_1_1, rule_def_1_2⟩ := hsP1
  simp_rw [or_comm] at rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2

  let new (X Y Z) := ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z
  have new_new : new a b c := by simp only [true_or, or_true, new, sP0, and_true]
  have imp_new_0 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inl
  have imp_new_1 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inl
  have imp_new_2 (X Y Z) : _ → new X Y Z := Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
  have new_imp (X Y Z) : new X Y Z → ps.R X Y Z ∨ sP0 X Y Z ∨ sP1 X Y Z := id

  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at imp_new_0
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP0, or_assoc] at imp_new_1
  simp only [not_and, imp_iff_not_or, sP1, or_assoc] at imp_new_2
  simp only [imp_iff_not_or] at new_imp
  clear_value sP0 sP1 new

  have prev_0 := rule_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_0 ps.rule_2 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp
  have prev_1 := rule_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 ac bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_1 ps.rule_3 imp_new_1 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_2 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_2 := rule_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_2 ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp
  have prev_3 := rule_3_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 ac bc p3 p4XY p4XZ p4YZ prev_0 ps.rule_3 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 imp_new_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_2 new_imp imp_new_0
  have prev_4 := rule_4_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 ac bc p4XY p4XZ p4YZ ps.rule_4 rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 rule_def_1_2 new_imp

  exact ⟨{
    R := new
    rule_0 := prev_0
    rule_1 := prev_1
    rule_2 := prev_2
    rule_3 := prev_3
    rule_4 := prev_4
    finsupp := ps.finsupp ∪ {a, b, c}
    mem_1 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_0_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) bc p4XZ rule_def_0_0 rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_2 new_imp ps.mem_1
    mem_2 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_1_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) rule_def_0_1 rule_def_1_0 new_imp ps.mem_2
    mem_3 := by simpa only [Finset.union_insert, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton] using rule_finite_2_preserved G a b c ps.R new sP0 sP1 (· ∈ ps.finsupp) p4XZ rule_def_0_2 rule_def_1_0 rule_def_1_1 new_imp ps.mem_1 ps.mem_3
  }, by simp only [new_new, imp_iff_not_or, imp_new_0, implies_true, and_self]⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_covers [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∃ c, (ps.addArbitrary a b).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · assumption
  · generalize_proofs h1 h2 h3
    exact ⟨h1.choose, (h3 h2).choose_spec.1⟩

name: PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.addArbitrary_contains [Infinite G] (a b : G) :
    ∀ x y z, ps.R x y z → (ps.addArbitrary a b).R x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold addArbitrary
  split
  · simp
  · generalize_proofs v1 v2 v3
    exact (v3 v2).choose_spec.2

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists
statement: lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, (complSeq ps (Nat.pair a b + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_covers

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono_add_one (i : ℕ) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps (i + 1)).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  simp [complSeq]
  apply addArbitrary_contains
  exact h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_mono
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_mono (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (a b c : ℕ) (h : (complSeq ps i).R a b c) :
    (complSeq ps j).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  induction hij
  · exact h
  · apply ps.complSeq_mono_add_one
    assumption

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_exists_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (h : Nat.pair a b < i) :
    ∃ c, (complSeq ps i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ps.complSeq_exists a b
  use c
  apply complSeq_mono _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc
  omega

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule0
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule0 (a b c d : ℕ)
    (h : ps.compl a b c) (h2 : ps.compl a b d) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  unfold compl at *
  have := (ps.complSeq (Nat.pair a b + 1)).rule_0 a b c d
  simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_exists
statement: theorem PartialSolution.compl_exists (a b : ℕ) : ∃ c, ps.compl a b c
proof:
:=
  complSeq_exists ..

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) (h : ps.compl a b c) : (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:=
  PartialSolution.complSeq_mono _ _ _ (by omega) _ _ _ h

name: PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt
statement:
lemma PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt (a b i : ℕ) (habi : Nat.pair a b < i)
    (c : ℕ) : ps.compl a b c ↔ (ps.complSeq i).R a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro
    apply PartialSolution.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt <;> assumption
  · intro h
    have ⟨c', hc⟩ := ps.compl_exists a b
    convert hc
    have := ps.complSeq_of_compl_of_lt a b i habi c' hc
    have := (ps.complSeq i).rule_0 a b c c'
    simp_all

name: PartialSolution.compl_rule1
statement:
theorem PartialSolution.compl_rule1 (X0 X1 X2 X3 X4 : ℕ) :
    ¬ ps.compl X0 X1 X2 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X1 X1 X3 ∨ ¬ ps.compl X2 X3 X4 ∨ ps.compl X1 X4 X0
proof:
:= by
  let i := 1 + max (Nat.pair X0 X1) (max (Nat.pair X1 X1) (max (Nat.pair X2 X3) (max (Nat.pair X1 X4) 0)))
  repeat rw [PartialSolution.complSeq_iff_of_lt _ _ _ i]
  apply PartialSolution.rule_1
  all_goals omega

name: PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff
statement: theorem PartialSolution.complFun_eq_iff (a b c : ℕ) : ps.complFun a b = c ↔ ps.compl a b c
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ps.compl_exists a b).choose_spec

name: Finite.Equation1076_implies_Equation3
statement:
@[equational_result]
theorem Finite.Equation1076_implies_Equation3 (G : Type*) [Magma G] [Finite G] (h : Equation1076 G) : Equation3 G
proof:
:= by
  by_contra nh
  simp only [not_forall] at nh
  obtain ⟨sK0, nh⟩ := nh
  have step9 (X0 X1 : G) : (X1 ◇ ((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X1)) ◇ X1)) = X0 := mod_symm (h ..)
  have step10 : sK0 ≠ (sK0 ◇ sK0) := mod_symm nh
  have step11 (X Y : G) : ((Y ◇ (X ◇ Y)) ◇ ((Y ◇ (X ◇ Y)) ◇ Y)) = X := by
    let S : Set G := Set.univ
    have m1 : S.MapsTo (fun s => (s ◇ (s ◇ Y))) S := by
      intro
      simp [S]
    have m2 : S.MapsTo (fun s => (Y ◇ (s ◇ Y))) S := by
      intro
      simp [S]
    have linv : S.LeftInvOn (fun s => (Y ◇ (s ◇ Y))) (fun s => (s ◇ (s ◇ Y))) := by
      intro a ha
      simp [S]
      simp [← h]
    have t := linv.surjOn m1
    rw [Set.Finite.surjOn_iff_bijOn_of_mapsTo (Set.toFinite _) m2] at t
    have rinv := Set.InjOn.rightInvOn_of_leftInvOn t.injOn linv m2 m1
    apply rinv _
    simp [S]
  have step12 (X Y : G) : (((Y ◇ X) ◇ ((Y ◇ X) ◇ Y)) ◇ Y) = X := by
    let S : Set G := Set.univ
    have m1 : S.MapsTo (fun s => ((s ◇ (s ◇ Y)) ◇ Y)) S := by
      intro
      simp [S]
    have m2 : S.MapsTo (fun s => (Y ◇ s)) S := by
      intro
      simp [S]
    have linv : S.LeftInvOn (fun s => (Y ◇ s)) (fun s => ((s ◇ (s ◇ Y)) ◇ Y)) := by
      intro a ha
      simp [S]
      simp [← h]
    have t := linv.surjOn m1
    rw [Set.Finite.surjOn_iff_bijOn_of_mapsTo (Set.toFinite _) m2] at t
    have rinv := Set.InjOn.rightInvOn_of_leftInvOn t.injOn linv m2 m1
    apply rinv _
    simp [S]
  have step13 (X0 X1 : G) : (((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X1)) ◇ X1) ◇ ((X1 ◇ X0) ◇ ((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X1)) ◇ X1))) = X1 := superpose step9 step9
  have step15 (X0 X1 : G) : ((X1 ◇ X0) ◇ ((X1 ◇ X0) ◇ X1)) = (X1 ◇ ((((X1 ◇ X0) ◇ ((X1 ◇ X0) ◇ X1)) ◇ X0) ◇ X1)) := superpose step12 step9
  have step75 (X0 : G) : ((X0 ◇ X0) ◇ ((X0 ◇ X0) ◇ X0)) = (X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X0)) := superpose step12 step15
  have step91 (X0 : G) : ((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X0)) ◇ X0) = X0 := superpose step75 step12
  have step92 (X0 : G) : (((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X0)) ◇ X0) ◇ ((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X0)) ◇ ((X0 ◇ (X0 ◇ X0)) ◇ X0))) = X0 := superpose step75 step13
